Arakhin 15b:18-16a:4: Tana deve rabbi yishmael: kol hamesapper lashon hara magdil avonot keneged shalosh averot, avoda zara vegilluy arayot ushefichut damim. ketiv hacha "lashon medabberet gedolot", uchetiv baavoda zara "anna chata haam hazze chataa gedola".
Begilluy arayot ketiv: "veech eese haraa haggedola hazzot", bishfichut damim ketiv: "gadol avoni minneso".
Bemareva amri: lashon telitay katel telitay, horeg lamsappero, velamkabbelo, velaomrin alav.

Amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: may dichtiv "mavet vechayyim beyad lashon", vechi yesh yad lallashon? lomar lach: ma yad memita — af lashon memita. i ma yad enah memita ella besamuch lah — af lashon enah memita ella besamuch lah? talmud lomar: "chetz shachut leshonam".
I ma chetz ad arbaim vachamishshim amma, af lashon ad arbaim vachamishshim amma? talmud lomar: "shattu vashshamayim pihem uleshonam tihalach baaretz".
Vechi meachar dichtiv "shattu bashshamayim pihem", "chetz shachut leshonam" lema li? ha kamashma lan, dekatel kechetz.
Vechi meachar dichtiv "chetz shachut leshonam", "mavet vechayyim beyad lashon" lema li? lechidrava, deamar rava: devae chayyim — belishshaneh, devae mita — belishshaneh.

Hechi dame lishshana bisha? rava amar: kegon deamar "ikka nura be felanya". amar leh abbaye: may ka aved? galloye milleta bealma hu! ella demappek belishshana bisha, deamar: "hecha mishtechach nura ella be felanya".

Amar rabba: kol milleta demitamra beappe mara, let ba mishshum lishshana bisha. amar leh: kol shekken chutzepa velishshana bisha! amar leh: ana kerabbi yose sevira li, deamar rabbi yose: miyyamay lo amarti davar vechazarti laachoray. amar
Rabba bar rav huna: kol milleta demitamra beappe telata, let bah mishshum lishshana bisha. may tama? chavrach chavra it leh, vechavra dechavrach chavra it leh.

Ki ata rav dimi amar: may dichtiv "mevarech reehu bekol gadol babboker hashekem kelala techashev lo"? kegon demikkela leushepiza vetarchu kammeh shappir, limchar nafek yatev beshuka veamar: rachamana nivarcheh liflanya dehachi terach kammay, veshamin inashe veazlin veansin leh.
Tane rav dimi achu derav safra: leolam al yesapper adam betovato shel chavero, shemmittoch tovato ba lide raato.

Ikka deamri: rav dimi achu derav safra chalash, al rav safra leshayyole beh. amar lehu: tete li dekayyemi kol daamur rabbanan. amar leh: ha mi mekayyeymat — leolam al yesapper adam betovato shel chavero shemmittoch tovato ba lide genuto? amar lehu: la shemia li, vei hava shemia li — kayyemta.
Avodah Zarah 55a:2-10: Shaal agrippas sar tzava et rabban gamliel: ketiv betoratchem: "ki Adonai elohecha esh ochla hu el kanna", kelum mitkanne ella chacham bechacham, vegibbor begibbor, veashir beashir?
Amar lo: emshol lecha mashal, lema haddavar dome? leadam shennasa ishsha al ishto, chashuva mimmenna — en mitkannea bah, pechuta mimmenna — mitkannea bah.
Amar leh zunin lerabbi akiva: libbi velibbach yada daavoda zara let ba meshasha, veha kachazenan gavre deazli ki metabberi veatu ki metzammedi! may tama?

Amar lo: emshol lecha mashal, lema haddavar dome? leadam neeman shehaya bair, vechol bene iro hayu mafkidin etzlo shello beedim, uva adam echad vehifkid lo beedim. paam echad shachach vehifkid etzlo shello beedim, amra lo ishto: bo venichperennu, amar lah: vechi mippene sheshshote ze asa shello kahogen anu neabbed et emunatenu?

Af kach yissurin, beshaa shemmeshaggerin otan al haadam, mashbiin otan: shello telchu ella beyom peloni, velo tetzu ella beyom peloni uveshaa pelonit, veal yede peloni veal yede sam peloni. kevan shehiggia zemannan latzet, halach ze levet avoda zara, amru yissurin: din hu shello netze, vechozrin veomrim: vechi mippene sheshshote ze ose shello kahogen anu neabbed shevuatenu?
Vehayeynu deamar rabbi yochanan: may dichtiv "vocholayim raim veneemanim"? raim bishlichutan, veneemanim bishvuatan.

Amar leh rava bar rav yitzchak lerav yehuda: haikka bet avoda zara beatrin, dechi mitzterich alma lemitra, mitchaze lehu bechelma veamar lehu: shachatu li gavra veayyte mitra — shachatu la gavra veate mitra!

Amar leh: hasheta (i havay) [ikko] shachevna, la amari lechu ha milleta, deamar rav: may dichtiv "asher chalak Adonai elohecha otam lechol haammim"? melammed shehechlikan bidvarim, kede letordan min haolam.
Vehayeynu deamar resh lakish: may dichtiv "im lalletzim hu yalitz velaanavim yitten chen"? ba littamme — potchin lo, ba littaher — mesayyeyin oto.
Berakhot 63b:10-14: Veod patach rabbi yehuda bichvod tora vedarash: "haseket ushema yisrael hayyom hazze nihyeta leam", vechi oto hayyom nittena tora leyisrael? vahalo oto yom sof arbaim shana haya! ella lelammedcha shechaviva tora al lomdeha bechol yom vayom kayyom shennittena mehar sinay.
Amar rabbi tanchum bereh derabbi chiyyay ish kefar akko: teda — shehare adam kore keriat shema shacharit vearvit, veerev echad eno kore — dome kemi shello kara keriat shema meolam.

"Haseket" — asu kittot kittot veisku battora. lefi sheen hattora niknet ella bachavura. kidrabbi yose berabbi chanina, deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: may dichtiv "cherev el habbaddim venoalu" — cherev al sonehem shel talmide chachamim sheyyoshvim bad bevad veoskim battora. velo od, ella shemmittappeshim, ketiv hacha "venoalu", uchetiv hatam "asher noalnu". velo od, ella shechotim, shenneemar "vaasher chatanu".

Davar acher: "haseket ushema yisrael" — kattetu atzmechem al divre tora. kidamar resh lakish, deamar resh lakish: minnayin sheen divre tora mitkayyeymin ella bemi shemmemit atzmo aleha — shenneemar: "zot hattora adam ki yamut beohel".

Mishnah Menachot 10:2-5:
Mitzvat haomer lavo min hakkarov. lo vikker hakkarov lirushalayim, meviim oto mikkol makom. maase shebba miggaggot tzerifin, ushete hallechem mibbikat en socher: 
Ketzad hayu osim. sheluche vet din yotzim meerev yom tov, veosim oto cherichot bimchubbar lakkarka, kede sheyyehe noach liktzor. vechol haayarot hassemuchot lesham, mitkannesot lesham, kede sheyyehe niktzar beesek gadol. kevan shechashecha, omer lahem, ba hashshamesh, omrim, hen. ba hashshamesh, omrim hen. maggal zo, omrim hen. maggal zo, omrim hen. kuppa zo, omrim hen. kuppa zo, omrim hen. beshabbat omer lahem, shabbat zo, omrim hen. shabbat zo, omrim hen. ektzor, vehem omrim lo ketzor. ektzor, vehem omrim lo ketzor. shalosh peamim al kol davar vedavar, vehem omrim lo hen, hen, hen. vechol kach lamma. mippene habbaytosim, shehayu omrim, en ketzirat haomer bemotzae yom tov: 
Ketzaruhu unetanuhu vekuppot, heviuhu laazara, hayu mehavehvin oto vaur, kede lekayyem bo mitzvat kali, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, bekanim uviklichot chovtim oto, kede shello yitmaech. netanuhu laabbuv, veabbuv haya menukkav, kede sheyyehe haur sholet bechullo. shetachuhu vaazara, veharuach menashshevet bo. netanuhu verechayim shel garosot, vehotziu mimmennu issaron shehu menuppe mishshelosh esre nafa, vehashshear nifde veneechol lechol adam. vechayyav bachalla, ufatur min hammaasrot. rabbi akiva mechayyev bachalla uvammaasrot. va lo laissaron, venatan shamno ulevonato, yatzak, uvalal, henif, vehiggish, vekamatz, vehiktir, vehashshear neechol lakkohanim: 
Mishshekkarav haomer, yotzin umotzin shuk yerushalayim shehu male kemach vekali, shello virtzon chachamim, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, birtzon chachamim hayu osim. mishshekkarav haomer, huttar hechadash miyyad, veharchokim muttarim mechatzot hayyom ulehallan. mishshecharav bet hammikdash, hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay, sheyyehe yom hanef kullo asur. amar rabbi yehuda, vahalo min hattora hu asur, shenneemar (Vayikra 23), ad etzem hayyom hazze. mippene ma harchokim muttarim mechatzot hayyom ulehallan, mippene shehen yodin sheen bet din mitatztzelin bo:
Mishnah Menachot 10:6-9:
Haomer haya mattir bammedina, ushete hallechem bammikdash. en meviin menachot uvikkurim uminchat behema kodem laomer. veim hevi, pasul. kodem lishte hallechem, lo yavi. veim hevi, kasher: 
Hachittim vehasseorim vehakkussemin veshibbolet shual vehashshifon chayyavin bachalla, umitztarfin ze im ze, vaasurim bechadash millifne happesach, umilliktzor millifne haomer. veim hishrishu kodem laomer, haomer mattiran. veim lav, asurim ad sheyyavo omer habba: 
Kotzrim bet hashshelachim shebbaamakim, aval lo godshin. anshe yericho kotzrin birtzon chachamim, vegodshin shello virtzon chachamim, velo michu veyadam chachamim. kotzer lashshachat, umaachil labbehema. amar rabbi yehuda, ematay, bizman shehitchil ad shello hevia shelish. rabbi shimon omer, af yiktzor veyaachil af mishshehevia shelish: 
Kotzrin mippene hannetiot, mippene vet haevel, mippene vittul bet hammidrash. lo yaase otan kerichot, aval mannichan tzevatim. mitzvat haomer lavo min hakkama. lo matza, yavi min hoomarim. mitzvato lavo min hallach. lo matza, yavi min hayyavesh. mitzvato liktzor ballayla. niktzar bayyom, kasher. vedoche et hashshabbat:
Mishnah Menachot 7:6-8:4:
Minnayin laomer hare alay toda, lo yavi ella min hachullin, shenneemar (Devarim 16), vezavachta pesach laAdonai elohecha tzon uvakar, vahalo en pesach ba ella min hakkevasim umin haizzim. im ken, lamma neemar tzon uvakar. ella lehakish kol habba min habbakar umin hatztzon lappesach, ma happesach, shehu va vechova, eno va ella min hachullin, af kol davar shehu va vechova, lo yavo ella min hachullin. lefichach, haomer hare alay toda, hare alay shelamim, hoil vehem baim chova, lo yavou ella min hachullin. vehannesachim bechol makom lo yavou ella min hachullin: 
Kol karbenot hatztzibbur vehayyachid baim min haaretz umichutza laaretz, min hechadash umin hayyashan, chutz min haomer ushete hallechem, sheenan baim ella min hechadash umin haaretz. vechullan enan baim ella min hammuvchar. veezehu muvchar. michmas umezonicha, alfa lassolet. sheniyya lahem, chafarayim babbika. kol haaratzot hayu chesherot, ella mikkan hayu meviim: 
En meviin lo mibbet hazzevalim, velo mibbet hashshelachim, velo mibbet hailan. veim hevi, kasher. ketzad hu ose, narah shana rishona, uvashsheniyya zorah kodem lappesach shivim yom, vehi osa solet merubba. ketzad hu vodek. haggizbar machnis et yado letochah. ala vah avak, pesula, ad sheyyenifenna. veim hitlia, pesula: 
Tekoa, alfa lashshamen. abba shaul omer, sheniyya lah regev beever hayyarden. kol haaratzot hayu chesherot, ella mikkan hayu meviin. en meviin lo mibbet hazzevalim, velo mibbet hashshelachim, velo mimma shennizra benehem. veim hevi, kasher. en meviin anpiknon. veim hevi, pasul. en meviin min haggargerim shennishru vammayim, velo min hakkevushim, velo min hashshelukin. veim hevi, pasul: 
Shelosha zetim, uvahen shelosha shelosha shemanim. hazzayit harishon, megargero verosh hazzayit vechotesh venoten letoch hassal. rabbi yehuda omer, sevivot hassal. ze rishon. taan bekora, rabbi yehuda omer, baavanim. ze sheni. chazar vetachan vetaan, ze shelishi. harishon lammenora, vehashshear lammenachot. hazzayit hashsheni megargero verosh haggag, vechotesh venoten letoch hassal. rabbi yehuda omer, sevivot hassal, ze rishon. taan bekora, rabbi yehuda omer, baavanim, ze sheni. chazar vetachan vetaan, ze shelishi. harishon lammenora, vehashshear lammenachot. hazzayit hashshelishi, otno vetoch habbayit ad sheyyilke, umaalehu umenaggevo verosh haggag, vechotesh venoten letoch hassal. rabbi yehuda omer, sevivot hassal, ze rishon. taan bekora, rabbi yehuda omer, baavanim, ze sheni. chazar vetachan vetaan, ze shelishi. harishon lammenora, vehashshear lammenachot:
Mishnah Menachot 8:5-9:1:
Harishon shebbarishon, en lemala mimmennu. hashsheni shebbarishon veharishon shebbashsheni, shavin. hashshelishi shebbarishon vehashsheni shebbashsheni veharishon shebbashshelishi, shavin. hashshelishi shebbashsheni vehashsheni shebbashshelishi, shavin. hashshelishi shebbashshelishi, en lematta mimmennu. af hammenachot hayu vaddin sheyyittaanu shemen zayit zach. ma im hammenora sheenah laachila, teuna shemen zayit zach, hammenachot, shehen laachila, eno din sheyyittaanu shemen zayit zach. talmud lomar (Shemot 27), zach katit lammaor, velo zach katit lammenachot: 
Uminnayin hayu meviin et hayyayin. kerutim vehattulim, alfa layyayin. sheniyya lahen, bet rimma uvet lavan bahar, uchefar signa vabbika. kol haaratzot hayu chesherot, ella mikkan hayu meviin. en meviin, lo mibbet hazzevalim, velo mibbet hashshelachin, velo mimma shennizra benehen. veim hevi, kasher. en meviin ilyusetan. veim hevi, kasher. en meviin yashan, divre rabbi. vachachamim machshirin. en meviin, lo matok, velo meushshan, velo mevushshal. veim hevi, pasul. en meviin min haddaliyyot, ella min harogliyyot umin hakkeramim haavudim: 
Lo hayu chonsim oto vachatzavim gedolim, ella vechaviyyot ketannot. veeno memalle et hechaviyyot ad pihem, kede sheyyehe recho nodef. eno mevi, lo mippiha, mippene hakkemachin. velo mishshuleha, mippene hashshemarim. ella mevi mishshelishah umeemtzaah. ketzad hu vodek, haggizbar yoshev vehakkane veyado, zarak et haggid vehikkish bakkane. rabbi yose verabbi yehuda omer, yayin sheala vo kemachin, pasul, shenneemar, temimim yihyu lachem uminchatam (Bamidbar 28), temimim yihyu lachem veniskehem (sham): 
Shete middot shel yavesh hayu vammikdash, issaron, vachatzi issaron. rabbi meir omer, issaron, issaron, vachatzi issaron. issaron me haya meshammesh, shebbo haya moded lechol hammenachot. lo haya moded, lo veshel shelosha lefar, velo veshel shenayim leayil, ella moddan esronot. chatzi issaron me haya meshammesh, shebbo haya moded chavitte chohen gadol, mechetza babboker umechetza ben haarbayim:
Mishnah Menachot 9:2-5:
Sheva middot shel lach hayu vammikdash. hin, vachatzi hahin, ushelishit hahin, ureviit hahin, log, vachatzi log, ureviit log. rabbi eliezer bar tzadok omer, shenatot hayu vahin, ad kan lefar, ad kan leayil, ad kan lecheves. rabbi shimon omer, lo haya sham hin, vechi me haya hahin meshammesh. ella midda yetera shel log umechetza hayta, shebbah haya moded leminchat kohen gadol, log umechetza babboker velog umechetza ben haarbayim: 
Reviit me hayta meshammeshet. reviit mayim limtzora, ureviit shemen lenazir. chatzi log me haya meshammesh. chatzi log mayim lesota. vachatzi log shemen letoda. uvallog haya moded lechol hammenachot. afillu mincha shel shishshim issaron, noten lah shishshim log. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, afillu mincha shel shishshim issaron, en lah ella luggah, shenneemar (Vayikra 14), lemincha velog shamen. shishsha lefar, arbaa leayil, shelosha lecheves, shelosha umechetza lammenora, mechatzi log lechol ner: 
Mearvin niske elim beniske farim, niske chevasim beniske chevasim, shel yachid beshel tzibbur, shel yom beshel amesh. aval en mearvin niske chevasim beniske farim veelim. veim belalan ellu vifne atzman veellu vifne atzman, venitarvu, kesherin. im ad shello valal, pasul. hakkeves habba im haomer, af al pi shemminchato chefula, lo hayu nesachav kefulin: 
Kol hammiddot shehayu vammikdash, hayu nigdashot, chutz mishshel kohen gadol, shehaya godshah letochah. middot hallach, berutzehen kodesh. umiddot hayyavesh, berutzehen chol. rabbi akiva omer, middot hallach kodesh, lefichach berutzehen kodesh. umiddot hayyavesh chol, lefichach berutzehen chol. rabbi yose omer, lo mishshum ze, ella shehallach nekar, vehayyavesh eno nekar:
Mishnah Menachot 9:6-10:1:
Kol karbenot hatztzibbur vehayyachid teunin nesachim, chutz min habbechor vehammaaser vehappesach vehachattat vehaasham, ella shechattato shel metzora vaashamo teunim nesachim: 
Kol karbenot hatztzibbur en bahem semicha, chutz min happar habba al kol hammitzvot, vesair hammishtalleach. rabbi shimon omer, af seire avoda zara. kol karbenot hayyachid teunim semicha, chutz min habbechor vehammaaser vehappasach. vehayyoresh somech umevi nesachim umemir: 
Hakkol somchin, chutz mecheresh, shote, vekatan, suma, venachri, vehaeved, vehashshaliach, vehaishsha. usemicha, sheyare mitzva, al harosh, bishte yadayim. uvimkom shessomchin shochatin, vetechef lassemicha shechita: 
Chomer bassemicha mibbattenufa uvattenufa mibbassemicha, sheechad menif lechol hachaverim veen echad somech lechol hachaverim. vechomer battenufa, shehattenufa noheget bekarbenot hayyachid uvekarbenot hatztzibbur, bachayyim uvashshechutin, bedavar sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim uvedavar sheen bo ruach chayyim, ma sheen ken bassemicha: 
Rabbi yishmael omer, haomer haya va veshabbat mishshalosh sein, uvechol mechamesh. vachachamim omrim, echad beshabbat veechad bechol, mishshalosh haya va. rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim omer, beshabbat haya niktzar beyachid uvemaggal echad uvekuppa achat. uvechol, bishlosha uveshalosh kuppot uveshalosh maggalot. vachachamim omrim, echad beshabbat veechad bechol, bishlosha uveshalosh kuppot uveshalosh maggalot:
Mishnah Oktzin 1:1-2:
Kol shehu yad velo shomer, mittamme umetamme velo mitztaref. shomer, af al pi sheeno yad, mittamme umetamme umitztaref. lo shomer velo yad, lo mittamme velo metamme: 
Sharshe hashshum vehabbetzalim vehakkaflotot bizman shehen lachin, vehappitma shellahen ben lacha ben yevesha, vehaammud shehu mechuvvan keneged haochel, sharshe hachazarim vehatztzenon vehannafus, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, shoresh tzenon gadol mitztaref, vehassiv shello, eno mitztaref. sharshe hammitna vehappegam veyarkot sade veyarkot ginna sheakaran leshatlan, vehashshidra shel shibbolet vehallevush shellah, rabbi elazar omer, af hassig shel retzafot, hare ellu mittammein umetammeim umitztarfin:
Mishnah Tevul Yom 4:6-7:
Hakkaddumin haashkelonim shennishberu veunkeli shellahem kayyemet, hare ellu temein. hammaber vehammazre vehammaggov vechen masrek shel rosh shennittela achat mishshinnehen vaasaan shel mattachot, hare ellu temein. veal kullan amar rabbi yehoshua, davar chadash chiddeshu hassofrim veen li ma lehashiv: 
Hattorem et habbor veamar, hare zo teruma al menat shettaale shalom, shalom min hashshever umin hashsheficha, aval lo min hattuma. rabbi shimon omer, af min hattuma. nishbera, enah medammaat. ad hechan tishshaver velo tedammea. kede shettitgalgel vetaggia labbor. rabbi yose omer, af mi shehaya vo daat lehatenot velo hitna, nishbera, enah medammaat, mippene shehu tenay bet din:
Mishnah Yadayim 1:1-2:
Me reviit notnin layyadayim, leechad, af lishnayim. machatzit log, lishlosha o learbaa. millog, lachamishsha velaasara ulemea. rabbi yose omer, uvilvad shello yifchot laacharon shebbahem merviit. mosifin al hashsheniyyim veen mosifin al harishonim: 
Bechol hakkelim notnin layyadayim, afillu vichle gelalim, bichle avanim, bichle adama. en notnin layyadayim, lo vedafnot hakkelim, velo veshule hammachatz, velo vimgufat hechavit. velo yitten lachavero vechafnav, mippene sheen memallein veen mekaddeshin veen mazzin me chattat veen notnim layyadayim ella vichli. veen matztzilin betzamid patil ella chelim, sheen matztzilin miyyad keli cheres ella chelim:
Mishnah Yadayim 1:3-2:1:
Hammayim shennifselu mishshetiyyat habbehema, bechelim, pesulim. uvekarkaot, kesherim. nafal letochan deyo, komos, vekankantom venishtannu marehen, pesulin. asa vahem melacha o sheshshara vahen pitto, pesulin. shimon hattimni omer, afillu nitkavven lishrot baze venafal lashsheni, kesherim: 
Hediach bahem et hakkelim o shemmicha vahem et hammiddot, pesulim. hediach bahem kelim mudachim o chadashim, kesherim. rabbi yose fosel bachadashim: 
Hammayim shehannachtom matbil bahem et haggeluskin, pesulim. ucheshehu mediach et yadav bahen, kesherim. hakkol kesherim litten layyadayim, afillu cheresh shote vekatan. manniach chavit ben birkav venotel. matte chavit al tziddah venotel. vehakkof notel layyadayim. rabbi yose fosel bishne ellu: 
Natal leyado achat mishshetifa achat, yado tehora. lishte yadav mishshetifa achat, rabbi meir metamme, ad sheyyittol merviit. nafal kikkar shel teruma, tahor. rabbi yose metamme:
Mishnah Yadayim 2:2-3:2:
Natal et harishonim lemakom echad, veet hashsheniyyim lemakom acher, venafal kikkar shel teruma al harishonim, tame, veal hashsheniyyim, tahor. natal et harishonim veet hashsheniyyim lemakom echad, venafal kikkar shel teruma, tame. natal et harishonim venimtza al yadav kesam o tzeror, yadav temeot, sheen hammayim haacharonim metaharim ella hammayim sheal gabbe hayyad. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, kol shehu mibberiyyat hammayim, tahor: 
Hayyadayim mittammeot umittaharot ad happerek. ketzad. natal et harishonim ad happerek, veet hashsheniyyim chutz lapperek, vechazru layyad, tehora. natal et harishonim veet hashsheniyyim chutz lapperek vechazru layyad, temea. natal et harishonim leyado achat venimlach venatal et hashsheniyyim lishte yadav, temeot. natal et harishonim lishte yadav venimlach venatal et hashsheniyyim leyado achat, yado tehora. natal leyado achat veshifshefah bachavertah, temea. berosho o vakkotel, tehora. notlin arbaa vachamishsha ze vetzad ze o ze al gabbe ze, uvilvad sheyyerappu sheyyavou vahem hammayim: 
Safek naasa vahem melacha safek lo naasa vahem melacha, safek yesh bahem kashshiur safek sheen bahem kashshiur, safek temeim safek tehorin, sefekan tahor, mippene sheamru, sefek hayyadayim littame uletamme velittaher, tahor. rabbi yose omer, littaher, tame. ketzad. hayu yadav tehorot ulefanav shene chikkarim temeim, safek naga safek lo naga, hayu yadav temeot ulefanav shene chikkarim tehorim, safek naga safek lo naga. hayu yadav achat temea veachat tehora ulefanav shene chikkarim tehorim, naga beachad mehem, safek battemea naga safek battehora naga. hayu yadav tehorot ulefanav shene chikkarim, echad tame veechad tahor, naga beachad mehen, safek battame naga safek battahor naga. hayu yadav achat temea veachat tehora ulefanav shene chikkarim echad tame veechad tahor, naga bishtehen, safek temea vattame utehora vattahor, o tehora vattame utemea vattahor, hayyadayim kemo shehayu vehakkikkarim kemot shehayu: 
Hammachnis yadav levayit hamenugga, yadav techillot, divre rabbi akiva. vachachamim omrim, yadav sheniyyot. kol hametamme vegadim bishat maggao, metamme et hayyadayim lihyot techillot, divre rabbi akiva. vachachamim omrim, lihyot sheniyyot. amru lo lerabbi akiva, hechan matzinu shehayyadayim techilla vechol makom. amar lahem, vechi heach efshar lahen lihyot techilla ella im ken nitma gufo, chutz mizze. hoochalin vehakkelim shennitmeu vemashkin, metammein et hayyadayim lihyot sheniyyot, divre rabbi yehoshua. vachachamim omrim, et shennitma veav hattuma, metamme et hayyadayim. bivlad hattuma, eno metamme et hayyadayim. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, maase veishsha achat shebbaat lifne abba, amra lo, nichnesu yaday laavir keli cheres. amar lah, bitti, uvamme hayta tumatah, velo shamati ma amra lo. amru chachamim, mevoar haddavar. et shennitma veav hattuma, metamme et hayyadayim. bivlad hattuma, eno metamme et hayyadayim: 
Kol happosel et hatteruma, metamme et hayyadayim lihyot sheniyyot. hayyad metammea et chavertah, divre rabbi yehoshua. vachachamim omrim, en sheni ose sheni. amar lahem, vahalo chitve hakkodesh sheniyyim metammein et hayyadayim. amru lo, en danin divre tora middivre sofrim, velo divre sofrim middivre tora, velo divre sofrim middivre sofrim:
Mishnah Yadayim 3:3-4:1:
Retzuot tefillin im hattefillin, metammeot et hayyadayim. rabbi shimon omer, retzuot tefillin enan metammeot et hayyadayim: 
Gillayon shebbassefer, shemmillemalan veshemmillemattan shebbattechilla veshebbassof, metammein et hayyadayim. rabbi yehuda omer, shebbassof eno metamme, ad sheyyaase lo ammud: 
Sefer shennimchak venishtayyer bo shemonim vechamesh otiyyot, kefarashat vayhi binsoa haaron, metamme et hayyadayim. megilla shekkatuv bah shemonim vechamesh otiyyot kefarashat vayhi binsoa haaron, metamma et hayyadayim. kol kitve hakkodesh metammein et hayyadayim. shir hashshirim vekohelet metammein et hayyadayim. rabbi yehuda omer, shir hashshirim metamme et hayyadayim, vekohelet machaloket. rabbi yose omer, kohelet eno metamme et hayyadayim veshir hashshirim machaloket. rabbi shimon omer, kohelet mikkulle vet shammay umechumre vet hillel. amar rabbi shimon ben azzay, mekubbal ani mippi shivim ushenayim zaken, bayyom shehoshivu et rabbi elazar ben azarya bayshiva, sheshshir hashshirim vekohelet metammeim et hayyadayim. amar rabbi akiva, chas veshalom, lo nechelak adam miyyisrael al shir hashshirim shello tetamme et hayyadayim, sheen kol haolam kullo cheday kayyom shennittan bo shir hashshirim leyisrael, shekkol hakketuvim kodesh, veshir hashshirim kodesh kadashim. veim nechleku, lo nechleku ella al kohelet. amar rabbi yochanan ben yehoshua ben chamiv shel rabbi akiva, kedivre ven azzay, kach nechleku vechach gamru: 
Bo vayyom nimnu vegamru al arevat haraglayim, shehi mishshene luggin vead tisha kabbin shennisdeka, shehi temea midras. sherabbi akiva omer, arevat haraglayim kishmah:
Mishnah Yadayim 4:2-5: Bo vayyom amru, kol hazzevachim shennizbechu shello lishman, kesherim, ella shello alu labbealim leshum chova, chutz min happesach umin hachattat. happesach bizmanno, vehachattat bechol zeman. rabbi eliezer omer, af haasham. happesach bizmanno, vehachattat vehaasham bechol zeman. amar rabbi shimon ben azzay, mekubbelani mippi shivim ushenayim zaken, bayyom shehoshivu et rabbi elazar ben azarya bayshiva, shekkol hazzevachim hanneechalin shennizbechu shello lishman, kesherim, ella shello alu labbealim leshem chova, chutz min happesach umin hachattat. lo hosif ben azzay ella haola, velo hodu lo chachamim:

Bo vayyom amru, ammon umoav, ma hen bashsheviit. gazar rabbi tarfon, masar ani. vegazar rabbi elazar ben azarya, maaser sheni. amar rabbi yishmael, elazar ben azarya, alecha reaya lelammed, sheatta machmir, shekkol hammachmir, alav reaya lelammed. amar lo rabbi elazar ben azarya, yishmael achi, ani lo shinniti misseder hashshanim, tarfon achi shinna, vealav reaya lelammed. heshiv rabbi tarfon, mitzrayim chutz laaretz, ammon umoav chutz laaretz, ma mitzrayim masar ani vashsheviit, af ammon umoav masar ani vashsheviit. heshiv rabbi elazar ben azarya, bavel chutz laaretz, ammon umoav chutz laaretz, ma bavel maaser sheni vashsheviit, af ammon umoav maaser sheni vashsheviit. amar rabbi tarfon, mitzrayim shehi kerova, asauha masar ani, sheyyihyu aniyye yisrael nismachim aleha bashsheviit, af ammon umoav, shehem kerovim, naasim masar ani, sheyyihyu aniyye yisrael nismachim alehem bashsheviit. amar lo rabbi elazar ben azarya, hare atta chimhannan mamon, veen atta ella chemafsid nefashot. kovea atta et hashshamayim millehorid tal umatar, shenneemar (Malachi 3), hayikba adam elohim ki attem kovim oti vaamartem bamme kevaanucha hammaaser vehatteruma. amar rabbi yehoshua, hareni chemeshiv al tarfon achi, aval lo leinyan devarav. mitzrayim maase chadash, uvavel maase yashan, vehanniddon shellefanenu maase chadash. yiddon maase chadash mimmaase chadash, veal yiddon maase chadash mimmaase yashan. mitzrayim maase zekenim, uvavel maase neviim, vehanniddon shellefanenu maase zekenim. yiddon maase zekenim mimmaase zekenim, veal yiddon maase zekenim mimmaase neviim. nimnu vegamru, ammon umoav measserin masar ani bashsheviit. ucheshebba rabbi yose ben durmaskit etzel rabbi eliezer belod, amar lo, ma chiddush haya lachem bevet hammidrash hayyom. amar lo, nimnu vegamru, ammon umoav measserim masar ani bashsheviit. bacha rabbi eliezer veamar, sod Adonai lireav uverito lehodiam (tehillim ko). tze veemor lahem, al tachoshshu leminyanchem. mekubbal ani merabban yochanan ben zakkay, sheshshama merabbo, verabbo merabbo ad halacha lemoshe missinay, sheammon umoav measserin masar ani bashsheviit:

Bo vayyom ba yehuda, ger ammoni, veamad lifnehen bevet hammidrash. amar lahem, ma ani lavo vakkahal. amar lo rabban gamliel, asur atta. amar lo rabbi yehoshua, muttar atta. amar lo rabban gamliel, hakkatuv omer (Devarim 23), lo yavo ammoni umoavi bikhal Adonai gam dor asiri vegomer. amar lo rabbi yehoshua, vechi ammonim umoavim bimkoman hen. kevar ala sancheriv melech ashshur uvilbel et kol haummot, shenneemar (yeshaya 10), veasir gevulot ammim vaatudotehem shoseti veorid kabbir yoshvim. amar lo rabban gamliel, hakkatuv omer (yirmeya mat), veachare chen ashiv et shevut bene ammon, uchevar chazru. amar lo rabbi yehoshua, hakkatuv omer (yirmeya 30 3), veshavti et shevut ammi yisrael vihuda, vaadayin lo shavu. hittiruhu lavo vakkahal:

Targum shebbeezra veshebbedaniyyel, metamme et hayyadayim. targum shekketavo ivrit veivrit shekketavo targum, uchetav ivri, eno metamme et hayyadayim. leolam eno metamme, ad sheyyichtevennu ashshurit, al haor, uvidyo:
Mishnah Yadayim 4:6-8: Omrim tzedokim, kovlin anu alechem, perushim, sheattem omrim, kitve hakkodesh metammein et hayyadayim, vesifre homeris eno metamme et hayyadayim. amar rabban yochanan ben zakkay, vechi en lanu al happerushim ella zo vilvad. hare hem omrim, atzmot chamor tehorim veatzmot yochanan kohen gadol temeim. amru lo, lefi chibbatan hi tumatan, shello yaase adam atzmot aviv veimmo tarvadot. amar lahem, af kitve hakkodesh lefi chibbatan hi tumatan, vesifre homeris, sheenan chavivin, enan metammein et hayyadayim:

Omrim tzedokin, kovlin anu alechem, perushim, sheattem metaharim et hannitztzok. omrim happerushim, kovlin anu alechem, tzedokim, sheattem metaharim et ammat hammayim habbaa mibbet hakkevarot. omrim tzedokin, kovlin anu alechem, perushim, sheattem omrim, shori vachamori shehizziku, chayyavin. veavdi vaamati shehizziku, peturin. ma im shori vachamori, sheeni chayyav bahem mitzvot, hare ani chayyav benizkan. avdi vaamati, sheani chayyav bahen mitzvot, eno din sheehe chayyav benizkan. amru lahem, lo. im amartem beshori vachamori, sheen bahem daat, tomru beavdi uvaamati, sheyyesh bahem daat. sheim aknitem, yelech veyadlik gedisho shel acher veehe chayyav leshallem:

Amar tzedoki gelili, kovel ani alechem, perushim, sheattem kotvin et hammoshel im moshe bagget. omrim perushim, kovlin anu alecha, tzedoki gelili, sheattem kotvim et hammoshel im hashshem baddaf, velo od, ella sheattem kotvin et hammoshel milmalan veet hashshem millemattan, shenneemar (Shemot 5) vayyomer paro mi Adonai asher eshma bekolo leshallach et yisrael. ucheshellaka mahu omer (sham 9), Adonai hatztzaddik:
Mishnah Yevamot 2:10-3:4:
Hechacham sheasar et haishsha beneder al balah, hare ze lo yissaenna. meana, o shechaltza vefanav, yissaenna, mippene shehu vet din. vechullan shehayu lahem nashim, vametu, muttarot linnase lahem. vechullan shennisseu laacherim venitgarshu o shennitalmenu, muttarot linnase lahen. vechullan muttarot livnehem o laachehen: 
Arbaa achin, shenayim mehen nesuim shete achayot, umetu hannesuim et haachayot, hare ellu choltzot velo mityabbemot. veim kadmu vechansu, yotziu. rabbi eliezer omer, bet shammay omrim yekayyemu, uvet hillel omrim yotziu: 
Hayta achat mehen asura al haechad issur erva, asur bah umuttar baachotah, vehashsheni asur bishtehen issur mitzva veissur kedushsha, choletzet velo mityabbemet: 
Hayta achat mehen asura al ze issur erva, vehashsheniyya asura al ze issur erva, haasura laze mutteret laze, vehaasura laze mutteret laze. vezo hi sheamru, achotah keshehi yevimtah, o choletzet o mityabbemet: 
Shelosha achin, shenayim mehen nesuin shete achayot, o ishsha uvittah, o ishsha uvat bittah, o ishsha uvat benah, hare ellu choltzot velo mityabbemot. verabbi shimon poter. hayta achat mehen asura alav issur erva, asur bah umuttar baachotah. issur mitzva o issur kedushsha, choltzot velo mityabbemot:
Mishnah Yevamot 2:6-9:
Mi shekkiddesh achat mishshete achayot veeno yodea ezo mehen kiddesh, noten get lazo veget lazo. met, velo ach echad, choletz lishtehen. hayu lo shenayim, echad choletz veechad meyabbem. kadmu vechansu, en motziin miyyadam: 
Shenayim shekkiddeshu shete achayot, ze eno yodea ezo kiddesh, veze eno yodea ezo kiddesh, ze noten shene gittin, veze noten shene gittin. metu, laze ach, velaze ach, ze choletz lishtehen, veze choletz lishtehen. laze echad velaze shenayim, hayyachid choletz lishtehen, vehashshenayim, echad choletz veechad meyabbem, kadmu vechansu, en motziin miyyadam. laze shenayim velaze shenayim, achiv shel ze choletz leachat, veachiv shel ze choletz leachat, achiv shel ze meyabbem chalutzato shel ze, veachiv shel ze meyabbem chalutzato shel ze. kadmu shenayim vechaltzu, lo yeyabbemu hashshenayim, ella echad choletz veechad meyabbem. kadmu vechansu, en motziin miyyadam: 
Mitzva vaggadol leyabbem. veim kadam hakkatan, zacha. hannitan al hashshifcha venishtachrera, o al hannachrit venitgayyera, hare ze lo yichnos. veim kanas en motziin miyyado. hannitan al eshet ish, vehotziuha mittachat yado, af al pi shekkanas, yotzi: 
Hammevi get mimmedinat hayyam, veamar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam, lo yissa et ishto. met, haragtiv, haragnuhu, lo yissa et ishto. rabbi yehuda omer, haragtiv, lo tinnase ishto. haragnuhu, tinnase ishto:
Mishnah Yevamot 3:5-8:
Shelosha achin, shenayim mehem nesuim shete achayot, veechad mufne, met echad mibbaale achayot, veasa vah mufne maamar, veachar kach met achiv hashsheni, bet shammay omrim, ishto immo, vehalla tetze mishshum achot ishsha. uvet hillel omrim, motzi et ishto veget uvachalitza, veeshet achiv bachalitza. zo hi sheamru, oy lo al ishto veoy lo al eshet achiv: 
Shelosha achin, shenayim mehen nesuim shete achayot, veechad nasuy nachrit, met echad mibbaale achayot, vechanas nasuy nachrit et ishto, vamet, harishona yotza mishshum achot ishsha, usheniyya mishshum tzaratah. asa vah maamar, vamet, nachrit choletzet velo mityabbemet. shelosha achim, shenayim mehem nesuim shete achayot, veechad nasuy nachrit, met hannasuy nachrit, vechanas echad mibbaale achayot et ishto, vamet, harishona yotza mishshum achot ishsha, usheniyya mishshum tzaratah. asa vah maamar, vamet, nachrit choletzet velo mityabbemet: 
Shelosha achim, shenayim mehen nesuim shete achayot, veechad nasuy nachrit, met echad mibbaale achayot, vechanas nasuy nachrit et ishto, umeta ishto shel sheni, veachar kach met nasuy nachrit, hare zo asura alav olamit, hoil veneesra alav shaa echat. shelosha achim, shenayim mehen nesuin shete achayot, veechad nasuy nachrit, geresh echad mibbaale achayot et ishto, umet nasuy nachrit, uchenasah hammegaresh, vamet, zo hi sheamru, vechullan shemmetu o nitgarshu, tzarotehen muttarot: 
Vechullan shehayu vahen kiddushin o gerushin besafek, hare ellu tzarot, choltzot velo mityabbemot. ketzad sefek kiddushin, zarak lah kiddushin, safek karov lo safek karov lah, zehu sefek kiddushin. sefek gerushin, katav bichtav yado veen alav edim, yesh alav edim veen bo zeman, yesh bo zeman veen bo ella ed echad, zehu sefek gerushin:
Mishnah Yevamot 3:9-4:2:
Shelosha achin nesuin shalosh nachriot, umet achad mehen, veasa vah hashsheni maamar, vamet, hare ellu choltzot velo mityabbemot, sheneemar (Devarim 25), umet achad mehem yevamah yavo aleha, shealeha zikkat yavam echad, velo shealeha zikkat shene yevamin. rabbi shimon omer, meyabbem leezo sheyyirtze, vecholetz lashsheniyya. shene achin nesuin lishte achayot, umet achad mehen, veachar kach meta ishto shel sheni, hare zo asura alav olamit, hoil veneesra alav shaa echat: 
Shenayim shekiddeshu shete nashim, uvishat kenisatan lachuppa hechelifu et shel ze laze, veet shel ze laze, hare ellu chayyavim mishshum eshet ish. hayu achin, mishshum eshet ach. veim hayu achayot, mishshum ishsha el achotah. veim hayu niddot, mishshum nidda. umafrishin otan shelosha chodashim, shemma meubbarot hen. veim hayu ketannot sheenan reuyot leled, machazirin otan miyyad. veim hayu chohanot, nifselu min hatteruma: 
Hacholetz livimto, venimtzet meubberet veyalada, bizman shehavvalad shel keyama, hu muttar bikrovoteha, vehi mutteret bikrovav, velo fesalah min hakkehunna. en havvalad shel keyama, hu asur bikrovoteha, vehi asura vikrovav, ufesalah min hakkehunna: 
Hakkones et yevimto, venimtzet meubberet veyalada, bizman shehavvalad shel keyama, yotzi vechayyavin bakkarban. veim en havvalad shel keyama, yekayyem. safek ben tisha larishon, safek ben shiva laacharon, yotzi vehavvalad kasher, vechayyavin beasham taluy:
Mishnah Yevamot 4:3-7:
Shomeret yavam shennaflu lah nechasim, modim bet shammay uvet hillel shemmocheret, venotenet, vekayyam. meta, ma yaasu vichtubbatah uvannechasim hannichnasim veyotzin immah, bet shammay omrim, yachaloku yorshe habbaal im yorshe haav. uvet hillel omrim, nechasim bechezkatan, ketubba bechezkat yorshe habbaal, nechasim hannichnasim veyotzim immah bechezkat yorshe haav: 
Kenasah, hare hi cheishto lechol davar, uvilvad shettehe chetubbatah al nichse valah harishon: 
Mitzva vaggadol leyabbem. lo ratza, mehallechin al kol haachin. lo ratzu, chozrin etzel gadol veomrim lo, alecha mitzva, o chalotz o yabbem: 
Tala vakkatan ad sheyyagdil, o vaggadol ad sheyyavo mimmedinat hayyam, o vacheresh, o vashshote, en shomin lo, ella omrim lo, alecha mitzva, o chalotz o yabbem: 
Hacholetz livimto, hare hu cheechad min haachin lannachala. veim yesh sham av, nechasim shel av. hakkones et yevimto, zacha vannechasim shel achiv. rabbi yehuda omer, ben kach uven kach, im yesh sham av, nechasim shel av. hacholetz livimto, hu asur bikrovoteha, vehi asura vikrovav. hu asur beimmah, uveem immah, uveem aviha, uvevittah, uvevat bittah, uvevat benah, uvaachotah bizman shehi kayyemet. vehaachin muttarin. vehi asura veaviv, uvaavi aviv, uvivno, uveven beno, beachiv, uveven achiv. muttar adam bikrovat tzarat chalutzato, veasur betzarat kerovat chalutzato:
Mishnah Yevamot 4:8-11:
Hacholetz livimto, venasa achiv et achotah, vamet, choletzet velo mityabbemet. vechen hamegaresh et ishto, venasa achiv et achotah, vamet, hare zo petura min hachalitza umin hayyibbum: 
Shomeret yavam shekkiddesh achiv et achotah, mishshum rabbi yehuda ven betera amru, omrim lo, hameten ad sheyyaase achicha haggadol maase. chalatz lah achiv, o chenasah, yichnos et ishto. meta hayyevama, yichnos et ishto. met yavam, yotzi et ishto veget, veeshet achiv bachalitza: 
Hayevama lo tachalotz velo tityabbem, ad sheyyesh lah shelosha chodashim. vechen kol shear hannashim lo yitarsu velo yinnasu, ad sheyyihyu lahen shelosha chodashim. echad betulot veechad beulot, echad gerushot veechad almanot, echad nesuot veechad arusot. rabbi yehuda omer, hannesuot yitarsu, vehaarusot yinnasu, chutz min haarusot shebbihuda, mippene shellibbo gas bah. rabbi yose omer, kol hannashim yitarsu, chutz min haalmana, mippene haibbul: 
Arbaa achin nesuin arba nashim, vametu, im ratza haggadol shebbahem leyabbem et kullan, harshut beyado. mi shehaya nasuy lishte nashim, vamet, biatah o chalitzatah shel achat mehen poteret tzaratah. hayta achat keshera, veachat pesula, im haya choletz, choletz lappesula. veim haya meyabbem, meyabbem lakkeshera:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 6:15-16: Mayim shennistappek lo im naasa mehen melacha o lo naasa. im yesh bahen kashshiur o sheen bahen. im hen tehorin o temein. safek natal yadav safek lo natal yadav. sefeko tahor shekkol safek shebbetohorat yadayim tahor:

Mayim harishonim tzarich sheyyagbiah yadav lemala ad shello yetzu mayim chutz lapperek veyachzeru vitammeu et hayyadayim. veacharonim tzarich sheyyashpil yadav lematta kede sheyyetze kol koach hammelach meal yadav. mayim rishonim nittalim ben al gabbe keli ben al gabbe karka. veacharonim enan nittalin ella al gabbe keli. mayim rishonim nittalin ben bechamme haur ben betzonen. veacharonim enan nittalin bechammin. vehu sheyyihyu chammim shehayyad soledet bahen mippene sheen maavirin et hazzuhama, sheeno yachol leshafshef bahen. aval hayu poshrin notlin mehen baacharona:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 6:17-18: Notel adam yadav shacharit umatne alehen kol hayyom veeno tzarich littol et yadav lechol achila vaachila. vehu shello yassiach dato mehen. aval im hissiach dato mehen tzarich littol yadav bechol et shetztzarich netila:

Lat adam et yadav bemappa veochel bahen pat o davar shettibbulo bemashke af al pi shello natal yadav. hammaachil laacherim eno tzarich netilat yadayim. vehaochel tzarich netilat yadayim af al pi sheacher noten letoch piv veeno nogea bammaachol. vehu haddin leochel bemagrefa shetztzarich netilat yadayim:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 6:19-20: Asur lehaachil mi shello natal yadav veaf al pi shehu noten letoch piv. veasur lezalzel bintilat yadayim. vetziuuyim harebe tziuu chachamim vehizhiru al haddavar. afillu en lo mayim ella kede shetiyya notel yadav bemiktzatan veachar kach ochel veshote miktzatan:

Tzarich adam lenaggev et yadav veachar kach yochal. vechol haochel belo nigguv yadayim keochel lechem tame. vechol hannotel yadav baacharona menaggev veachar kach mevarech. vetechef lintilat yadayim birkat hammazon, lo yafsik benehem bedavar acher. afillu lishtot mayim achar shennotel yadav baacharona asur ad sheyyevarech birkat hammazon:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 7:1-2: Minhagot rabbot nahagu chachme yisrael basseudda vechullan derech eretz. veellu hen. keshennichnasin lasseudda haggadol shebbechullan notel et yadav techilla. veachar kach nichnasin veyoshvin mesubbin. vegadol mesev barosh vesheni lo lematta hemennu. hayu shelosha mittot gadol mesev barosh vesheni lo lemala hemennu ushelishi lo lematta hemennu:

Baal habbayit mevarech hammotzi umashlim habberacha veachar kach botzea. vehaoreach mevarech birkat hammazon kede sheyyevarech levaal habbayit. veim hayu kullan baale habbayit haggadol shebbahen botzea vehu mevarech birkat hammazon:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 7:3-4: En habbotzea rashshay livtzoa ad sheyyaviu melach o liftan lifne kol echad veechad ella im ken nitkavvenu leechol pat chareva. veeno botzea lo perusa ketanna mippene shehu nire ketzar ayin velo perusa gedola yoter mikkevetza mippene shennire kiravtan. uveshabbat yesh lo livtzoa perusa gedola. veeno botzea ella mimmakom shennitbashshel yafe yafe:

Mitzva min hammuvchar livtzoa kikkar shelema. im hayta sham shelema shel seorim uferusa shel chittim manniach shelema betoch perusa uvotzea mishshetehen kede sheyyivtza mechittim umishshelema. beshabbatot uveyamim tovim chayyav livtzoa al shete kikkarot notel shetehen beyado uvotzea achat mehen:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 10:19-21:
Hatztzad davar shedderech mino latzud oto chayyav. kegon chayya veofot vedagim. vehu sheyyatzud otan lemakom sheeno mechussar tzeda. ketzad. kegon sheradaf achare tzevi ad shehichniso levayit o leginna o lechatzer venaal befanav. o shehifriach et haof ad shehichniso lemigdal venaal befanav. o sheshshala dagim min hayyam betoch sefel shel mayim hare ze chayyav. aval im hifriach tzippor levayit venaal befanav. o shehivriach dag vaakaro min hayyam livrecha shel mayim. o sheradaf achar tzevi ad shennichnas litraklin rachav venaal befanav hare ze patur. sheen zo tzida gemura sheim yavo lekachto tzarich lirdof acharav velatzud oto mishsham. lefichach hatztzad ari eno chayyav ad sheyyachnisennu lakkippa shello shehu neesar bah: 
Kol makom sheim yarutz bo yaggia lachayya bishchiyya achat. o shehayu hakketalim kerovin ze laze ad sheyyippol tzel shenehem laemtza keechad hare ze makom katan. veim hivriach hatztzevi vechayyotze bo letocho chayyav. umakom shehu gadol mizze hammavriach chayya vaof letocho patur: 
Echad shemona sheratzim haamurin battora veechad shear shekatzim uremasim sheyyesh leminan tzida hatztzad echad mikkullan ben letzorech ben shello letzorech o lesachek bahen chayyav hoil venitkavven latzud vetzad. shemmelacha sheenah tzericha legufah chayyav aleha. hatztzad et hayyashen veet hassuma chayyav:
Moed Katan 6b:14-7a:3: Gemara may ishut? amar rav yehuda: beriyya sheen lah enayim. amar rava bar yishmael veittema rav yemar bar shelemya: may kera? "kemo shabbelul temes yahaloch nefel eshet bal chazu shamesh".

Tanu rabbanan: tzadin et haishut veet haachbarim missede hallavan umissede hailan kedarko, umachrivin chore nemalim. ketzad machrivin? rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: mevi afar mechor ze venoten letoch chor ze, vehen chonkin ze et ze.
Amar rav yemar bar shelemya mishshemeh deabbaye: vehu dekae bitre evre nahara, vehu delekka gishra, vehu delekka gamla, vehu delekka mitzra.

Rabbi yehuda omer: missede hailan kedarko, umissede hallavan shello kedarko. tanu rabbanan: ketzad kedarko? chofer gumma vetole bah metzuda. ketzad shello kedarko? noetz shappud umakke bekuredom umeradde haadama mittachteha.

Tanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: kesheamru missede lavan shello kedarko, lo amru ella bisde lavan hassemucha lair, aval bisde lavan hassemucha lisde hailan — afillu kedarko, shemma yetzu missede hallavan veyachrivu et hailanot.
Nedarim 20a:10-20b:12: Vachachamim omrim potchin lo petach kulei. tana: leolam al tehi ragil bannedarim, shessofcha limol bishvuot. veal tehi ragil etzel am haaretz, shessofcha lehaachilcha tevalim. al tehi ragil etzel kohen am haaretz, shessofcha lehaachilcha teruma. veal tarbe sicha im haishsha, shessofcha lavo lide niuf.

Rabbi acha berabbi yoshiyya omer: kol hatztzofe benashim, sofo ba lide avera. vechol hammistakkel baakevah shel ishsha, havyin lo banim sheenan mehugganin. amar rav yosef: uveishto nidda. amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: akevah dekatane, bimkom hattinnofet, shehu mechuuon keneged heakev.

Tanya: "baavur tihye yirato al penechem" — zo busha. "levilti techetau" — melammed shehabbusha mevia lide yirat chet. mikkan amru: siman yafe beadam shehu bayyshan. acherim omrim: kol adam hammitbayyesh, lo bimhera hu chote. umi sheen lo boshet panim — beyadua shello amdu avotav al har sinay.

Amar rabbi yochanan ben dahavay, arbaa devarim sachu li malache hashsharet: chiggerin mippene ma havyin — mippene shehofchim et shulechanam. illemim mippene ma havyin — mippene shemmenashshekim al oto makom. chershim mippene ma havyin — mippene shemsapperim bishat tashmish. somin mippene ma havyin — mippene shemmistakkelim beoto makom.
Ureminhu, shaalu et imma shalom: mippene ma

Banayich yefefin beyoter? amra lahen: eno mesapper immi lo bitchillat hallayla, velo besof hallayla, ella bachatzot hallayla. ucheshehu mesapper, megalle tefach umechasse tefach, vedome alav kemi shekkefao shed.
Veamarti lo: ma taam? veamar li: kede shello etten et enay beishsha acheret, venimtzeu banav bain lide mamzerut.
La kashya: ha — bemille detashmish, ha — bemille achranyayta.

Amar rabbi yochanan: zo divre yochanan ben dahavay, aval amru chachamim: en halacha keyochanan ben dahavay, ella kol ma sheadam rotze laasot beishto — ose. mashal levasar habba mibbet hattabbach, ratza leochlo bemelach — ochlo. tzali — ochlo. mevushshal — ochlo. shaluk — ochlo. vechen dag habba mibbet hatztzayyayd.

Amar ammemar: man malache hashsharet — rabbanan, dei tema malache hashsharet mammash, ammay amar rabbi yochanan en halacha keyochanan ben dahavay? ha inhu bekii betzurat havvalad tefe! veammay karu lehu malache hashsharet — dimtzayyeyni kemalache hashsharet.

Hahi daatay lekammeh derabbi, amra lo: rabbi, arachti lo shulechan vahafacho! amar lah: bitti, tora hittiratech, vaani ma eese lich? hahi daatay lekammeh derav, amra lo: rabbi, arachti lo shulechan vahafacho! amar: may shena min binita?
"Velo taturu achare levavchem", mikkan amar rabbi: al yishte adam bechos ze veyitten enav bechos acher. amar ravina: lo nitzrecha, ella daafillu shete nashav.
"Uvaroti mikkem hammordim vehapposhim bi", amar rabbi levi: ellu bene tesha middot, bene osna"400 meshugga"8.
Bene ema, bene anusa, bene senua, bene nidduy, bene temura, bene meriva, bene shichrut, bene gerushat hallev, bene irbuveya, bene chatzufa.

Ini? vehaamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: kol adam sheishto tovato — havyin lo banim sheafillu bedoro shel moshe rabbenu lo hayu kemotam. shenneemar: "havu lachem anashim chachamim unevonim", uchetiv: "vaekkach et rashe shivtechem", vela ketiv "nevonim".
Uchetiv "yissashchar chamor garem", uchetiv: "mibbene yissashchar yode vina laittim"!
Niddah 31b:12-16: Tanya, haya rabbi meir omer: mippene ma amra tora nidda leshiva? mippene sheragil bah vekatz bah. amra tora: "tehe temea shiva yamim", kede shettehe chaviva al balah kishat kenisatah lachuppa.

Shaalu talmidav et rabbi dostay berabbi yannay: mippene ma ish mechazzer al ishsha, veen ishsha mechazzeret al ish? mashal leadam (sheavad) [sheavda] lo aveda — mi mechazzer al mi? baal aveda mechazzer al avedato.
Umippene ma ish panav lematta, veishsha paneha lemala kelappe haish? ze mimmekom shennivra, vezo mimmekom shennivret.
Umippene ma haish mekabbel piyyus, veen ishsha mekabbelet piyyus? ze mimmekom shennivra, vezo mimmekom shennivret.
Mippene ma ishsha kolah arev, veen ish kolo arev? ze mimmekom shennivra, vezo mimmekom shennivret, shenneemar: "ki kolech arev umarech nave".

Zohar, Ha'Azinu 1: (Devarim 32) haazinu hashshamayim vaadabbera vetishma haaretz imre fi, ribbi yehuda patach, (Shir hashshirim 5) patachti ani ledodi vedodi chamak avar vegomer, bikkashtihu velo metzatihu kerativ vela anani. ma ketiv leella. ani yeshena velibbi er vegomer. ani yeshena, amra keneset yisrael. ani yeshena, mippikkude orayyta, bezimna daazilna bemadbera. velibbi er, leaala leara, lemebad lehu (nimusin) deha kol pikkude orayyta beara mishtakkechin. kol dodi dofek, da moshe. deochach lehu leyisrael bechamma vikkuchin, bechamma ketatin. dichtiv, (Devarim 1) elle haddevarim vegomer, (Devarim 9) mamrim heyitem vegomer. (Devarim 9) uvechorev hiktzaftem vegomer. hada hu dichtiv, (Shir hashshirim 5) dofek.

Veim kol da demoshe ochach lehu leyisrael, birchimuta havo kol milloy, dichtiv, (Devarim 7:6) ki am kadosh atta laAdonai elohecha. uvecha bachar Adonai elohecha lihyot lo leam vegomer (Devarim 14:2) banim attem laAdonai elohechem (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai. veal da (Devarim 27:10) veshamata bekol Adonai elohecha. (Devarim 7:8) ki meahavat Adonai etchem. hada hu dichtiv, (Shir hashshirim Adonai:2) pitchi li achoti rayati.

Ma ketiv. (sham) kamti ani liftoach ledodi, amru yisrael beod dahavenan zeminin lemeal leara, ulekabbela innun pikkude orayyta al yedoy demoshe. ma ketiv, (sham) vedodi chamak avar. dichtiv, (Devarim 34:5) vayyamat sham moshe eved Adonai. bikkashtihu velo metzatihu, dichtiv velo kam navi od beyisrael kemoshe. kerativ velo anani, dela hava dara kedara demoshe, dekudesha berich hu shama lekalehon, veavad lehu nissin venimusin, kema deavad al yedoy.

Ribbi yitzchak amar, kamti ani liftoach ledodi, da kudesha berich hu beyomoy demoshe, dechol yomoy la baa demalacha ushelicha ledabbera immeh, dichtiv, (Shemot 33:15) im en panecha holchim vegomer. zakkaa chulakeh demoshe, dekudesha berich hu istecham liruteh. vedodi chamak avar, beyomoy dihoshua, dichtiv, (yehoshua Adonai:14) lo ki ani sar tzeva Adonai.

Ta chaze, moshe hava shama kala kaddisha demalka illaa, vela izdaza, vekol shekken malacha, dela baa (velo kabbeleh). batar deshachiv ma ketiv. vayyomer lo ki ani sar tzeva Adonai. uchetiv (sham) vayyippol yehoshua el panav artza. atta vati, beyomoy demoshe rabbach atena, vela kibbellani. beh shaata, yadu yisrael shevacha demoshe. behahu zimna bau yisrael lekudesha berich hu, vela izdeman lehu hachi keyomoy demoshe, hada hu dichtiv bikkashtihu velo metzatihu vegomer.
Zohar, Ha'Azinu 10: Ribbi elazar patach, (Vayikra 26:44) veaf gam zot bihyotam beeretz oyvehem vegomer. zakkain innun yisrael, al kol ammin ovde kochavim umazzalot, deaf al gav deargizu kame marehon, kudesha berich hu la bae leshavka lon. divchol atar degalu bene ammayya, kudesha berich hu immehon begaluta. hada hu dichtiv veaf gam zot bihyotam beeretz oyvehem vegomer.

Ribbi abba amar, veaf gam zot bihyotam. ta chaze, kama chavivuta dekudesha berich hu legabbehon deyisrael, deaf al gav degarmin lemigle bene ammayya, shechinta la itadiat minnehon lealmin. dela tema deinnun bilchodayyhu begaluta mishtakkechin. ella veaf gam zot immehon mishtakkechin. hada hu dichtiv veaf gam zot bihyotam beeretz oyvehem vegomer.

Lemalka deargiz al bereh, gazar aleh onsha leitrachaka minneh, ulemezal leara rechika. shemaa matronita veamra, hoil uveri azil leara rechika, veshade leh malka mehechaleh, ana la eshbok leh, o tarvavna kachada nituv lehechala demalka o tarvavna kachada netiv beara achara. lezimnin, pakid malka al matronita, la ashkechah. dahavavt azlat im bereh, amar, hoil umatronita tamman, tarvavyyhu yetuvun.

Uvezimna defakid kudesha berich hu lematronita, pakid lah bekadmita, uveginah pakid livnoy. hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 6:Adonai) vegam ani shamati et naakat bene yisrael vegomer. man garim daana shemana akathon. kivyachol, matronita. didcharna lah. hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 6:Adonai) vaezkor et beriti. uchetiv (Shemot 2:24) vayyizkor elohim et berito. vechad kudesha berich hu yehadar leyisrael min galuta, ma ketiv. (Devarim 30:3) veshav Adonai elohecha et shevutecha verichamecha, da matronita. veod ketiv, (Tehillim 85:2) ratzita Adonai artzecha shavta shevut yaakov.

Amar ribbi yehuda, halAdonai tigmelu zot, begin deattun dor ikkesh ufetaltol, attun havetun garmin detigle zot begaluta. halAdonai tigmelu zot. da hu gemul deavid immechon, bechol innun nimusin demitzrayim, bechol innun atvavn deavad lechu, da hu gemul deattun shalmin lehay zot. man garam lechon da. begin deattun am naval velo chacham, vela mistakkelin bechol innun tavan deavad lechu ad hasheta.
Zohar, Vayakhel 18: Uvesifra derav yeva sava, bammincha beshabbeta, ha itar raza dismala, (24 amud alef) unekuda tattaa, behahu sitra dismala, mekabbela raza deorayyta, keden behahi shaata, natla missitra dismala, umiddileh karenan.

Deha ihi kayyeyma beraza detesha, (nusach acher sefiran) vekarenan tesha, veinnun shit dechol, utelat beshaata deittear semala beshabbeta, uleitkalla kolla kachada. veihi mitattera behu, bitlat sitrin, kegavvna ditlat sitrin illain, deinnun kelala defarsheta deshabbeta. zakkaa chulakeh man dezache likara deshabbeta, zakkaa ihu bitren almin, bealma den, uvealma deate.

Ketiv (Shemot 16:29) al yetze ish mimmekomo bayom hashshevii mahu mimmekomo. tanenan, mimmekomo mehahu atar deitchaze limehach. veraza demilla, dichtiv, (yechezkel 3:12) baruch kevod Adonai mimmekomo. veda ihu makom, veda ihu raza dichtiv, (Shemot 3:Adonai) ki hammakom asher atta omed alav. atar yedia ihu leella, vekarenan leh makom, deishtemoda beh yekara illaa dilella. ubbegin kach, azharuta lebar nash deha mitattera beitra kaddisha dilella, dela yippok minneh dei (yippuk mippumeh maylavelaa dechol) yippok mineh, ka mechallel shabbeta. bidoy, baavidta. kema deokimna. beragloy, lemehach levar mittere alfin ammin, kol illen chillula deshabbeta ihu.

Al yetze ish mimmekomo, da ihu atar yekara dikdushsha da, deha minneh levar, atar deelohim acherim ihu. baruch kevod Adonai mimmekomo. kevod Adonai (Bereshit 25 amud alef) dilella. mimmekomo, da kevod diltatta veda ihu raza daattara deshabbeta, begin kach al yetze ish mimmekomo, berich hu lealam ulealme almin.

Ketiv (Shemot 33:21) hinne makom itti, makom itti, vadday da ihu makom tamir veganiz, dela ityeyda kelal. mashma dichtiv itti, atar dela itgalya, vekayyeyma temira, veda ihu atar illaa leella leella, hechala illaa tamir veganiz. aval da, ihu atar letatta kidkaamran. veda ihu makom deitperash leella, veitperash letatta, ubbegin kach al yetze ish mimmekomo bayom hashshevii.

(Bamidbar 35:5) umadotem michutz lair et peat kedma alpayim baamma vegomer, (209) ha ukemuha beinnun razin illain. aval alpayim baamma, deyarta teren (hakedama Adonai amud alef) sitrin lechol setar, veihi mitattera tadir bitren sitrin, ben leella ben letatta. vesimanich shechina la sharya levar mittechuma deitchaze lah.

Kad nafak shabbeta, tzerichin yisrael diltatta, leakava, deha yoma rabba illaa ihu. (itzterich leitakkava aleh) uvehay yoma, ushepiza rabba veyakkira, ka sharya aleh, begin kach bae leitakkeva, leitchazaa dela dachakin beushepiza kaddisha. keden patche yisrael veamre, (Tehillim 78:38) vehu rachum yechapper avon vegomer, detikkuna shappira ihu behay lelya, kevan dedina ithaddar leatreh, ma dela itchaze kad ayiyil shabbeta, dedina istallak, vela ishtechach.

Beshaata defatche yisrael vayhi noam, ukedushata desidra, kol innun chayyayvin degehinnam, patchin veamri, zakkain attun yisrael amma kaddisha, zakkain attun tzaddikayyay, denatre pikkude orayyta. vavy lon lechayyayvayya, dela zachu lemetar orayyta, keden 55 kadim, vecharoza ittear veamar, (Tehillim 9:18) yashuvu reshaim lishola kol goyim shecheche elohim. vechol illen chavile tehirin, tardin lon begehinnam, velet man dimrachem alehon. zakkain innun kol natre shabbeta behay alma, veka meannege lehahu ong desharya milleella, kidkaamran.

Hay man deshare betaanita beshabbeta, tere mitare aleh kamme malka kaddisha. chad, hahu rucha illaa kaddisha deitzterich leitannega, vela itannag. vechad, hahu memana dekayyeyma al man deshare betaanita, vesangaryah shemeh. vesallekin kame malka kaddisha, umitare aleh.

Vehahu rucha istallak geria mehahu ithanuta diltatta. vechad hay rucha la ishtelim letatta, rucha achara dilella la ishtelim. kevan dela ishtelim letatta uleella, keden itchaze hahu bar nash leitlatteya, uleitannesha. ella kevan deishtelim zimna achara, vehahu memana deitmana al innuyyay vetaanita, ishtelim go innun memanan acharanin, beinnuga dilella, korin leh kol gezar dina, deitgezar meinnun shivin shenin illain.
Lemalka dechadde behillula dileh, vechol bene nasha chaddan immeh, chama chad bar nash yahiv bekolar, pakid aloy, vesharyyuhu. begin deyishtakkechun kolla bechedva.

Ulevatar, mithadderin illen memanan deanshin livne nasha, veitparin minneh debar nash, al deishtechach begineh geriuta ella vetatta. may takkanteh. letiv taanita al taanita. may taama. da battil innuga deshabbeta, yevattel innuga dechol.

Vei ihu mevattel innuga deshabbeta, veka mitanneg bachol, dame keman dechashav lemilla achara, yattir mimma dechashiv leh lekudesha berich hu. rucha illaa, kaddisha dekudeshin desharya aleh, la anig, uvattil leh minneh. rucha achara dechol, desharya levatar al alma, chashiv veka meanga leh. keden mehadderin umitparin minneh, behay alma, uvealma deate.

Begin kach, itzterich taanita acharina, beyoma kadmaa dechol, bezimna desharya al alma hahu rucha dechol. uvehay it leh asvavta, kevan dela chashiv lerucha dechol. vesimanich (Vayikra Adonai:23) veheshiv et haggezela asher gazal vegomer. gazlan, la chashiv lekudesha berich hu, la chashiv livni nasha, begin kach let leh onsha kaggannav. gannav, dechashiv livni nasha, yattir mekudesha berich hu, it leh onsha behay alma, uvealma deate. zakkaa ihu, man deishtelim letatta, lehahu oneg illaa kadka chaze.
Yoma da, mitattera beshivin itrin, ushema illaa (88 amud bet) kaddisha, ishtelim vechol sitrin, veitnehiru kullehu dargin, vecholla bechedva devirkan, uvikdushsha al kedusha, vetosefet dikdushsha.

Kidusha demaale shabbeta, da ihi kedushsha deshabbat bereshit. deha itkaddash mittelatin uteren shevilin, utelat dargin detappuchin (vaychi 249 amud bet) kaddishin. uvaenan leadkera al hay kidusha, kelala deovada divreshit, venayycha beraza ditlatin uteren shevilin, utelat dargin deitkelilan behu, raza desahaduta deovada divreshit, dehayynu (Bereshit 2:1-2) vaychullu hashshamayim vehaaretz vechol tzevaam vegomer. vaychal elohim, deit besahaduta da, telatin (hakedama Adonai amud bet) vachamesh tevin. telatin uteren shevilin, utelat dargin detappuchin kaddishin.

Telat dargin, deinnun: shevii. shevii. shevii. veit beh raza dealma illaa, veraza dealma tattaa, veraza dechol mehemnuta. telat zimnin elohim, chad, alma tattaa. vechad, pachad yitzchak. vechad, alma illaa kaddisha, kodesh kudeshin. bae bar nash lemishad sahaduta da, bechedva, biruta delibba, leashada kamme mareh dimhemnuta. vechol man deyashid da, veyishave libbeh ureuteh leda, mechapper al kol chovoy.

Barucha atta Adonai elokenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav veratza vanu vechulei, hay kiddusha ihu bechad matkela, lokovel sahaduta dimhemnuta, veinnun telatin vachamesh tevin acharanin, kama deit bevaychullu. kolla sallekin leshivin tevin, (132 amud bet) leitattera behu shabbat, demaale shabbeta. zakkaa chulakeh devar nash, diyyechavvevn reuteh lemillin illen, likara demareh.

Kiddusha deyoma, ha ukemuha bore peri haggefen, vela yattir. deha yoma kaim lekaddesha leh, ma delet hachi belelya, deanan tzerichin lekaddesha leh, behani millin, kema deokimna. vela itkaddash hay lelya, ella beamma kaddisha letatta, kad sharya alayyhu hahu rucha illaa. vaanan baenan lekaddesha leh biruta delibba, lechavvevna data lehay.
Veyoma ihu ka mekaddesha leh. veyisrael mekaddeshe bitzlotin uvautin, umitkadshin bikdushateh, behay yoma. zakkain yisrael, amma kaddisha, deachasinu yoma da, achasanat yeruta lealmin.
Zohar, Vayeilech 3: Ribbi shimon patach, (Yeshayahu 24:16) mikkenaf haaretz zemirot shamanu tzevi latztzaddik vegomer, vavy lon livne nasha, leinnun dela mashgichin vela mishtaddelin bikara demarehon, vela mistakkelin bikdushsha (bikdushsha) illaa, leitkaddesha behay alma, lemeheve kaddishin bealma deate. mikkenaf haaretz, da (96 amud alef, 142) kesuta illaa kaddisha. zemirot shamanu, kema deat amer (iyyov 35:10) noten zemirot ballayla, zemirot tushebchan dichneset yisrael, kamme kudesha berich hu ballayla. ballayla, bezimna deihi izdammena (dekudesha berich hu) (sefer acher azedavevagea dishchicha) ushechicha leshabbecha leh lekudesha berich hu (ballayla, bezimna deihi azedavevagea) (izdavvevgat) umishtaasha im tzaddikayyay beginta deeden.

Veematay. mippalgut lelya veelach. ucheden zemirot shamanu (ballayla), tushebchan. uzemirot, kema deat amer (Vayikra 25) lo tizmor. uchetiv (yeshaya koach) zemir aritzim yaane, akeruta meatrayyhu kol innun takkifin, deha kad ayyil lelya, kama aritzim gardine nimusin shechichin bealma, azlin veshayytan (veshatyayn) bealma lekatrega. mippalgut lelya veelach, ittear rucha chada veakar lechullehu meatrayyhu, veabar lon dela yishletun. zemirot shamanu, tushebchan dichneset yisrael belelya, vechol da lamma. tzevi latztzaddik, leizdavvevga beziuuga chada (lekudesha) dekudesha berich hu, uleitkaddesha bikdushsha chada.

Veomer razi li razi li, da hu raza illaa. da hu ruach kaddisha, aval oy li al dara, veal alma. bogdim bagadu, dechullehu meshakkeran beh. meshakkeran behu begarmayyhu, vela day dimshakkeran begarmayyhu (mammash), ella innun benin deolidu mitshakkeran behahu shikra dilhon, veishtechachu pegimin leella vetatta.

Kevan deistakkal yeshayahu behay, kanish leinnun dachalin chattaa, veolif lon orach kaddisha leitkaddesha bikdushsha demalka, uleishtakkecha benayyhu kaddishin. kevan deitkedashu illen, innun benin deolidu ikrun al shemeh. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 8:18) hinne anochi vehayeladim asher natan li Adonai leotot ulemoftim beyisrael, difrishan mishshear ammin.

Davar acher mikkenaf haaretz zemirot shamanu, beshaata dealu yisrael leara, vaaron kayyeyma kaddisha kammayyhu, shamu yisrael demistera chad deara, tushebchan vechedu vekal mezammere illae, dimzammere beara. keden tzevi latztzaddik, tushebcha demoshe hava behahi shaata. divchol atar dearon hava share beara, havo shame kala deamre, (Devarim 4:44) vezot hattora asher sam moshe lifne bene yisrael. aval oy li devogdim bagadu, dizminin yisrael leshakkera bekudesha berich hu, uleitakkera meara zimna chada. uvegin deitachadu benayyhu shikra dilhon, yitakkerun zimna tinyayna, ad deyishtelim chovayyhu beara achara.
Zohar, Vayeilech 7: Amar ribbi yehuda, uvozay yekallu, man dela yada leokir lemareh, vela itkavvavn beamen, detanenan gadol haone amen yoter min hammevarech. veha okimna kammeh derabbi shimon, deamen, mashich birchan mimmabbua lemalka, umimmalka lematronita (da keneset yisrael). uveatvavn gelifin deribbi elazar, mealef lemem, umimmem lenun. kevan dematu birchan lenun, mittamman nagdin venafkin birchan leillae vetattae, umitpashshete becholla. vekala nafik itshakyu mishshakiuta devirchan, deappik pelanya avda demalka kaddisha.

Vechad yisrael letatta, meshammerin leatava amen, lechavvevna libbayyhu kema deitzterich, kama pitchin devirkan petichan leh leella, kama tavan mishtakkechin bechullehu almin, kama chedu becholla. may agar lehu leyisrael degarmin hay. agar lehu bealma den, uvealma deate. bealma den beshaata deakin lehu (leyisrael), umetzallan tzelota kamme marehon, kala machreza bechullehu almin, (Yeshayahu 26:2) pitchu shearim veyavo goy tzaddik shomer emunim al tikre emunim, ella amenim. pitchu shearim, kema deyisrael patchin lehu tarin devirkan, kach hasheta pitchu shearim, vetitkabbel tzelothon meinnun deakin lehu.

Hay bealma den, bealma deate may agrayyhu. dechad yippuk bar nash mehay alma, dehava shomer leatava amen. may shomer. kelomar, natir hahi beracha deamar hahu dimvarech, umechakke leh leatava amen, kema deitzterich. nishmateh salleka umachreze kammeh, pitchu shearim kammeh, kema deihu hava patach tarin kol yoma, kad hava shomer emunim.

Amar ribbi yose amar ribbi yehuda, may amen. amar ribbi abba, ha ukemuha kolla, amen ikre mabbua dehahu nachala denagid, amen ikre, dichtiv, (Mishlei 8:30) vaehye etzlo amon, al tikre amon, ella amen. kiyyuma dechullehu hahu nachala (sefer acher talla) denagid venafik, amen ikre. detanya, (Tehillim 106:48) min haolam vead haolam, olam dilella, olam diltatta. uf hacha amen veamen, amen dilella, amen diltatta. amen kiuma dechullehu, veha okimna amen beinnun atvavn.

Ribbi shimon amar, alef amika devera dechol birchan mittamman navin venafkin, umishtachchin. mem petucha, nahara denagid venafik, veikre mem. vehu raza detanenan, mem petucha, mem setuma. kema deokimna, (yeshaya 9) lemarbe hammisra.

Nun peshuta, kelala ditren nunin, nun peshuta, nun kefufa. nun peshuta kelala deat vav, kelala denun kefufa (sefer acher peshuta). (sefer acher mem petucha, kelala ditren nunin, nun peshuta, nun kefufa. nun peshuta kelala deat vav) begin kach kolla ikre nun vav nun. uveraza dematnita hachi tana, 6 dechar, 50 peshuta kelala didchar venukeba, nun kefufa, bichlala difshuta hi. uvesifra derav hamenuna sava, mem dehacha, hi notarikon melech, vehayeynu amen, amen notarikon, el melech neeman. kelala decholla, veshappir hu, veha ittemar.

Tana, kol man deshama beracha mehahu dimvarech, vela itkevavn beamen, aleh neemar uvozay yekallu. kema deat amer, (Malachi 1:6) lachem hakkohanim boze shemi. may onsheh. kema dela patach birchan leella, kach la patchin leh. velo od ella kad nafik mehay alma, machrize kammeh, veamre, teruku gale kammeh diflanyay, vela liul, vela tekabbelun leh, vavy leh, vavy lenishmateh.
Zohar, Vayeilech 8: Tana, chayyayve degehinnam, kullehu salke bimdorin yedian, vechamma pitchin it leh lagehinnam, vechullehu pitchin lokovel pitchin degan eden. uveshaata deafke leinnun chayyayvayya dekabbilu onshayyhu, innun patche petichin, veshavveyayn (sefer acher vasheabeyn) lon levar. vechullehu pitchin bishmahan ikrun, lokovlehon defitchin degan eden, vechol pitcha ufitcha, ikre shema, lokovle hahu pitcha degehinnam, veishtemodan pitchin lokovlehon pitchin, innun pitchin degan eden.

Bagehinnam it madora batraa tattaa dechullehu, vehahu madora have madora al madora, veikkere (iyyov 10:22) eretz efata. mahu efata. kema deat amer (Shemot 28:16) ravua yihye kaful, umetargeminan merubba yihye if, uf hacha efata, kelomar kefula. vehahu ikre sheol tachtit, sheol hu madora chad. tachtit, hu madora tattaa. uvegin kach ikre eretz efata tachtit, veikre avaddon. veal da ketiv, (Mishlei 27) sheol vaavaddon. vechullehu madorin la achpalu, vechullehu la ayyfin bar mehay.

Vetana, man denachit laavaddon deikre tachtit, la salik lealmin. vehahu ikre gever deishtetze veitavid mikkullehu almin. vetana, lehahu atar nachtin lehanehu gavre dimvazze leatava amen, veal amen saggiin deitavidu minneh, dela chashiv lehu, dayynin leh bagehinnam, venachtin leh behahu madora tattaa, delet bah pitcha, veitavid vela salik minneh lealmin. veal da ketiv, (iyyov 7:9-10) kala anan vayyelach ken yored sheol la yaale. vela, veha ketiv (Yona 2:3) mibbeten sheol shivvati shamata vegomer. uchetiv (Shmuel 1 2:6) morid sheol vayyaal. ella hacha sheol, hatam tachtit. veokimna ha deahdar beh, ha dela ahdar beh.

Amar ribbi yose, may dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 2:13) ki shetayim raot asa ammi oti azvu mekor mayim chayyim lachtzov lahem borot vegomer. oti azvu mekor mayim chayyim, da hu dela bae lekaddesha shema dekudesha berich hu, beamen. may onsheh. ketiv lachtzov lahem borot borot nishbarim, denachtin laggehinnam darga batar darga, ad denachtin laavaddon deikre tachtit. vei ihu kaddish shema dekudesha berich hu, lechavvevna beamen kaddeka yaut, salik darga batar darga, leitaddena mehahu alma deate, denagid tadir la pasik, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 31:24) emunim notzer Adonai umeshallem al yeter ose gaava.

rashi: Kuma Adonai. david haya mitpallel lifne hakkadosh baruch hu, sheyyakum vimaher laasot zot:
Al yaoz. amalek leorech yamim bigdullato:
Al panecha. bishvil hakkaas shehichisucha bemikdashecha:
targum: Kum Adonai la yitashan bar nasha rashia yitdanun ammaya kodamach:

rashi: Meze raav. unkelos tirgem "nefiche chafan", veen li ed mochiach alav, umishshemo shel rabbi moshe haddarshan mittulusa shamati seire raav — adam kachush megaddel sear al besaro:
Meze. leshon arammi sear — mizayya, "dahava mehappech bemizayya" (Megila 18):
Ulechume reshef. hashshedim nilchamu vahem, shenneemar "uvene reshef yagbihu uf" (Iyov Adonai), vehem shedim:
Veketev meriri. ucheritut shed sheshshemo meriri, katev kerita, kemo "ehi katavcha sheol" (Hoshea 13):
Veshen behemot. maase haya vehayu harchelim noshchin umemitin (sifre):

Chamat zochale afar. eres nechashim hamehallechim al gechonam al heafar kammayim hazzochalim al haaretz; zechila leshon merutzat hammayim al heafar vechen kol merutzat davar hameshafshef al heafar veholech:

Lishola. amar rabbi nechemya (yevamot 13:): kol teva hatztzericha lamed bitchillatah, hittil lah hei besofah, kegon "mitzrayma"(Bereshit 12:10) "midbara" (Melachim 1 19:15). hetivun leh: vehachtiv yashuvu reshaim lishola? amar rabbi abba bar zavdi: lammadrega hattachtona shel sheol. umahu yashuvu? leachar sheyyetzu miggehinnom veyaamdu vaddin veyitchayyevu, yashuvu lammadrega tachtit shel gehinnom:
targum: Yetuvun rashie lishyol kulehon ammaya deashliu dechalta daAdonai:

rashi: Kaddonag namassu. dichtiv "venehersu heharim venaflu hammadregot" (Yechezkel 38:20):
Kaddonag. keshaava:
targum: Turaya hech shaava yitmesun min kodam Adonai min kodam ribbon kol ara:

rashi: Vaomar challoti hi. machashavti omeret ki en zot ella lehachaloti uleyareni lashuv elav:
Challoti. kemo lechalloti, leshon choli vechil:
Shenot yemin elyon. et asher nishtannet yemin elyon, shehayta nedari bakkoach roetzet oyev (Shemot 15:6), veachshav heshiv achor yemino (Eicha 2:3):
targum: Vaamaret maruti hu ishteniu gevurat yemin ilaa (vaamaret bauti hu shenin deketz miyamin):

rashi: Hu vehoshea bin nun. shabbat shel deyozgi hayta, nittela reshut mizze venittena laze, heemid lo moshe meturgeman lihoshua sheyyehe doresh bechayyav, kede shello yomru yisrael bechayye rabbecha lo haya lecha leharim rosh; velamma korehu kan hoshea? lomar shello zacha dato alav sheaappi shennittena lo gedulla hishpil atzmo kaasher mittechillato (80 sifre):
ohc: Hu vehoshea bin nun. perush, haya omed immo, aval haddibbur lo dibber ella moshe keamro "vaydabber", vechen amar Adonai "velammedah et bene yisrael simah befihem" leshon yachid el moshe. veamro "vehoshea" velo amar "vihoshua" kemo shekkara lo moshe, lefi shettosefet hayyod hi likar ugedulla karamuz bemaamar (Bamidbar 13:16) "vayyikra moshe lehoshea" vegomer, ucheshehishvam hakkatuv veamar "hu vehoshea bin nun" hesir hayyod, al derech amro (Yeshayahu 10:15) "hayitpaer haggarzen" vegomer:

rashi: Ki miggefen sedom gafnam. musav lemala — amarti belibbi afehem veashbit zichram lefi shemmaasehem maase sedom vaamora:
Shademat. sede tevua, kemo "ushedemot lo asa ochel" (Chavakuk 3), "beshadmot kidron" (Melachim 2 23):
Inneve rosh. esev mar:
Ashkelot merorot lamo. mashke mar rauy lahem, lefi maasehem puranutam, vechen tirgem unkelos "vetushelamat ovadehon kimrarutehon":
ohc: Ki miggefen vegomer. perush, noten taam limchiratam ulehakkodem lah "amarti afehem". veamro "miggefen" – kevar hodati ki davar shebbikdushsha yesh kenegdo bassitra ochora, keamro (Kohelet 7:14) "gam et ze leummat ze asa" vegomer, veyisrael nimshelu legefen (Bereshit Rabba 99,8) dichtiv (tehillim 80:9) "gefen mimmitzrayim tassia", uchenegdam keshehirshiu amar "miggefen sedom", vegefen hi ilan hara shel achizat harshaim, kemo sheggamar omer "anavemo inneve rosh" vegomer, ulefi sheenam ella ochazim bah veen kol anpam mimmenna, laze amar "miggefen" velo amar "ki gefen sedom gafnam", uvachar mikkol dome hara sedom, lefi shennitmallea seatam kisdom.

Veamro "umishshadmot amora", ki kemo shebbeanfe ilan hakkadosh yesh gader lemala miggader, vehaelyon yityaches elav shem zachar lihyoto mashpia, vehattachton yityaches elav shem nekeva lihyoto nishpa, kemo chen himshil achizot besharsho hara lishne gedarim: gader harishon yikkare gefen, vegader sheni nikra sade, vehammaskil yavin bedugematam bakkedushsha veyeoru enav:

rashi: Halo hu kamus immadi. ketargumo, kisvurim hem sheshshachachti maasehem, kullam genuzim ushemurim lefanay:
Halo hu. peri gafnam utevuat shadmotam — kamus immadi:
ohc: Halo hu kamus immadi vegomer. perush, hagam shebbishvil kaas oyev nimnati measot bahem mishpat hammitchayyev lahem al maasehem, lo mippene ze yippatru meonesh hammaggia lahem, halo hu kamus immadi chatum beotzrotay leyom haddin. veal ze amar hannavi (Yeshayahu 10:3) "uma taasu leyom pekudda", vetze ulemad ma shecharad shemuel mippachad yom haddin, keamram zichronam livracha (chagiga 4:) bemaase baalat ov. vechafal lomar "kamus immadi chatum" vegomer, al derech amro (Shemot 34:7) "nose avon", uchesheyyaggia legader sheyyomar "nileti neso" (Yeshayahu 1:14) yachtemehu baotzarot veyinkom hu meose risha behotzaat shemesh minnartikah (nedarim 8:) velihat otam yom Adonai, vehu amro "li nakam" perush sheyyinkom hu beatzmo kivyachol:

rashi: Al asher mealtem bi. geramtem limol bi:

Al asher lo kiddashtem oti. geramtem li shello etkaddesh, amarti lachem "vedibbartem el hassela" (Bamidbar 20) vehem hikkuhu vehutzrechu lehakkoto faamayim, veillu dibberu immo venatan memav belo hakkaa, haya mitkaddesh shem shamayim, shehayu yisrael omrim uma hassela sheeno lesachar velo lefuranut, im zacha en lo mattan sachar veim chata eno loke, kach mekayyem mitzvat boro, anu lo kol shekken:
ohc: Al asher mealtem vegomer al asher lo kiddashtem vegomer. ayyen ma shepperashti befarashat chukkat (Bamidbar 20:12) beinyan ze beorech.

rashi: Afafuni. hikkifuni:
Mishbere mavet. ketargumo: "keitta deyatva al matbera", ken shem moshav haavanim shehaishsha yoledet sham:
Nachale. geyasot shotfot kenachal:
targum: Are akefatni aka keitta deyatva al matbera vechela let lah lemelad vehi mesakkena limmat siat chayavin baatat yati:

rashi: Chevle. ketargumo: "mashrit", kemo (Shmuel 1 10:5): "chevel neviim":
Kiddemuni. bau lefanay:
targum: Mashiryat rashiin akfuni kadmuni dimzaynin bemane ketol:

rashi: Ki minneged. merachok:
Tire vegomer. im lo tirenna achshav, lo tirenna od bechayyecha, al ken ani omer lecha ale uree:
Veshamma lo tavo. veyadati ki chaviva hi lecha, al ken ani omer lecha ale uree:
ohc: Ki minneged tire vegomer. perush al derech amro (Devarim 34:1) "vayyarehu Adonai et kol haaretz", veayyen ma shepperashti sham.

Veshamma lo tavo el haaretz vegomer. kashe, achar sheamar "veshamma lo tavo", ma makom lachzor velomar "el haaretz" vegomer? veyitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (Devarim Rabba 2,9) sheatid moshe likkanes laaretz im haavot leatid lavo, veamru bazzohar (chelek 2 120.) ki hu yavi et yisrael el haaretz bevo geullatam. velaze kesheamar Adonai "veshamma lo tavo" chash sheyyihyu haddevarim nishmaim shemmachlit lo biat haaretz leolam vaed, laze amar "el haaretz asher ani noten" vegomer perush, atta, velo el asher yitten leatid. veayyen ma shepperashti befasuk (Devarim 3,25) "ebera na".
Chassalat parashat haazinu

rashi: Ki lo lanetzach yishshachach. yisrael haevyon millifkod alehem ma sheshshibedu vo, vtikvat aniyyim lo tovad laad:
targum: Mitul dela lealmaya mishtele chashocha sovara deinvetani la tehoved lealma:

rashi: Yishu veen moshia vegomer. hare ze mikra mesoras, yishu el Adonai velo anam, veen moshia, kemo (Yeshayahu 17:7): "yishe haadam el osehu", kemo yifne. umenachem chibbero im (Bereshit 4:4): "vayyisha Adonai el hevel", ufatar bo leshon atira, venofel hallashon al hammatir veal hannetar, kemo (Bereshit 25:21): "vayyetar yitzchak laAdonai", "vayyeater lo Adonai", af kan "yishu veen moshia" nofel al hammitpallel, vayyisha Adonai nofel al hallashon, al mi shemmitpallelin lefanav:
targum: Baan said velet lehon parik metzalan kodam Adonai vela mekabbel tzelothon:

rashi: Vayyatter tamim darki. mikkol michshol, umikkol chet, umikkol mesukkan, ad ki haya shalem vechavush:
targum: Elaha desaid li bechela umetakan shelim orchi:

rashi: Im shannoti berak charbi. im ashannen et lahav charbi lemaan heyot lah barak, shapelanedaver:

Vetochez bemishpat yadi. lehanniach middat rachamim meoyvay shehereu lachem "asher ani katzafti meat vehemma azru leraa" (Zecharya 1 15), vetochez yadi et middat hammishpat lehachazik bah velinkom nakam:

Ashiv nakam vegomer. lamdu rabbotenu baaggada mittoch leshon hammikra sheamar vetochez bemishpat yadi — lo chemiddat basar vadam middat hakkabba, middat basar vadam zorek chetz veeno yachol lahashivo, vehakkabba zorek chitztzav veyesh beyado lahashivam keillu ochazan beyado, shehare varak hu chitztzo shenneemar kan berak charbi vetochez bemishpat yadi, vehammishpat hazze leshon puranut hu, velaaz 426:
Ki amtzu. kaasher amtzu:
targum: Shezvani misanay are takfani mibbaale devave are itgabbaru alay:

rashi: Yavinu leacharitam. yittenu lev lehitbonen lesof puranutam shel yisrael:

Kaasher met aharon achicha. beotah mita sheraita vechamadta otah, shehifshit moshe et aharon beged rishon vehilbisho leelazar vechen sheni vechen shelishi veraa beno bichvodo, amar lo moshe, aharon achi ale lammitta veala, peshot yadcha ufashat, peshot raglecha ufashat, atzom enecha veatzam, kemotz picha vekamatz, vehalach lo. amar moshe — ashre mi shemmet bemita zo (sifre):
ohc: Umut bahar. perush, hitratztze lamut, sheen hakkadosh baruch hu lokeach nafshot chasidav ella lirtzonam. veamro "veheasef el ammecha" al derech amram (ketuvot 104.) sheyyotzim hatztzaddikim lehakebil pene tzaddik, velaze amar Adonai elav sheyyeasef el ammav habbaim likrato.

Od yitbaer al ze hadderech, ki va latet shelosha teamim lemitat ish haelohim. veze shiur hakkatuv "umut", vehattaam "bahar" – perush al derech amram zichronam livracha (sota yad.) lamma nikbar moshe behar nevo, bishvil avon peor, ki bechol zeman sheyyizkof rosho peor yimtza kenegdo moshe venichna, ucheamro (Devarim 34,6) "vayyikbor oto baggay mul bet peor". taam sheni – "asher atta ole shamma", perush kede sheyyuchal lehassig haosher shehissig beemtzaut maasim tovim hannoraim, ma sheen yachol lehassig beodo meshuttaf im hagguf sheeno yachol lehassig hammaala hahi, vehu amro "asher atta ole shamma" – perush baolam haelyon. shelishi – "veheasef el ammecha" al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 19), bappasuk (Devarim 33,21) "vayyete rashe am" vegomer, shebbeemtzaut moshe yizku dor hammidbar, vehem mityachasim elav keamro (Shemot 32,7) "red ki shichet ammecha", vehu amro "veheasef el" – perush lesibbat ammecha lahaviam laolam habba. vahagam shebbeaharon matzinu sheamar ken gam ken (Devarim la,29) "vayyeasef el ammav", bemakom sheyyesh lidrosh dorshin.

rashi: Asher sam shammot. asher sam artzot haggoyim shemama:
targum: Ezilun chamon ovadaya dayya deshave tzadyan verishe ara:

rashi: Ki lo davar rek hu mikkem. lo lechinnam attem yegeim bah, ki harebe sachar taluy bah, ki hu chayyechem; davar acher — en lecha davar rekan battora sheim tidreshennu sheen bo mattan sachar, teda lecha shekken amru chachamim "vaachot lotan timna" (Bereshit 36) "vetimna hayta filegesh vegomer", lefi sheamra eni cheday lihyot lo ishsha halevay veehye filagsho, vechol kach lamma? lehodia shivcho shel avraham shehayu shiltonim umelachim mitavvim liddabbek bezaro (sifre):
