Vaydabber Adonai el moshe beetzem hayyom hazze. bishlosha mekomot neemar beetzem hayyom hazze, neemar benoach "beetzem hayyom hazze ba noach vegomer" (Bereshit 7) — bemarit oro shel yom, lefi shehayu vene doro omrim bechach vechach im anu margishin bo, en anu mannichin oto likkanes batteva, velo od ella anu notlin kashshilin vekardummot umevakkein et hatteva, amar hakkabba hareni machniso bachatzi hayyom vechol mi sheyyesh beyado choach limchot yavo veyimche; bemitzrayim neemar "beetzem hayyom hazze hotzi Adonai" (Shemot 12), lefi shehayu mitzriyyim omrim bechach vechach im anu margishin bahem, en anu mannichin otam latzet, velo od ella anu notlin seyafot uchele zayin vehorgin bahem, amar hakkabba hareni motzian bachatzi hayyom vechol mi sheyyesh bo choach limchot yavo veyimche; af kan bemitato shel moshe neemar "beetzem hayyom hazze", lefi shehayu yisrael omrim bechach vechach im anu margishin bo — en anu mannichin oto, adam shehotzianu mimmitzrayim vekara lanu et hayyam vehorid lanu et hamman vehegiz lanu et hasselav veheela lanu et habbeer venatan lanu et hattora, en anu mannichin oto, amar hakkabba hareni machniso vachatzi hayyom vechulei (sifre):
ohc: Beetzem hayyom hazze lemor. amro "lemor", sheyyomar lahem leyisrael shehu ole lamut, veze mechuvvan ledivrehem zichronam livracha sheddarshu (sifre) beamro "beetzem hayyom hazze" lefi shehayu yisrael omrim vechulei yeuyyan sham devarav:

rashi: Reu atta. havinu min happuranut shehevi alechem veen lachem moshia, umin hatteshua sheoshiachem veen moche veyadi:
Ani ani hu. ani lehashepil vaani leharim:
Veen elohim immadi. omed kenegdi limchot:
Immadi. dugmati vechamoni:
Veen miyyadi matztzil. happoshim bi:
ohc: Reu atta ki ani ani hu vegomer. kafal lomar shete peamim "ani ani" keneged shete tauyyot shel avoda zara sheramaznu bappasuk shellifne ze, laze amar "ani" – perush velo acher sheattem choshvim bo leeloah gamur, ucheneged avoda zara sheosim leemtzai amar "ani hu" – perush levaddi, vegamar omer "veen elohim immadi" – emtzai beni leven hannivraim.

Ani amit vaachayye. ze keneged kat haomrim sheppoel hara eno poel hattov ushete yecholot yesh, laze amar "ani amit vaachayye", velo bifrat ze bilvad ella afillu bifrate poole hara "ani machatzti vaani erpa". verabbotenu zichronam livracha darshu (fesachim sach.) yeuyyan sham divrehem.
Veen miyyadi matztzil. perush, shekkol hannivraim yamutu, velaze diyyek lomar "veen miyyadi" velo amar "veen matztzil miyyadi".

rashi: Mashbit milchamot. mealenu:
Ad ketze haaretz. shekkol artzot haggoyim yihyu immanu beshalom:
Keshet. haggoyim yeshabber:
Agalot yisrof baesh. richve milchamot:
targum: Yevatel kerava ad seyafe ara kashta yetabbar veyitra murenita teresaya agilin yokid benura:

rashi: Vayyashet choshech sevivotav. lesukka, kainyan shenneemar (Shemot 14:20): "vayhi heanan vehachoshech", mafsik ben mitzrayim leyisrael:
Chashrat mayim ave shechakim. meayin haya hachoshech, ave shechakim hayu, shehen choshrin mayim al haaretz:

Chashrat. leshon kevara hu, shehu nofel al haaretz dak dak (taanit 9 2), vechen hu omer beaggadot harebe: choshrin oto bichvara. veyesh liftor 'chashrat, leshon 'kesher, shemmitkashsherin hashshamayim beavim al yede hammayim, kemo 'vechishshurehem haamur beofanne hammechona (Melachim 1 7:33), shehem zeroot haetz hamehaddekin vekoshrin igguleha yachad:
targum: Veashre shechinteh baarafela vaanan yekar sechor sechor leh machit miyin takifin merichpat ananin kalilin berum alma:

rashi: Venichat keshet nechusha zerootay. venidrecha keshet nechusha al zeroi, sheyyesh bi koach ledarchah. keshatot hayu teluyim ledavid beveto, vehayu malche haummot bain veroin otan, veomrim ze laze: atta savur shehu yachol ledarchan, en ze ella leyarenu, vedavid shomea venotlan umechattetan lifnehem. uderichat keshet leshon chayyit hi, vechen "tehillim chitztzecha nichtu vi":
targum: Malef yede lemebad kerava umatkef vekeshet nechasha dari:

rashi: Simu levavchem. tzarich adam sheyyihyu enav velibbo veaznav mechuvvanim ledivre tora, vechen hu omer "ben adam ree veenecha uveaznecha shema vesim libbecha" (Yechezkel 40); vahare devarim kal vachomer uma tavnit habbayit shehu nire laenayim venimdad bekane tzarich adam sheyyihyu enav veaznav velibbo mechuvvanin, lehavin divre tora shehen kahararin teluyin bisara al achat kamma vechamma (sifre):

Ki lo chetzurenu tzuram. kol ze haya lahem laoyvim lehavin shehashshem hisgiram velo lahem velelohehem hannitztzachon, shehare ad henna lo yachlu kelum elohehem keneged tzurenu, ki lo chesalenu salam; kol tzur shebbammikra leshon sela:
Veoyvenu pelilim. veachshav oyvenu shoftim otanu, hare shetzurenu mecharanu lahem:
ohc: Ki lo chetzurenu vegomer. perush, hattaam sheyyitlu taam echad elef ki tzuram mecharam vaAdonai hisgiram, velo yitlu lomar mibbilti yecholet Adonai vegomer chas veshalom, uchemaamar moshe laAdonai bemaase hammeraggelim, ki hattokef shel yisrael eno ketakpam shel haummot, sheen lecha avoda zara sheamda yamim rabbim, besod (Mishlei 12:19) "vead argia leshon shaker", vetze ulemad meavoda zara shel kemosh asher tau achareha rov haummot vechamma hiflia asot kakkatuv bedivre rabbenu seadya gaon, veaf al pi chen vehaya kelo haya, verabbot kaelle. aval tzurenu saggi choach maalin bakkodesh vaafillu haggoyim yaskimu al ze, kaamur bedivre hannavi (Malachi 1:11) "ki gadol shemi baggoyim", uchesheyyiru mappelet yisrael bederech ze gam hem yishpetu chen, vehu amro "veoyvenu pelilim" leshon dayyanim, keamro (Shemot 21:22) "venatan biflilim", perush yishpetu gam hem shello chetzurenu tzuram, ella kesheroim hashechatat yisrael yenakkeru et haemet kemo shekkatuv "pen yenakkeru vegomer pen yomru" vegomer.

rashi: Minnoga negdo. shello tomar bachoshech hu sharuy, ella hannoga lifnim min hammechitza, umeoto noga asher lefanav, baaru gachale esh, shennishtallechu chitztzim al mitzrayim:
targum: Miziv yekareh mavhikin sheme shemaya mezofiteh kegumerin denur dalka memreh:

rashi: Beyom hitztzil Adonai oto. leet ziknato, leachar sheavru alav kol tzarotav venitztzol mikkullam:

Umikkaf shaul. vahalo shaul bakkelal haya, ella shehaya oyvo verodfo mikkullam, kayyotze bo (Shmuel 2 2:30): "tisha asar ish vaasahel", kayyotze bo (Yehoshua 2:1): "lechu reu et haaretz veet yericho" vechayyotze bo (Melachim 1 11:1): "vehammelech shelomo ahav nashim nachriyyot veet bat paro":
targum: Veshabbach david binvua kodam Adonai yat pitgame tushebachta hada al kol yomaya desheziv Adonai yat yisrael miyad kol baale devavehon veaf ledavid shezveh mecharba deshaul:

rashi: Chemat bakar vachalev tzon. ze haya bime shelomo, shenneemar (Melachim 1 4) "asara vakar beriim veesrim bakar rei umea tzon":
Im chelev karim. ze haya bime aseret hashshevatim, shenneemar (Amos 6) "veochlim karim mitztzon":
Chelev kilyot chitta. ze haya bime shelomo, shenneemar (Melachim 1 Adonai) "vayhi lechem shelomo vegomer":
Vedam enav tishte chamer. bime aseret hashshevatim "hashshotim bemizreke yayin" (Amos 6):
Chemat bakar. hu shumman hanniklat meal gabbe hechalav:
Vachalev tzon. chalav shel tzon, ucheshehu davuk nakud chalev, kemo "bachalev immo" (Shemot 23):
Karim. kevasim:
Veelim. kemashmao:
Bene vashan. shemenim hayu:
Kilyot chitta. chittim shemenim kechelev kelayot vegassin kechuleya:
Vedam enav. tihye shote yayin tov vetoem yayin chashuv:

Chamer. yayin bilshon arammi "chamar", en ze shem davar ella leshon meshubbach betaam, vaveynevash belaaz. veod yesh lefaresh shene mikraot hallalu achar targum shel unkelos "ashrinun al takpe ara vegomer":
Tzuri. leshon sela, shehassela machase leovre derech, min hammatar veharuchot, 554 109:
Echese. leshon kissuy, shehayiti mitkasse leezra:
Misgabbi. somcheni:
Umenusi. shehayiti nas elav leezra:
targum: Elahi deitree vi karevni lidchalteh tukefe demin kodamohi mityehav li tekof ufurekan leitgabbara al baale devavi rochatzani deal memreh ana rachitz beidan aka megin alay mibbaale devavi vaamar laarama karni befurekaneh sumechani dahava memreh semach li kad haveti arik min kodam radfay purekani mibbaale devavi veaf miyad kol chatofin sheziv yati:

rashi: Kinuni. hiviru chamati:
Belo el. bedavar sheeno eloah:
Belo am. beumma sheen lah shem, shenneemar (Yeshayahu 23) hen eretz kasdim ze haam lo haya, beesav hu omer (Ovadya 1) bazuy atta meod:
Begoy naval achisem. ellu hamminim, vechen hu omer (Tehillim 14) amar naval belibbo en elohim (sifre; yevamot 63):

Haazinu hashshamayim. sheani matre vahem beyisrael vetihyu edim baddavar, shekkach amarti lahem sheattem tihyu edim, vechen vetishma haaretz. velamma heid bahem shamayim vaaretz? amar moshe: ani basar vadam, lemachar ani met, im yomru yisrael lo kibbalnu alenu habberit, mi va umachchisham? lefichach heid bahem shamayim vaaretz — edim shehen kayyamim leolam. veod, sheim yizku yavou haedim veyittenu secharam, haggefen titten piryah vehaaretz titten yevulah vehashshamayim yittenu tallam, veim yitchayyevu tihye vahem yad haedim techilla — "veatzar et hashshamayim velo yihye matar vehaadama lo titten et yevulah" (Devarim 17), veachar kach "vaavadtem mehera" (sham 11) al yede haummot:
ohc: Haazinu hashshamayim vegomer. yesh lehair rishona lamma amar "vaadabbera", velo amar al ze hadderech "haazinu hashshamayim devaray". 2 lamma lo kalal otam yachad veyomar "haazinu hashshamayim vehaaretz", o "shimu shamayim vaaretz": 3 lamma lashshamayim amar leshon haazana velaaretz amar leshon shemia: 4 lamma lashshamayim amar leshon tziuuy "haazinu" lenocheach, velaaretz amar "vetishma" shehaya lo lomar "veshimi haaretz": Adonai lamma lashshamayim amar "vaadabbera" dibbur kashe velaaretz amar "imre fi" amira rakka: 6 lamma dikdek lomar "imre fi" velo amar "amaray":

Veraiti lerabbotenu zichronam livracha (besifre) sheamru: moshe shehaya karov lashshamayim amar "haazinu hashshamayim" vegomer, yeshaya shehaya rachok min hashshamayim amar "shimu shamayim" (yeshaya 1:2), ad kan. velidverehem nityashshevu ketzat mehaddikdukim, lo kullam.

Vechutz middarkam nire lomar, vekodem naskil al devar mashmaut tevat "haazinu", vehinne hi sovelet shene derachim: echad, hatte ozen, vehashsheni, taazin aznecha. ladderech harishon yaggid shehashshomea rachok vetzarich lehattot azno kede sheyyuchal lishmoa, shebbelo hattayat azno eno yachol lishmoa. veladderech hashsheni yaggid shekkol kach ozen hashshomea kerova lammashmia shellaze amar haazen. vederech ze bo bacharu chazal. vechevan shehammilla sovelet gam ken derech harishon, veen hechrea, anu nelech bo, uvaze yityashshevu kol haddikdukim al nachon.

Vahagam shekkadmonenu bacharu derech acher, kevar amarnu sheshshivim panim lattora (Bamidbar Rabba 13,16), uveinyan haaggada yecholim lefaresh hagam sheyyihye happerush menagged ledivrehem kol sheen hanniggud bidvar halacha, uma gam sheyyesh lanu lehasebil shene hadderachim bappasuk kaasher avaer besamuch:

Hinne hadderech sheanu meyashshevim bo kol haddikdukim hu al ze hadderech, lefi shehashshamayim hem elyonim kifshat hainyan, laze kara lahem moshe sheyyattu aznam, veamar lahem "haazinu", perush hattu aznechem lishmoa devaray, velaaretz amar "vetishma", perush meatzmah belo hattayat ozen, ki lefanav hi omedet, vichola lishmoa chittuch hammaamar hayyotze mippiv, vehu amro "imre fi", lihyotah kol kach kerova etzlo.

Ulederech ze hirvachnu yishshuv kol haddikdukim, ki lefi sheechad rachok veechad karov, laze chillek haheara lechol echad kefi harauy lo. larachok kara sheyyatte azno, vehitna al atzmo likro bekol gadol, vehu amro "vaadabbera", velakkarov kefi harauy lo heiro sheggam elav yedabber, ella sheeno tzarich likria, ki meatzmo yishma hagam shello yikra bekol gadol, ella bechittuch otiyyot mippiv tishma bo.

Ulederech ze yityashshevu divre yeshaya sheamar (yeshaya 1:2) "shimu shamayim vehaazini aretz", shennatan shemia lashshamayim hagam shehem rechokim mimmennu, vehaazana laaretz hagam shehi kerova. hattaam hu, kemo sheggamar omer yeshaya atzmo veamar "ki Adonai dibber", perush taam sheamar beseder ze lahem ki Adonai dibber, uveerech hamedabber shehu hakkadosh baruch hu yoter hem kerovim hashshamayim, dichtiv (tehillim 115:16) "hashshamayim shamayim laAdonai", uchetiv (yeshaya 66:1) "hashshamayim kisi vehaaretz hadom ragli", velaze amar "shimu shamayim" ma sheddibber Adonai, ki enam tzerichim hattayat ozen, vehaazini aretz" lihyotah rechoka, tzericha lehattayat aznah lishmoa.

Veulay shettevat "haazinu" yutzdeku bah shene hadderachim, al ze hadderech: beerech bechinat pe moshe hammechattech haotiyyot tihye hakkavvana kidvarenu, uveerech nishmato shehi haruchaniyyut tihye hakkavvana kedivre rabbotenu zichronam livracha, vehaddevarim mochichim ken, sheal nishmato shel moshe hu sheamru chachamenu zichronam livracha (sifre haazinu 1) lefi shehaya karov lashshamayim, ki atzmuto baaretz yedabber, veen lehachechish hammuchash.

Od nitkavven sheddibber im shene harekavot shemmehem banuy haadam, echad chelek haruchani sheyyityaches beshem hashshamayim, veechad chelek haggufani sheyyityaches beshem haaretz, uchederech sheramzu rabbotenu zichronam livracha (sanhedrin tze:) bappasuk "yikra el hashshamayim meal" vegomer (tehillim 50:4).

Uchesheddibber laruchaniyyut shebbaadam kara elav veamar "haazinu hashshamayim", perush, chelke hashshamayim shelleheyotam temunim bannistar, laze keraam lehaazin, veamar kenegdo dibbur kashe, ki hannefesh tisbol marut beinyene habbore, ki takkir chiyyuvah.
Ucheneged hagguf shehu benigle, amar "vetishma haaretz", perush, chelke haaretz, "imre fi", ki hagguf leheyot tivo rachok mehammuskalot tzarich amira rakka lishmoa.

Od nitkavven ledabber im haderagot hannimtzaim beyisrael: echad hem gedolehem verashehem, 2 hemma hamon haam sheen lahem shem baam. vechinna laggedolim beshem shamayim shehem bemadrega gedola, vehikdimam vedibber lahem betziuuy "haazinu hashshamayim", veachar kach amar "vetishma haaretz", perush meatzmam yishmeu hehamon hannimshalim laaretz, kesheyyiru gedolehem holchim bederech nachon, ucheamram zichronam livracha (Zohar chelek 2 36.) veze leshonam: i resha deamma ittakkan kolla ittakkan.

Od yirmoz: im yaazinu divre tora az yihyu nikraim shamayim, vehu amro "haazinu" – baze attem nechshavim shamayim, al derech amro (tehillim 82:6) "ani amarti elohim attem", uchemo sheheerachnu befarashat bereshit, sheal yede maase hatztzaddikim gam hachomer mehappechim oto veosim oto tzura, veal yede maase harshaim mehappechim hatztzura lechomer.

Uchevar amarnu ki hatztzura tityaches beshem shamayim, vehachomer yityaches beshem eretz. veamro "vaadabbera", perush, lo bishat hattova levad taazinu, ella afillu beshaa sheyyedabber kashot betochachot al avon tzerichin lehaazin.

Veamro vetishma haaretz vegomer. perush, sheafillu achar peredat hannefesh mehagguf vetishshaer bechinat haaretz levaddah, af al pi chen tishma haaretz imre fi. perush, al derech amram besefer hazzohar (zohar chodesh Bereshit befasuk "vayyomer elohim yehe meorot") veze leshono: "tzeena ureena" vegomer, atida bat kol leitteara bechol tziyyuna vetziyyuna bevatte kivre veomeret "tzeena ureena", puku mittechot beleuta deafra veittearu mishshenatchon benot tziyyon, kema deat amar "ma hatztziyyun hallaz" (Melachim 2 23:17), ad kan. hu hammaamar shemmavtiach Adonai latztzaddikim sheyyishma gufam achar sheyyihye baaretz, vehu amro "vetishma haaretz imre fi". umimmotza davar atta lamed shemmi shello yaazin devar Adonai lo yishma gufo hashshochen baaretz et kol hakkaroz hahu velo yihye afaro ninar.

rashi: Ki shem Adonai ekra. hare ki meshammesh bilshon kaasher, kemo (Vayikra 23) "ki tavou el haaretz", kesheekra veazkir shem Adonai, attem havu godel lelohenu uvarchu shemo, mikkan amru sheonin baruch shem kevod malchuto achar beracha shebbammikdash (80 sifre; mechilta Shemot 13; berachot 21; taanit 16):
ohc: Ki shem Adonai ekra. hakkavvana ki haddavar asher elav yechavven bemaamarav hu shem Adonai, al derech amram zichronam livracha (Zohar 11 98:) kol hattora kullah shemotav shel hakkadosh baruch hu, vealeha hu omer "yaarof kammatar likchi" shehi hattora shehi shemo yitbarach, uferush "ekra" milleshon yekar.

Od ramaz, shehagam shettala lahem esek hattora betal umatar, lo tihye hakkavvana ballimmud al ze, ella likrot besefer torat Adonai, vehu amro "ki", perush, yihye taam "shem Adonai ekra" perush, likrot betorato shehi shemo yitbarach kede sheyyitten godel lelohenu, vezo tikkare tora lishmah legaddel ulefaer shem kevodo. veamro "ekra" hu ma sheyyaase kol echad mehem, o al derech amram zichronam livracha (Tikkunei Zohar tikun 69 daf 112.) shennafshot kol oske tora hem nitzotze moshe, velo dor hammidbar levad ella ad sof kol haddorot kol haosek battora karuch hu bemoshe, velaze kinna esek hattora shel yisrael elav veamar "ekra", vehaven:

Od yirtze amro "ki shem Adonai" vegomer netinat taam lehanneemar achar kach shehu "havu godel lelohenu", vehu al derech ma sheamru zichronam livracha (shocher tov 29, 12) befasuk (tehillim 22, 4) "yoshev tehillot yisrael" shello yashav Adonai al kisse hattehillot ad sheamru tzeva hashshamayim "baruch Adonai elohe yisrael", velo haya lo nachat ruach kesheamru lo elohe shamayim vaaretz velohe hammalachim. velaze ba devaro hattov kan veamar havu godel umaala ledavar ze sheeno chafetz likkare ella elohenu, vehu amro "lelohenu", ki beemtzaut shekkorim battora shehu shem Adonai, vehu amro "ki shem Adonai ekra", baze keshemmeshabbechin haelyonim veomrim "baruch Adonai elohe yisrael" shevach ze yesh bo gedulla veshevach, ma sheen ken kesheen yisrael oskim battora veomrim hammalachim "baruch Adonai elohe yisrael" shevach ze garua meod matta matta veyishtakka haddavar, shehare hem machchishim chas veshalom kesheen oskin betorato shebbeemtzautah yiches elohuto alenu. verabbotenu zichronam livracha darshu harebe derashot (sifre) uchefattish vegomer.

rashi: Shichet lo vegomer. ketargumo, "chabbilu lehon la le":
Banav mumam. banav hayu vehashechata shehishchitu hi mumam:
Banav mumam. mumam shel banav haya velo mumo:
Dor ikkesh. akom umeukkal, kemo "veet kol hayeshara yeakkeshu" (Micha 3). uvilshon mishna "chulda sheshshinneha akummot vaakushot":

Ufetaltol. anetaverateyleyysh, kappetil hazze sheggodlin oto umakkifin oto sevivot haggedil; petaltol min hattevot hakkefulot kemo "yerakrak" "adamdam" (Vayikra 13) "secharchar" (Tehillim 38), "segalgal" (targum yonatan Melachim 1 7):
ohc: Shichet lo lo banav. perush, keshemmashchitim darkam gormim raa leatzmam, uma raa gormim – lo banav, perush sheenam nikraim bene el chay, keamram zichronam livracha (bava batra 10.) kesheyyisrael holchim bedarko shel makom nikraim banim uchesheen holchim vechulei nikraim avadim, vehu amro "shichet lo" shello yikkaru banav shel hakkadosh baruch hu. veamro "mumam", lefi sheyyesh makom lomar sof sof yaggia haddavar laav mum habbanim chas veshalom, laze amar "mumam", perush hammum mehem ba lo meavinu, ki hu bara et haadam yashar, uchemaamar hannavi (Yeshayahu 5:1-2) "kerem haya vegomer vayazzekehu vaysakkelehu vayyittaehu sorek vegomer vaykav laasot anavim" vegomer. vehu amro "mumam", perush hammum mehem ba. uferush mum al derech amram zichronam livracha (sota 3.) en adam over avera ella im ken nichnesa bo ruach shetut, shehu ruach raa vehi tikkare mum, besod amro (Devarim 15:21) "mum ra", vehameshachat chelek ze hara eno ella mitztzad maase haadam.

Dor ikkesh ufetaltol vegomer. sheim yihye ikkesh levad, divre hattora tasim hammaakashshim lemishor, umi garam laze shennishchat – heyoto ikkesh ufetaltol, perush mitchazzek beikkeshuto, kaasher enenu root baddorot hallalu mine eppikorsut derech ikkesh, uchesheadam meyashsher ikkeshutehem hem mitchazzekim bearchot ikkeshim kashim, veze avdan moledet bayit.

rashi: Avita. leshon ovi:
Kasita. kemo kasita, leshon "ki chissa fanav bechelbo" (Iyov 15), keadam sheshshamen mibbifnim uchesalav nichpalim mibbachutz, vechen hu omer (sham) "vayyaas pima ale chasel":
Kasita. yesh lashon kal bilshon kissuy, kemo "vechose kalon arum" (Mishlei 12), veim katav kissita, dagush, haya nishma kissita et acherim, kemo "ki chissa fanav" (Iyov 15):
Vaynabbel tzur yeshuato. ginnahu uvizzahu, kemo shenneemar (Yechezkel 8) "achorehem el hechal Adonai vegomer", en lecha nibbul gadol mizze (sifre):

Amarti afehem. amarti velibbi afe otam, veyesh lefaresh afehem ashitem pea, lehashelicham mealay hefker, vedugmato matzinu veezra (Nechemya 9) "vattitten lahem mamlachot vaamamim vattachlekem lefea" — lehefker, vechen chibbero menachem. veyesh potrim oto ketargumo "yachul rugezi alehon", velo yittachen, sheim ken haya lo lichtov aafehem, achat leshimmush veachat lisod, kemo "aazzercha" (Yeshayahu 45), "aammitzchem bemo fi" (Iyov 15), vehaalef hattichona enah reuya vo chelal. veunkelos tirgem achar leshon habbarayta hashshenuya vesifre hacholeket teva zo leshalosh tevot, amarti af e hem — amarti veappi ettenem keillu enam sheyyomru roehem alehem ayye hem:
ohc: Amarti afehem. perush "afehem" – asmich appi immahem ad sheyyushebtu meenosh.

rashi: Hareninu goyim ammo. leoto hazzeman yeshabbechu haummot et yisrael, reu ma shivchah shel umma zo, sheddavku behakkabba bechol hattelaot sheavru alehem velo azavuhu, yodim hayu betuvo uveshivcho:
Ki dam avadav yikkom. shefichut demehem, kemashmao:

Venakam yashiv letzarav. al haggazel veal hechamas, kainyan shenneemar (Yoel 4) "mitzrayim lishmama tihye veedom lemidbar shemama tihye mechamas bene yehuda", veomer (Ovadya 10) "mechamas achicha yaakov vegomer" (80 sifre):
Vechipper admato ammo. vifayyes admato veammo al hatztzarot sheavru alehem vesheasa lahem haoyev:
Vechipper. leshon ritztzuy ufiyyus, kemo (Bereshit 32, 21) "achappera fanav" — anchineh lerugezeh:
Vechipper admato uma hi admato? ammo. kesheammo mitnachamim artzo mitnachemet, vechen hu omer "ratzita Adonai artzecha", bamme ratzita artzecha? "shavta shevit yaakov" (Tehillim 85).

Befanim acherim hi nidreshet besifre venechleku vah rabbi yehuda verabbi nechemya, rabbi yehuda doresh kullah keneged yisrael, verabbi nechemya doresh et kulla keneged haummot, rabbi yehuda dorshah kelappe yisrael — (26) amarti afehem kemo shepperashti, ad (27) velo Adonai paal kol zot. (28) ki goy avad etzot hemma. avdu torati shehi lahem etza nechona, veen bahem tevuna lehitbonen (30) Eicha yirdof echad min haummot elef mehem, im lo ki tzuram michram. (lo) ki lo chetzurenu tzuram hakkol kemo shepperashti ad tachlit. vera nechemya dorshah kelappe haummot, ki goy avad etzot hemma, kemo shepperashti techilla ad veoyvenu pelilim:
(32) Ki miggefen sedom gafnam. shel ummot:
Umishshadmot amora vegomer. velo yasimu libbam litlot haggedulla bi:
Anavemo inneve rosh. hu sheamar lule kaas oyev agur al yisrael lehareilam ulehamriram, lefichach ashkelot merorot lamo lehaleit otam al ma sheasu levanay:
(33) Chamat tanninim yenam. muchan lehashekotam al ma sheosin lahem:
(34) Kamus immadi. oto hakkos, shenneemar (Tehillim 75) "ki chos beyad Adonai vegomer":
(La) leet timmot raglam. kainyan shenneemar "tirmesenna regel" (Yeshayahu 26):
(36) Ki yadin Adonai ammo. belashon ze meshammesh ki yadin bilshon deha, veen yadin leshon yissurin ella komo ki yariv et rivam miyyad oshkehem. ki yire ki azlat yad vegomer:

(37) Veamar i elohemo. haoyev yomar e elohemo shel yisrael? kemo sheamar titus harasha kesheggidder et happarochet (gittin 56), kainyan shenneemar (Micha 7): vetere oyavti utechasseha vusha haomra elay ayyo Adonai elohayich":
(39) Rau atta ki ani vegomer. az yegalle hakkabba yeshuato veyomar rau atta ki ani ani hu, meitti bat alehem haraa umeitti tavo alehem hattova:
Veen mide matztzil. sheyyatztzil etchem min haraa asher avi alechem:

(40) Ki eshsha el shamayim yede. kemo ki nasati — tamid ani mashre mekom shechinati vashshamayim, ketargumo, afillu challash lemala vegibbor lematta emat elyon al hattachton vechol shekken sheggibbor lemala vechallash millematta:

Yede. mekom shechinati, kemo "ish al yado" (Bamidbar 2), vehaya veyadi lehippara mikkem, aval amarti shechay anochi leolam, eni memaher lippara lefi sheyyesh li shahut baddavar, ani chay leolam uvedorot acharonim ani nifra mehem vehayecholet beyadi lippara min hammetim umin hachayyim; melech basar vadam shehu holech lamut memaher nikmato lehippara bechayyav ki shemma yamut hu o oyvo venimtza shello raa nikmato mimmennu aval ani chay leolam, veim yamutu hem veeni nifra bechayyehem, eppara bemotam:
(41) Im shannoti barak charbi. harebe im yesh sheenam teluyin, kesheashannen barak charbi vetochez bemishpat yede, kullo kemo shepperashti lemala:
ohc: Hareninu goyim vegomer. perush, ki baasot Adonai nekama beoyve yisrael viromem madregat yisrael, yerannenu haggoyim al ammo yisrael leshabbecham ulerommam, keamro (tehillim 144:15) "ashre haam" vegomer.

Ki dam avadav yikkom. veamro "ki dam vegomer venakam" vegomer – perush, shello dam levad, ella gam tzarav asher charshu aven lo yashiv Adonai lahem nakam shechashvu laasot, al derech amro (tehillim 7:17) "yashuv amalo verosho".

Vechipper admato ammo. veamro "vechipper admato ammo" hu gemar haddevarim shehitchil lomar "ki yadin Adonai ammo" vegomer, vegamar omer ki hannimtza adayin mehachataim al yisrael techapper alehem haaretz asher hayta leshamma ulecherpa shanim rabbot, ze yihye lechapparat avon am Adonai.

rashi: Veim ikkesh. paro:

Tittappal. leshon niftal veikkesh, uvesefer tehillim (tehillim 18:27) katuv: "titpattal". davar acher: yishlach mimmarom yikkacheni. al atzmo amar, keshehaya nechpaz lalechet mippene shaul besela hammachlekot vehaya karov lehittafes, umalach ba el shaul lemor: mahara velecha ki fashtu felishtim: vayyashev vegomer ketzidkati. shello haragtiv becharti kenaf meilo:
targum: Im yaakov dehalich bivrirutta kodamach becharta venohi mikkol ammaya veafrashta zareh mikkol pesola paro umitzrae dachashivu machshevan al amach balbaltinun bemachshevathon:

rashi: Tarchiv tzaadi. kesheadam medabbek raglav zo bazo, hu noach lippol, vechen hu omer (Mishlei 4:12): "belechtecha lo yetzar tzaadecha":
Karsullay. akevay:
targum: Asgita pesiati techotay vela izdazea rechuvati:

rashi: Bakkodesh darkecha. derech middatcha lekaddesh et shimcha baolam, laasot din barshaim:
targum: Elaha dekadishin orchatach man elaha rabba kelaha deyisrael:

rashi: Echa yirdof echad. mimmennu elef miyyisrael:
Im lo ki tzuram mecharam vaAdonai hisgiram. mecharam umesaram beyadenu, 246 belaaz:
ohc: Echa yirdof. yesh lefarsho heara laggoy sheeno mitorer beheara nirgeshet shehi "echa yirdof echad" vegomer, perush, echad mehaummot elef miyyisrael, perush ki bechol milchamot hargilim ben haummot lo yimmatze davar kaze, sheen sone massig koach ugevura kazo ben haammim.
Echa yirdof echad elef. perush, echad hammeyuchad mehaummot elef miyyisrael vechulei. veayyen ma shepperashti befarashat bechukkotay befasuk (Vayikra 26:8) "veradfu mikkem chamishsha mea" vegomer:

Im lo ki tzuram. perush middat haddin, uchemo shepperashti befasuk (Devarim 32:4) "hatztzur tamim" vegomer. veamro "vaAdonai hisgiram" perush middat rachamim im middat haddin, shezzulat ze lo haya kol kach yerida leyisrael sheyyippelu elef lifne echad.

rashi: Ala ashan beappo. ken derech hakkoes, yotze ashan minnechirav, vechen (tehillim 18:9): "ala ashan beappo". vezehu kol leshon charon af, shehaaf nocher umaale hevel:
Veesh mippiv tochel. miggizrat devar piv, tochal esh barshaim:
targum: Selik zedone defaro rashia kitnana kodamohi bechen shelach rugezeh keasha vaara demin kodamohi meshetzaa mezofiteh kegumerin denur dalka memreh:

rashi: Berakav. zohorurav, lashon "lemaan heyo lah barak morata" (Yechezkel 21:15):
Vattachel. "bayyom hahu yihye raash gadol al admat yisrael veraashu mippanav dege hayyam" (Yechezkel 38:19-20):
Vattachel. leshon "chil kayyoleda" (tehillim 48:7; Micha 4:9):
targum: Menaharin berake tevel chamat veitchalchalat ara:

rashi: Yarkivehu al bomote aretz. kol hammikra ketargumo:
Yarkivehu vegomer. al shem sheeretz yisrael gavoah mikkol haaratzot:
Vayyochal tenuvot saday. ellu ferot eretz yisrael shekkallim lanuv ulehitbashshel mikkol perot haaratzot:

Vayyenikehu devash missela. maase beechad sheamar livno besichni have li ketziot min hechavit, halach umatza haddevash tzaf al piha, amar lo zo shel devash hi amar lo hasheka yadcha letochah veatta maale ketziot mittochah (sifre):
Bomote aretz. leshon gova:
Saday. leshon sade:
Mechalmish tzur. takpo vechazko shel sela, kesheeno davuk latteva shelleacharav nakud challamish ucheshehu davuk nakud chalmish:
Veshemen mechalmish tzur. ellu zetim shel gush chalav (sifre):
ohc: Yarkivehu al bomote vegomer. en ze nimshach im haamur lemala, ella hatechalat inyan venimshach lematta, ugezerat haddevarim hu "vayyishman yeshurun" vegomer.

rashi: Lule kaas oyev agur. im lo shekkaas haoyev kanus alehem lehashechit, veim yuchal lahem veyashchitem yitle haggedulla bo uvelohav velo yitle haggedulla bi, vezehu shenneemar pen yenakkeru tzaremo — yenakkeru haddavar litlot gevuratam benachri sheen haggedulla shello — pen yomru yadenu rama vegomer:
ohc: Lule kaas oyev vegomer. perush, shekkamma vechamma hacheasot hichisuni oyvehem, vehu amro "agur" milleshon (Mishlei 6:8) "agra vakkatzir", sheagur hu kaaso shel oyev veomdim hem lechillayon, uchesheyyiru shehishbatti shem yisrael chas veshalom "yenakkeru tzaremo", perush, yachshevu ki yisrael emunatam nachriyya velo tzaddik, veyitchazzek devar emet lesheker chas veshalom. veod choshesh "pen yomru yadenu rama", perush, millevad sheyyachchishu emunat yisrael vedatam, yosifu lachato lomar sheemunatam emuna reuya, vehu amro "pen yomru yadenu rama", vetovatam veshalvatam lo meAdonai hi ella meavoda zara asher hem ovdim.
Vehu amro velo Adonai paal kol zot, perush, kol tovatam vehatzelachatam. veharaya shello asu yisrael davar ra ma shehem enam osim, veyoter mehemma, vehem mashlu bahem vayabbedum.

O yirtze, shekkol happeulla hazzot sheasu hashechata gedola beyisrael vehishbitu meenosh zichram, yomru shello asa kol ze Adonai ella betzeruf koach veratzon avodat avoda zara shehi hishlitatam alehem:

rashi: Chay Adonai. haose li elle:
targum: Bechen al nisa ufurekana daavadta leamach bet yisrael odiu vaamaru kayaym hu Adonai uverich takifa demin kodamohi mityehiv lana tekof uppurekan umeromem elaha tekof purekanana:

rashi: Ma acharitam. ma taale vahem besofam:
Ki dor tahpuchot hemma. mehappechin retzoni lechaas:
Lo emun bam. en giddulay nikkarim bahem, ki horetim derech tova vesaru mimmenna:
Emun. leshon "vayhi omen" (Ester 2), 686 belaaz; davar acher — emun leshon emuna, ketargumo, amru vesinay naase venishma uleshaa kalla vittelu havetachatam veasu haegel (sifre):
ohc: Ki dor tahpuchot vegomer. perush, lefi sheamar hakkatuv besamuch "astira fanay" vegomer, uvaze lo yashkif veyire hagam sheyyaase teshuva vichannenu kolam, veen ze min hannachon laasot ken, laze gamar omer hattaam "ki dor tahpuchot", perush mithappechim mittova leraa. veamro "banim", perush afillu yachshevu lehetiv lavo el geder sheyyihyu nechshavim banim, "lo emun bam" ki yashuvu lehareshia veen chazaratam shelema, vaasher al ken rauy hu lehasetir vegomer:

rashi: Vayyet shamayim. lehinnakem meoyvav, mimmitzrayim umipparo:
targum: Vearkin shemaya veitgeli yekareh vaanan amitta kevash kodamohi:

rashi: Chasid, tamim, navar. keneged shelosha avot, sheshshillem hakkadosh baruch hu gemul tzidkatam livnehem:
targum: Im avraham deishtechach chasid kodamach bechen asgeta lemeebbad chisda im zareh yitzchak dahava shelim bidchaltach bechen ashlemta memar reutach lemebad imeh:

rashi: Tavu goyim. zo hi hattehilla asher asapper:
targum: Tevau ammaya beshuchata daavadu bimtzadta dena kemanu itachadat riglehon:

rashi: Li nakam veshillem. immi nachon umezumman puranut nakam, vishallem lahem kemaasehem, hannakam yeshallem lahem gemulam. veyesh mefarshim veshillem shem davar, kemo veshillum vehu miggizrat "vehaddibber en bahem" (Yirmeyahu Adonai) — kemo vehaddibbur. veematay ashallem lahem?
Leet tamut raglam. keshettittom zechut avotam shehen semuchim alav:
Ki karov yom edam. mishsheertze lehavi alehem yom edam karov umezumman lefanay lehavi al yede sheluchim harebe:
Vechash atidot lamo. umaher yavou haatidot lahem:

Vechash. kemo "yemaher yachisha" (Yeshayahu Adonai); ad kan heid alehem moshe divre tochecha lihyot hashshira hazzot leed, keshettavo alehem happuranut yedu sheani hodatim merosh, mikkan vaelach heid alehem divre tanchumin sheyyavou alehem kichlot happuranut, kechol asher amar lemala, "vehaya chi yavou alecha vegomer habberacha vehakkelala vegomer veshav Adonai elohecha et shevutecha vegomer":
ohc: Li nakam veshillem. yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (avoda zara 3:) shelleatid lavo yotzi hashshem chamma minnartikah, harshaim niddonim bah velihata otam, vehatztzaddikim mitrappein bah. vehu amro "li nakam veshillem", perush, nakam larshaim, veshillem sachar tov latztzaddikim.

Leet tamut raglam. hu sod maamar (sota mat.) "ikkevot meshicha", vehu berure nitzotze ragle 100 keshettamut raglam shel ose risha, vetiggamer mimma shennaga bah middavar hammaamid, kayyadua leyode chen.
Ki karov yom edam, vegomer. hu maamar hannavi (Tzefanya 1:7) "ki karov yom Adonai" vegomer.
Vechash atidot lamo. hem hannechamot haatidot, kesheyyishtallemu ose risha techef yemaher lekayyem havetachot haatidot latztzaddikim.

rashi: Noda Adonai. kol ze min hattehilla, noda Adonai labberiyyot ki shallit hu umoshel venokem leoyvav, shehare mishpat asa bahem. yushetitza belaaz:
Nokesh rasha. nichshal rasha:
Higgayon. nehge zot sela:
targum: Gele kodam Adonai din daavad beovade aydoy ittekal rashia yerannun tzadikaya lealmin:

rashi: Bene nechar yibbolu. yilu, leshon (Yirmeyahu 8:13): "veheale navel" 704 109:
Veyachgeru. leshon pischim:
Mimmisgerotam. mikkoshi yissure masger sheani meyasseran bahem:
targum: Bene ammaya yesufun vizuun mibbirneyatehon:

rashi: Veamar. hakkabba alehem e elohemo sheavdu:
Tzur chasayu vo. hassela shehayu mitkassin bo mippene hachamma vehatztzinna, kelomar shehayu vetuchin bo lehagen alehem min haraa:
ohc: E elohemo. yisrael yomar: "e elohemo?" hagam sheen maasehem mehugganim, af al pi chen yavo betaana lifne haelohim haramuz betevat tzur, vehu chasayu vo. ki yisrael, hagam sheyyarshiu veyaavru al chelek mimmitzvot Adonai, af al pi chen kol machsehem baAdonai, vealav sovlim dallut veshiflut, veneheragim al kedushshat shemo, veomdim umetzappim letzur goalam, vehu amro "chasayu vo".

rashi: Neum Adonai ladoni. rabbotenu derashuhu beavraham avinu, vaani afarshennu kedivrehem: neum Adonai leavraham, shekkerauhu haolam adoni "shemaeni adoni" (Bereshit 23:11):
Shev limini. hitakkev litshuati vehitcholel laAdonai, en yeshiva ella akkava, vechen hu omer: "vatteshvu vekadesh" (Devarim 1:46):
Limini. litshuat yemini:
Ad ashit oyvecha. amrafel vachaverav (Bereshit 14:1):
targum: Al yad david tushebcha amar Adonai bememreh leshavaa yati ribbon al kol yisrael beram amar li tuv veorech leshaul demin shivta devinyamin ad dimut arum let malchuta mekarva achavertah uvatar ken ashave baale devavach kevish leriglach: <small>(401)</small> amar Adonai bememreh lemittan li rabbanuta chalaf ditevit leulefan orayta dimini orech ad daashave beal devavach kevish leriglach:

rashi: Lo eloah. ketargumo "delet behon tzeroch", illu haya vahem tzeroch lo hayta kina chefula kemo achshav (sifre):
Chadashim mikkarov bau. afillu haummot lo hayu regilim bahem — goy shehaya roe otam, haya omer ze tzelem yehudi:

Lo searum avotechem. lo yaru mehem — lo amda saaratam mippenehem, derech saarot haadam laamod mechamat yira, kach nidrash besifre. veyesh lefaresh od searum leshon (yeshaya 13, 21) "useirim yerakkedu sham", seirim hem shedim, lo asu avotechem seirim hallalu:
ohc: Lo eloah. perush, gam hem enam zovchim lahem letzad heyotam eloah, ella laasot lahem tzarchehem umevukkasham. ucheneged ma sheosim laavodat elilim amar "elohim lo yedaum", perush, hagam sheenam yodim otam ma tivam shel haelilim hem ovdim otam. veamro "chadashim mikkarov bau" vegomer, ayyen ma shepperashti befasuk (Devarim 13:7) "ki yesitcha achicha" vegomer:

rashi: Behanechel elyon goyim. keshehinchil hakkabba lemachisav et chelek nachalatan hetzifan ushetafam:
Behaferido bene adam. keshehefitz dor happallaga haya veyado lehaaviram min haolam, lo asa chen ella yatztzev gevulot ammim, kiyyemam velo ibbedam:
Lemispar bene yisrael. bishvil mispar bene yisrael sheatidin latzet mibbene shem, ulemispar shivim nefesh shel bene yisrael sheyyardu lemitzrayim hitztziv gevulot ammim — shivim lashon:
ohc: Behanechel elyon goyim. perush, keshehinchil Adonai baruch hu et haggoyim lesare mala, ze yaggid asher hem pechutim etzlo, asher lo ratza sheyyitkannu lishmo, unetanam lesare mala:

Behaferido bene adam. perush, shello masar Adonai kol haummot beyad sar echad, ella hifridam venatan chelek lechol sar vesar. veofen hachalukka sheasa bahem kesheyyitztzev gevulam hayta lemispar bene yisrael. perush, yesh lecha ladaat ki chol maase Adonai asa ze leummat ze vetov vara, vechol nefashot shebbannivraim netaam Adonai mishshene ilanot: ilan echad tov veechad ra. ilan hattov hu adam harishon, ilan hara hu 100 adam beliyyaal. ucheshechata adam harishon venitarev ra betov, chazru lihyot yotzim meholadat adam harishon gam nefashot raot, ad sheyyatza nefesh achat tehora shebbah kelulot kol hanneshamot hakkedoshot, venitbarer hailan hattov mechadash, veze hu yaakov avinu alav hashshalom. velaze amru (bava metzia 84.; Zohar chelek 3 244.) shufereh deyaakov avinu meen shufereh deadam kadmaa, vehaven haddevarim. veilan ze yesh bo shivim anafim, vehem shivim nefesh sheyyardu lemitzrayim. vaasher al ken kaasher hifrid Adonai haummot, hitztziv gevulam lemispar bene yisrael, asa mehem shivim keneged shivim anfe hakkedushsha.

Vehakkavvana baze, kede shettihye kol bechina uvechina shel kol anaf meanfe hakkedushsha moshelet al shekkenegdah bechelek hara, veze sod (Mishlei 5:5) "ragleha yordot mavet", sheraglayim shel hakkedushsha dorchim al rashe hakkelippa, venimtzaim anfe yaakov sholtim umolchim al haummot. veamar "ki chelek Adonai ammo" perush taam laze, leheyot shehaumma asher bachar lo Adonai sheyyihye hu hammoshel aleha hem yisrael, laze nitkavven Adonai vehimlich venisse et bene yisrael al kol haummot, uvaze kaasher hu molech al yisrael hinne hu molech al kol haolam kullo. veamro "chelek Adonai ammo" yechavven el yisrael achar shekkibbelu hattora sheaz yikkaru beshem am Adonai. veamro "yaakov chevel" perush hachevel shehu rosh hannachala, vehu ma shehairoticha elav beremez amram zichronam livracha (bava metzia 84.) shufereh deyaakov vechulei:

Od yechavven lomar, leheyot sheyyesh shete bechinot banneshamot: yesh shebbaa meolam elyon, velaze yomar "chelek Adonai" – perush chelek meAdonai baruch hu kivyachol, veyesh nefashot shebbaot mimmakom hannikra nachalat shadday, velaze yikkare yaakov "chevel nachalato". vedikdek lomar "chevel" lirmoz inyan gadol asher gillu yode chen, ki chol nefesh hachiyyuni shebbaadam yesh lah chut echad davuk im sharshah, vehu yotze mehannechirayim vedavuk besharsho lemala, umishsham yoneket hannefesh lichyot. veal nefesh harasha amar hakkatuv (Bamidbar 15:31): "hikkaret tikkaret" vegomer – perush sheoto hashshoresh haddavuk mehannefesh lammakom shemmimmennu chutztzeva yachritennu Adonai, veshuv en lah yenika, vezo hi mita rachamana litzlan. uvatztzaddikim neemar (Devarim 4:4): "veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim" vegomer, vehu amro "chevel nachalato", vehaven:

rashi: Imrat Adonai tzerufa. berura, mavtiach veose:
targum: Elaha dechevana orcheh orayta dayya bechira hi takif hu lechol di mitrachatzin alohi:

rashi: Chamat tanninim yenam. ketargumo "ha chemarat tanninayya kos pureanutehon", hinne chimrirat nechashim kos mishte puranutam:
Verosh petanim. kosam shehu achzar lannashuch, oyev achzari yavo veyippara mehem:
Matte. leshon mishan, kemo "kol matte lechem" (tehillim 105:16):
Matte uzzecha yishlach Adonai mitztziyyon. keshettashuv min hammilchama vaanashecha ayefim verodfim, yishlach lecha Adonai et malki tzedek melech shalem lehotzi lechem vayayin (Bereshit 14:17-18):
Rede. bammilchama:
Bekerev oyvecha. lavetach:
targum: Chumera deushenach yeshadar Adonai mitzion utehe rade bimtza baale devavach:

rashi: Vehagiti vechol poolecha. sheasita lanu kevar:
targum: Urenanet bechol ovadach tavaya uvetaskofe nisach amalel:

rashi: Yimtzaehu beeretz midbar. otam matza lo neemanim beeretz hammidbar, shekkibbelu alehem torato umalchuto veullo, ma shello asu yishmael veesav, shenneemar (Devarim 33) "vezarach misseir lamo hofia mehar paran":

Uvetohu yelel yeshimon. eretz tziyya ushemama, mekom yillat tanninim uvenot yaana, af sham nimshechu achar haemuna, velo amru lemoshe heach netze lammidbarot mekom tziyya veshimmamon? kainyan shenneemar (Yirmeyahu 2), "lechtech acharay bammidbar":
Yesovvenhu. sham sibbevam vehikkifam baananim vesibbevam bidgalim learba ruchot vesibbevan betachtit hahar shekkafahu alehem kegigit (80 sifre):
Yevonnehu. sham betora uvina:
Yitztzerenhu. minnachash saraf veakrav umin haummot:

Keishon eno. hu hashshachor shebbaayin shehammaor yotze hemennu. veunkelos tirgem yimtzaehu — "yaspikehu kol tzarko vammidbar", kemo (Bamidbar 11) "matza lahem", (Yehoshua 17) "lo yimmatze lanu hahar":
Yesovvenhu. "ashrinun sechor sechor lishchinteh", ohel moed baemtza vearbaa degalim learba ruchot:
ohc: Yimtzaehu beeretz midbar uvetohu vegomer. nire ki yechavven hakkatuv al derech amram zichronam livracha (berachot 9:) lo yatzu yisrael mimmitzrayim ad sheasauha kimtzula sheen bah dagim vechulei, veamru od (Likkutei tora vayyar) sheim hayu yisrael mitakkevin bemitzrayim hayu nitmaim sham laad leolam ki hayu nichnasim bachamishshim shaare tuma, laze amar yimtzaehu beeretz shehi midbar, perush chareva veen bah mammash, velaze lo amar yimtzaehu bammidbar ella beeretz midbar, vehaven:

Veamar od, shemmillevad shehaeretz midbar mibbeli nitzotz kedushsha, ella shehu tohu yelel yeshimon, perush melea tinnufet vetuma. vetimtza sheamru bazzohar (chelek 1 16.) ki tohu hu bechinat kelippa achat, uchemo chen yelel yeshimon shehem bechinat hara, shehammakom meshullal mehattov umuchlal mehara. velaze Adonai sibbevo, perush, leshon shemira, veamar leshon atid lomar sheotah shemira sheasa lo lo nedera veodenna tihye tamid. vehakkavvana baze shehotziam mimmekom hara hahu shello nitmeu sham, od shebbeoto makom atzmo keshehaya mevi Adonai hammakkot al mitzrayim haya shomer otam, al derech amro (Shemot 9:6) "umimmikne yisrael" vegomer, "beeretz goshen" vegomer (Shemot 9:26), "ulechol bene yisrael haya or" vegomer (Shemot 10:23), "velo yitten hammashchit" vegomer (Shemot 12:23), vehu amro "yesovvenhu".

Veamro yevonnehu – perush, al yede shennatan lahem tora shehi mekor habbina, shebbaze "yitztzerenhu keishon eno", al derech amro (Mishlei 2:11) "tevuna tintzerekka". veamro "keishon eno" – kemaamar hannavi (Zecharya 2:12) "ki hannogea bachem kenogea bevavat eno". vehakkavvana baze, kederech sheen haayin sovelet negiat etzba haadam bah, vehattaam letzad ki guf haetzba achur vehaayin zakka, veen haruchani sovel haggashmi. vehu sod maamar harashbi (Zohar 10 211:) sheamar: vay lah lenishmeta desavla eshsha nucheraa, perush, haesh shebbo nichneset lehaanishah hi esh nachriyya beerech esh hanneshama, velaze timtza sham shennefesh hatztzaddik titbol baesh hannikra nehar dinur, perush, beod shello nitrachek haesh velo nigsham, shebbaze lo yitztaaru. vehaven sodan shel devarim:

Vehu amro kan "keishon eno", ki hem ruchaniyyim vechol chutz mehem gashmi, velaze yareu veyashchitu bahem afillu negiat heachur, kemo sheyyarea negiat yad beishon ayin. veze haya achar shehinchilam hattora, velaze kadam lomar "yevonnehu" veachar kach amar "yitztzerenhu keishon eno", vehu taam mitzvot lo taase, vehaven:

Od yirtze amro "yevonnehu yitztzerenhu" al derech amram zichronam livracha bemassechet berachot ned:, shelosha tzerichin shemira, veechad mehem hu talmid chacham, vehattaam lefi shehammazzikin mitkanneim mimmaalat ben tora umitgarim bo. laze amar "yevonnehu", perush yitten lo hattora shennikret tevuna (Mishlei 2:11), laze chal alav leshamro keamro "yitztzerenhu" vegomer:

rashi: Yitkachashu li. mechamat yira, yomru li kezavim:
Lishmoa ozen yishshamu li. afillu shello befanay, yaguru mippanay, lemishma aznehem lasur el mishmati:
targum: Bene ammaya yitkadvun li lishmoa oden yishtamun bi:

rashi: Teshi. tishkach. verabbotenu darshu keshebba lehetiv lachem attem machisin lefanav umattishim kocho millehetiv lachem (sifre):
El mechollecha. motziacha merechem, leshon (tehillim 29) "yecholel ayyalot", (tehillim 48) "chil kayyoleda":
ohc: Tzur yeladcha teshi. yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (Zohar chelek 3 207:) beshaa sheratza hakkadosh baruch hu livro et haadam, nimlach bammalachim veamru lefanav "ma enosh" vegomer (tehillim 8:5), venitatztzem Adonai neged divre hammalachim uverao veheenish hammenaggedim, ad kan, velaze kesheyyisrael ovrim retzono machlishim taam ledato shel adam, vehu amro "yeladcha teshi".

Vattishkach el mechollecha. titparesh leshon adi, kederech amro (Hoshea 2:15) "vattaad nizmah vechelyatah", vehakkavvana sheasaacha machol, adi al kol hannivraim, afillu al hammalachim, keamro (tehillim 66:12) "hirkavta enosh leroshenu", o al derech amro (yeshaya 49:3) "yisrael asher becha etpaar", sheasaacha adi lo yitbarach. verazal amru (sifre) derashot uchefattish vegomer.

rashi: Ki yadin Adonai ammo. kesheyyishpot oto beyissurin hallalu haamurot alehem, kemo "ki vam yadin ammim" (Iyov 36) — yeyasser ammim. ki ze eno meshammesh bilshon deha, latet taam laddevarim shel mala, ella leshon techillat dibbur, kemo (Vayikra 25) "ki tavou el haaretz", kesheyyavou alehem mishpatim hallalu veyitnachem hakkabba al avadav lashuv ulerachem alehem:
Yitnecham. leshon hippuch hammachashava lehetiv o lehara:
Ki yire ki azlat yad. kesheyyire ki yad haoyev holechet vechozeket meod alehem, veefes bahem atzur veazuv:
Atzur. nosha al yede otzer umoshel sheyyaatzor bahem:

Azuv. al yede ozev; otzer hu hammoshel haotzer baam shello yelchu mefuzzarim betzetam latztzava al haoyev, belaaz mayynetaynadevar; atzur, hu hannosha bemaatzor hammoshel; azuv, mechuzzak, kemo (Nachum 3) "vayyaazvu yerushalayim ad hachoma"; "ech lo uzzeva ir tehilla" (Yirmeyahu 49), 647:
ohc: Ki yadin Adonai ammo vegomer. achar sheggamar inyan machise el ad sofam, chazar lehavetiach lichlalut yisrael shello leolam yariv ittam. "ki yadin Adonai ammo" – perush, yaamid bemishpat kosot hattarela asher avarum, veyire tzarot sheavru al hatztzaddikim, mehem hargu, mehem sarfu, mehem hifshitum, uvishvil hatztzaddikim asher nitztaaru yitnecham. vehu amro "veal avadav yitnecham" – perush, bishvilam yitnecham lomar day tzarot haggalut. veod, kesheyyire Adonai sheen koach beyisrael lehatztzil atzman mehaggalut, vechoach en batztzaddikim leyasser beshevet musar lemargize el, gam lo yishshaaru beyisrael anashim gedolim uneviim chozim baale ruach hakkodesh veen eshkol" vegomer (Micha 7:1), vehu amro "ki azlat yad", uvaze "efes atzur" – perush, al derech (Shmuel 1 9:17) "yatzor beammi" – perush, sheen koach lammadrichim bedarche Adonai lehadericham, "veazuv" – perush, umitztzad ze nishar haam azuv.

rashi: Ashkir chitztzay middam. haoyev:
Vecharbi tochal besaram:
Middam chalal veshivya. zot tihye lahem meavon dam challe yisrael veshivya sheshshavu mehem:
Merosh parot oyev. mippesha techillat pirtzot haoyev, ki keshehakkabba nifra min haummot poked alehem avonam vaavonot avotehem mereshit pirtza sheppartzu veyisrael:
Yakniuhu. hiviru chamato vekinato:
Betoevot. bemaasim teuvim, kegon mishkav zechur ucheshafim sheneemar bahem toeva:
Erkaem. ermesem, veharebe yesh besefer yechezkel: (6:11): "ureka beraglecha" (25:6): "verakacha beragel":
targum: Vedoshashtinun keafra deara kesin shokin beatet behon refastinun:

rashi: 40 Tigmelu zot. leshon temah, vechi lefanav attem maatzivin sheyyesh beyado lippara mikkem veshehetiv lachem bechol hattovot?
Am naval. sheshshachchu et heasuy lahem:
Velo chacham. lehavin et hannoladot, sheyyesh beyado lehetiv ulehara:
Halo hu avicha kanecha. shekkenaacha, shekkinnencha bekan hasselaim uveeretz chazaka, shettikkencha bechol mine takkana:
Hu ascha. umma baummot:
Vaychonnecha. achare chen bechol mine vasis vechan — mikkem kohanim, mikkem neviim umikkem melachim, kerach shehakkol bo (sifre; chullin 56):
ohc: Hale tigmelu zot. amar leshon gemul lehair shebbimkom sheyyigmeluhu tovot keal kol asher gemalam, hinne hem meshallemim raa tachat tova.

Am naval velo chacham. veen chacham hafekiyyut hannaval, lomar shehagam sheyyihyu am naval mittivam, im hayu chachamim lo hayu nevalim im Adonai, ki hannaval yakkir shechosech miyyosher ach lemachsor velo yihye naval.

Vehu ma sheggamar omer "halo hu avicha" vegomer, sidder arba chalukkot: 1 shehu bara et haadam, ucheneged ze amar "hu avicha". shenit, shekkana otanu laavadim bema shehotzianu miyyad paro vehecheya otanu bammidbar vehevi otanu leeretz melea kol tuv, ucheneged ze amar "kanecha". 3 shettikken otanu tikkun meulle veram betet shechinato betochenu venibba otanu, veze tikkun gadol sheasa otanu keli rauy lekabbel hannevua, ucheneged ze amar "ascha", perush maase chadash millevad habberia harmuza bemaamar "avicha". 4 shettikken otanu hitkonnut hannitzchi lizkot bo chayye olam habba shehu haikkar. vehakkavvana bechol ze hu sheen hannaval ose nevala im geder ze im lo letzad heyoto sachol, vehu amro "naval velo chacham".

rashi: Ki eshsha el shamayim yadi. ki vacharon appi essa yadi el atzmi bishvua:
Veamarti chay anochi. leshon shevua hu, ani nishba chay anochi:
ohc: Ki essa el shamayim vegomer. perush leshon shevua, shennishba binsiut yadav leshannen charbo linkom mitztzarav, vehu amro "im shannoti berak" vegomer, veamro "vetochez bemishpat" perush yitkof bemiddat haddin.

O yirtze, shettaskim gam middat harachamim vetitchazzek bammishpat lehashiv nakam letzare Adonai shehem oyve yisrael, sheenam sonim otanu ella al devekutenu baAdonai, veomer "velimsanay" – hem kat hammaaveret yisrael al dat.

rashi: Hamu goyim. leshon "home" (Melachim 1 1:41):

Tamug. tames, ken patar menachem (Shemot 15:15) "namogu kol yoshve chenaan", vechen (Yechezkel 21:20) "lamug lev", aval dunash patar otam leshon hanaa, vechen (Shmuel 1 14:16) "hehamon namog vayyelech vahalom" vechen kullam:
targum: Bemittan orayta leameh itregashu amaya izdazeu malkevata kad arim kaleh vechad yehav orayta leameh itmogagu yatve ara:

rashi: Yiggalu mosdot tevel. shennivka hattehom, keshennivka yam suf nivkeu kol memot shebbaolam (yalkut shemauni ramaz 161):
Minnishmat. mikkoach neshivat ruach appo:
targum: Veitchaziu umeke yama itgeliu shachlule tevel bimzofita min kodam Adonai mimemar tekof rugezeh:

rashi: Adonai badad yanchennu. nihagam bammidbar badad uvetach:

Veen immo el nechar. lo haya choach beechad mikkol elohe haggoyim lehareot kocho ulehillachem immahem. verabbotenu derashuhu al heatid vechen tirgem unkelos, vaani omer divre tochecha hem lehaid hashshamayim vehaaretz utehe hashshira lahem leed shessofan livgod velo yizkeru lo harishonot sheasa lahem velo hannoladot shehu atid laasot lahem, lefichach tzarich leyashshev haddavar lechan ulechan. vechol hainyan musav al zachar yamut olam beno shenot dar vedar, ken asa lahem vechen atid laasot, kol ze haya lahem lizkor:
ohc: Adonai badad yanchennu. yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (tanchuma, tzav 7) bappasuk (Hoshea 4:17) "chavur atzabbim efrayim hannach lo", kesheyyisrael yesh benehem achdut afillu ovde avoda zara hannach lo, perush al derech (Ester 2:11) "vahanacha lammedinot asa", vehu amro "Adonai badad" perush keshehaam badad leshon bad – Adonai yanchennu.

Veen immo el nechar – perush, hagam shehem ovde avoda zara en Adonai machshiv lo avon ze. umaamar "en immo" titparesh al derech sheddarshu zichronam livracha (socha ma.) befasuk (yirmeya 30:17) "doresh en lah", mikkelal sheyyesh lah, kemo chen bema shellefanenu amar "en immo" mikkelal sheyyesh immo, ella sheen Adonai meyassero al ze.
Od yirtze al ze hadderech: ematay "Adonai badad yanchennu"? keshennigmar chelek hara miyyisrael, vehu amro "veen immo el nechar", shehu chelek hara haddavuk baadam mechet haadam, vehammaskil yavin:

rashi: Kenesher yair kinno. nihagam berachamim uvechemla, kannesher hazze rachmani al banav, veeno nichnas lekinno pitom ad shehu mekashkesh umetaref al banav bichnafav ben ilan leilan, ben socha lachavertah, kede sheyyeoru banav vihe vahem koach lekabbelo (sifre):
Yair kinno. yeorer banav:

Al gozalav yerachef. eno machbid atzmo alehem ella mechofef — nogea veeno nogea (talmud yerushalmi chagiga 2) — af hakkabbah, "shadday lo metzanuhu saggi choach" (Iyov 37) keshebba litten tora lo nigla alehem meruach achat ella mearba ruchot, shenneemar "Adonai missinay ba vezarach misseir lamo hofia mehar paran" (Devarim 33), "eloah mitteman yavo" (Chavakuk 3) — zo ruach reviit (sifre):

Yifros kenafav yikkachehu. keshebba littelam mimmakom lemakom eno notlan beraglav kishar ofot, lefi sheshshear ofot yereim min hannesher shehu magbiah lauf uforeach alehem, lefichach nosan beraglav, mippene hannesher, aval hannesher eno yare ella min hachetz, lefichach nosan al kenafav, omer mutav sheyyikkanes hachetz bi velo yikkanes bevanay, af hakkabba (Shemot 19) "vaessa etchem al kanfe nesharim" — keshennasu mitzrayim acharehem vehissigum al hayyam hayu zorkim bahem chitztzim veavne balisteraot, miyyad "vayyissa malach haelohim vegomer vayyavo ben machane mitzrayim vegomer" (Shemot 14):
ohc: Kenesher yair kinno. razal (sifre) darshu ma sheddarshu bo, (ayyen Rashi zichrono livracha) vechutz middivrehem yitbaer al derech amram zichrono livracha (Vayikra Rabba 17:4) ki kesheyyisrael ovrim retzono en baal haddin nogea bannefashot techilla ella matchil lehairo benige battim achar kach benige begadim vechulei, vehu maamar "kenesher yair kinno" kemo chen Adonai meorer banav, gam meorram kefi hayyecholet sheyyuchelu amod bo, keamram zichrono livracha (Bereshit Rabba 55:2) sheen Adonai menasse haadam ella beshiur sheyyuchal lisbol.

Veamro "yifros kenafav" vegomer, al derech amram (sifre Devarim 3,29) yemino peshuta lekabbel shavim, sheim al yede heara sheyyair Adonai leyisrael yitorru lashuv bitshuva, techef yemino peshuta. veamar "yifros" leatid, ze shiurah, taam sheyyifros kenafav meikara hu bishvil sheyyikkachehu leish yisrael hachozer bitshuva, shezzulat ze lo haya pores kenafav.

Yissaehu al evrato – veamro "yissaehu" vegomer, al derech amram zichronam livracha (Tikkunei Zohar tikun 70 131.) befasuk (Kohelet 10:20) "uvaal kenafayim yagged davar", ki yesh kat achat shel malachim shennikraim baale kenafayim, vesherutam hi shekkol dibbur tov uvirkat Adonai hayyotzet mippi ish yehudi yissauha kanfehem, vehu amro "yissaehu al evrato", perush yissa habba mimmennu mehattov.

rashi: Aspe alemo raot. achbir raa al raa, leshon "sefu shana al shana" (Yeshayahu 29), "sefot harava" (Devarim 29), "olotechem sefu al zivchechem" (Yirmeyahu 7). davar acher — aspe achalle, kemo "pen tissafe" (Bereshit 19):
Chitztzay achalle bam. kol chitztzay ashlim bahem, ukelala zo lefi happuranut livracha hi — chitztzay kalim vehem enam kalim (sifre; sota 9):
Hatztzur tamim poolo. aappi shehu chazak, keshemmevi puranut al ovre retzono, lo beshetef hu mevi ki im bedin, ki tamim poolo:
El emuna. leshallem latztzaddikim tzidkatam laolam habba, veaappi shemmeacher et tagmulam, sofo leammen et devarav:
Veen avel. af larshaim meshallem sechar tzidkatam baolam hazze (80 sifre):
Tzaddik veyashar hu. hakkol matzdikim alehem et dino, vechach rauy veyashar lahem, tzaddik mippi habberiyyot veyashar hu verauy lehatzediko:
ohc: Hatztzur tamim poolo. perush, lefi shekkadam veamar sheesek hattora yesovev tal umatar, laze heir sheim haadam asak battora umezonotav kashim velechem ayin, o sheroe adam sheen alav ol tora umoes belomdeha umoddin lo bemidda gassa achol vesavoa vehoter kayyiudim shenneemru lelomde tora venahafoch hu, lo mippene ze yivat vetivvaled bo chas veshalom minut, ella yatzdik haddin alav veyomar Adonai emet vedino din emet. vehu amro "hatztzur" – perush leshon tokef vechozek, veze yaggid el yad Adonai haroda baadam. af al pi chen tatzdik vetomar "tamim poolo", ze keneged ma sheroe et sheddarko limdod begassa shel tova umaddu bedakka. vegamar omer "ki chol derachav mishpat" – kalal baze gam et sheddarko limdod tova bedakka umaddu lo begassa, "ki chol derachav mishpat", ki lo hevi yissurin al hatztzaddik ad shennitchayyev bahem, velo hevi tova al harshaim ella im zachu lah kefi maasehem.

Vegamar omer el emuna vegomer, veamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (sifre) "el emuna" – leshallem latztzaddikim tzidkatam laolam habba, "veen avel" – leshallem larshaim tzidkatam baolam hazze. vehakkavvana bemaamar ze al pi divrehem sheamru (shocher tov 4) befasuk "natatta simcha velibbi meet deganam vetirosham rabbu" (tehillim 4:8), sheamar david ki meet sheraa shalvat harshaim nasa kal vachomer beatzmo: uma leellu shehem ovre retzono kach vechulei. vehu amro "el emuna", perush, yatzdik hatztzaddik emunat secharo baAdonai kesheyyire middat "veen avel", shehu sechar harshaim shebbaolam hazze al miut zechutam.

Tzaddik veyashar hu. perush, ki haadon Adonai tzevaot bara haolam bemishpat, dichtiv (Mishlei 29:4) "bemishpat yaamid aretz", veamru zichronam livracha (tanchuma Shoftim) shennishba Adonai sheyyaamod haolam al hammishpat, aval matzinu lo shelosh esre middot shekkullam rachamim, veim nishba al hammishpat ma makom larachamim?

Achen hasseder hu al ze hadderech, ki mittechilla kesheyyoshev al hammishpat hu maamid hammishpat al tillo, ucheshebba lehishtallem mitratztze berachamim umitpayyes betachanunim. vehu al derech amro (tehillim 145:17) "tzaddik Adonai bechol derachav vechasid bechol maasav", perush, keshehu ba lehaderich davar hu madricho al kav haddin, aval bemaasav, perush, bishat maase keshebba adam umitchannen – el rachum vechannun yerachamehu. vehu amro tzaddik veyashar hu, perush tzaddik al kav haddin, ucheferush Rashi bema sheamru baggemara (avoda zara 6.) "vedilma noach terefa hava", umetaretz "tamim ketiv beh", umakshu "vedilma tzaddik bidrachav tamim bemaasav", uferesh (Rashi) "tzaddik bidrachav al pi haddin" vechulei, veze bitchilla, aval achar kach "veyashar", perush yashar lifnim mishshurat haddin, keamram zichronam livracha (bava metzia kach:) beferush pasuk "veasita hayyashar vehattov" (Devarim 6:18 518 sham).

rashi: Ketzidkati. kesheyyatzu acharav lammidbar vesamchu al havetachato:
targum: Amar david yeshalminani Adonai kizchuti kivrirut yeday yetiv li Adonai:

rashi: Mehullal ekra Adonai. ketargumo; bekari lo ahodennu, lefi ki meoyvay ani boteach sheivvasha. veyittachen liftor ekra veivvasha, leshon 'hove:
targum: Amar david betushebcha ana metzale kodam Adonai divchol idan mivaale devavi parik yati:

rashi: Ki oto goy ovad etzot hemma veen bahem tevuna. sheillu hayu chachamim yaskilu zot Eicha yirdof vegomer:
ohc: Ki goy ovad etzot. perush, sheen chashash shehaggoy yire veyikkach musar veyomar: uma ellu al shehichisu meat raa ma alta beyadam vechulei veyetiv maasav, vehu amro "ki goy ovad etzot", perush en betivo davar ze veavud hu meetzot kaellu, "veen bahem tevuna" lehavin davar mittoch davar, kemo sheamarnu "lu chachmu yaskilu zot", perush chori haaf habba al yisrael, umizze yavinu leacharitam ma tihye al maalam.

rashi: Vaanotcha tarbeni. higdalta li middat anvetanutecha:
targum: Vihavt li tekof uvefurekanach uvememrach asgitani:

rashi: Esh lefanav telech. bemilchemet gog umagog, dichtiv bemilchamto (Yechezkel 38:22) "venishpatti itto bedever uvedam vegeshem shotef veavne elgavish esh vegafrit":
targum: Esha kodamoy tehalech umetzalhava chazor chazor meikoy:

rashi: Vayyitgaash vattirash. lo al nissim sheeruhu neemar, ella al nissim shennaasu leyisrael, verosh hammikra mechubbar al sofo:
Ki chara lo. 'ki meshammesh kan bilshon 'kaasher, vechen pitrono, ucheshechara lo mippene machisav, nitgaasha venitraasha haaretz, umosdot hashshamayim ragzu veraashu:
targum: Veitregifat veitregishat ara shachlule shemaya zau veitrechinu are tekef rugezeh:

rashi: Sali umetzudati. leshon chozek hem, 'sela kemashmao, 'metzuda hi metzudat yearim, shekkorin 491 109, veal shem hannes shennaasa lo besela hammachloket (Shmuel 1 23:28), vehammetzudot bachorsha:
Umefalleti li. mefalleti im tzeva yisrael bammilchama, ufeamim shehu mefallet li kesheani levaddi, kegon min yishbi benov (Shmuel 2 21:16):
targum: Vaamar Adonai tukefi veruchetzani umesheziv yati:

rashi: Michutz teshakkel cherev. michutz lair teshakkelem cherev geyasot.

Umechadarim ema. keshebboreach venimlat chadre libbo nekufim alav mechamat ema, vehu met veholech ba (sifre); davar acher, umechadarim ema — babbayit tihye emat dever, kema shenneemar (Yirmeyahu 9) "ki ala mavet bechallonenu", vechen tirgem unkelos; davar acher, michutz teshakkel cherev — al ma sheasu vachutzot, shenneemar "umispar chutzot yerushalayim samtem mizbechot labboshet" (sham 11); umechadarim ema, al ma sheasu vechadre chadarim, shenneemar "asher zikne vet yisrael osim bachoshech ish bechadre maskito" (Yechezkel 8):
Zechor yemot olam. me asa varishonim shehichisu lefanav:

Binu shenot dor vador. dor enosh shehetzif alehem me okyanus vedor hammabbul sheshshetafam. davar acher — lo netattem levavchem al sheavar, binu shenot dor vador — lehakkir lehabba, sheyyesh beyado lehetiv lachem ulehanchil lachem yemot hammashiach vehaolam habba (80 sifre):
Sheal avicha. ellu hanneviim shennikraim avot, kemo shenneemar (Melachim 2 2) beeliyyahu "avi avi rechev yisrael" (sifre):
Zekenecha. ellu hachachamim:
Veyomru lach. harishonot:
ohc: Zechor yemot olam. amar arba chalukkot keneged arbaa devarim sheamar bappasuk shellifne ze. keneged amro "halo hu avicha" sheramaz bo shehu habbore, amar "zechor yemot olam" shehem sheshet yeme vereshit, sham yimtza ki hu hayyotzer hu habbore. ucheneged amro "kanecha" sheramaz litziat mitzrayim ushear hattovot shebbahem kana otanu, amar "binu shenot dor vador" sheyyitbonen bema sheppaal Adonai bashshanim shel shene dorot, shehem dor hayyotze mimmitzrayim vedor revii hannichnas laaretz, uvahem yakkir maasav yitbarach leam yisrael shebbahem kanecha. ucheneged amro "ascha" shehu tikkun elyon shepperashnu bo shennatan shechinato betochenu venibba otanu, amar "sheal avicha veyaggedcha" – avicha hem hanneviim, vechen pershuha rabbotenu zichronam livracha (sifre). ucheneged "vaychonnecha" shepperashnuha al hachanot olam habba, amar "zekenecha veyomru lach" – perush hem chachme yisrael hammakkirim bahachanat haddavar vehammussag laolam habba, hem yomru lach.

rashi: Ki chelek Adonai ammo. lamma kol zot? lefi shehaya chelko kavush benehem veatid latzet, umi hu chelko? ammo. umi hu ammo?

Yaakov chevel nachalato. vehu hashshelishi baavot, hameshullash beshalosh zechuyyot, zechut avi aviv uzechut aviv uzechuto, hare 3, kachevel hazze shehu asuy beg gedilim, vehu uvanav hayu lo lenachala, velo yishmael ben avraham, velo esav beno shel yitzchak (80 sifre):
Yevoshu kol ovde fesel. dichtiv (Yeshayahu 2:18) "vehaelilim kalil yachalof":
Hammithallim. hammitpaarim laavodat gillulim:
targum: Yivhatun kol palche pisla demishtabbechin betaavata veyisgedun kodamoy kol amaya palche taavata:

rashi: Asher chelev zevachemo. hayu otan elohot ochlim, shehayu makrivim lifnehem, veshotin yen nesicham:
Yehi alechem sitra. oto hatztzur yihye lachem machase umistor:
ohc: Veamro asher chelev zevachemo vegomer – hu maamar Adonai neged divrehem, veharedafat haddevarim hu al ze hadderech "ki yadin" vegomer veyitnachem al ma shessavlu avadav, veod ki yire ki azlat yad vegomer veamar vegomer, veheshiv Adonai "asher chelev vegomer yakumu", umuvan haddavar meatzmo hakkaratam shel ochle zevachemo ki lo yoilu velo yatztzilu, veyakkiru ki Adonai hu levaddo moshia, vehu ma sheggamar omer "reu atta ki ani" vegomer.

Yakumu veyazeruchem vegomer. lefi sheyyesh shene mine ovde avoda zara: yesh sheoved avoda zara leeloah gamur, veyesh sheoved avoda zara leemtzai, veal shenehem tzivva Adonai kemo shepperashnuhu bimkomo (Shemot 20:4). laze amar keneged haoved avoda zara leemtzai amar "yakumu veyazeruchem" – ezer bealma, ki lesibba zo asauha laazor lehoil benehem uven elohe olam, ucheneged haoved avoda zara leeloah gamur omer "yehi alechem sitra".

rashi: Batztzar li ekra Adonai vayyishma vegomer. kach derech leshon hove, medabber leshon avar uleshon atid befaam achat:
targum: Amar david kad aka li ana metzale kodam Adonai ukedam elahay ana mitchanen umekabbel mehechaleh tzeloti uvauti kodamohi mitabbeda:

rashi: Merive. middoeg, meachitofel, veshaul, vehazzifim:

Tishmereni lerosh goyim. tzefantani lechach. umidrash aggada; amar david: ribbono shel olam, hatztzileni middino shel yisrael, sheim athu o erde et yisrael baavodato, ani neenash, ella lerosh happelishtim tesimeni, vehem yaavduni, vaalehem lo eenash:
targum: Uteshezvinani mippalgut ama temanayni resha leammaya ama dela yedait yiflechunani:

rashi: Yaarof kammatar likchi. zo hi haedut shettaidu — sheani omer bifnechem tora shennatatti leyisrael shehi chayyim laolam kematar ze shehu chayyim laolam (80 sifre); kaasher yaarfu hashshamayim tal umatar:
Yaarof. leshon yattif, vechen (Tehillim 65) "yirafun dashen", (Devarim 33) "yaarfu tal":
Tizzal kattal. shehakkol semechim bo, lefi shehammatar yesh bo atzavim labberiyyot, kegon holche derachim umi shehaya voro male yayin (sifre):
Kisirim. leshon ruach seara, ketargumo "keruche mitra", ma haruchot hallalu machazikim et haasavim umegaddelin otam, af divre tora megaddelin et lomdehen:
Vechirvivim. tippe matar. nire li al shem sheyyore kechetz nikra reviv, kema deat omer "rove kashshat" (Bereshit 21):
Deshe. 503, atifat haaretz mechussa veyerek:
Esev. kelach echad karuy esev, vechol min vamin leatzmo karuy esev:
ohc: Yaarof kammatar likchi. perush, al derech amram zichronam livracha (avot 3,17) "im en kemach en tora" vechulei, yechavven hakkatuv bemaamar ze ki kemo she noten matar lazun ulefarnes, kemo chen tzerichin hem lilmod tora, veze shiur hakkatuv: yattif kemo sheani mattif hammatar likchi, ucheillu amar "yaarof likchi kammatar", sheen hakkadosh baruch hu shoel mehaadam lilmod tora ad shemmechin lo kede parnasato, umimmotza davar atta lamed sheim lo yattifu mippihem tippe tora en chefetz Adonai latet matar. vehu ma shepperashnu bemaamar hattanna (avot 3,17) "im en kemach en tora" perush, im raita sheen kemach da sheen tora. vetaam shekkinna lelimmud tora lashon ze "yaarof", ledammot lemaase hammatar shehu mattif.

Od yirmoz ki kederech shehammatar meniato tesovev mita lehaadam, kemo chen meniat hattora taarfennu, al derech amro (yeshaya 1:19-20) "im tovu vegomer veim temaanu vegomer cherev" vegomer. vechafal lomar bemillot shonot "likchi imrati", keneged shene torot – tora shebbichtav vetora shebbeal pe. keneged tora shebbichtav amar "likchi" she netanah miyyado leyad moshe ketuva beetzba elohim, vahagam shello natan ella aseret haddibberot, bahem kelulim kol ma shekkatuv besefer hattora kemaamaram zichronam livracha (Zohar chelek 2 93:). ucheneged tora shebbeal pe amar "imrati" shehem devarim shennimseru bemaamar pe el pe. vechinna letora shebbichtav matar uletora shebbeal pe tal, lefi shehattora shebbichtav hi haikkar visod kol davar, vetora shebbeal pe hem tikkunim vedikdukim sheenam meforashim bah ella nirmazim, vehu inyan shellakach hakkatuv bedimyonah sheddimma tora shebbichtav lematar shehu yesod veikkar hakkol, vetora shebbeal pe letal shehu tikkun vehaamada ma sheasa hammatar kemo shehi tora shebbeal pe letora shebbichtav.

Od yirtze al derech amram anshe emet (beer hetev 15 70 238 beshem 253) ki mitzvat esek tora shebbichtav enah ella bayyom velo ballayla, vechen amru babbarayta (midrash shocher tov 19, 7) shemmoshe beotan arbaim yom shehaya etzel Adonai haya makkir ben hayyom lallayla mehallimmud shehaya Adonai melammedo, keshehaya melammedo mishna haya yodea shehu layla, veyesh taam baddavar sheen limmud mikra ballayla.

Velaze kinna tora shebbichtav lematar, sheeno tamid ella bimot haggeshamim aval lo bimot hachamma, vetze ulemad ma sheera lerava (taanit kad:) al shehitriach lehorid geshamim shello beittam, kemo chen hammikra hu davka bizmanno hammugbal lo yom velo layla. vedimma tora shebbeal pe letal, kemo shehattal lo mafsik kayitz vechoref yomam velayla, kemo chen tora shebbeal pe en lecha zeman sheeno zemannah, veal takshe shehattal yafrichennu hashshemesh ki en hammenia mitztzad hattal:

Kisirim vegomer. yitbaer al derech amram babbarayta (midrash Mishlei 10): amar rabbi yishmael, keshemmaamidin et haadam bedin, im yesh beyado mikra shoalin mimmennu lamma lo shana, veim yesh beyado mishna shoalin mimmennu talmud, vechen al ze hadderech. hinne meomek divre habbarayta mochichim haddevarim shemmi sheyyesh beyado mikra en shoalin mimmennu maase merkava, ella madrega achat kefi yechalto yoter mimma shettarach, shealav haya litroach gader lemala mizzo. vehu omer "kisirim vegomer vechirvivim" vegomer, perush, keshiur sheyyamtir Adonai tippin ketannim al haddeshe shehu katan, vechirvivim shehem tippin gedolim veavim ale esev shehu gadol sheyyachol lisbol, kedimyon ze mitzvot hattora kol echad kefi koach sheyyachol lehassig. veyesh baze lehakel ulehachmir: lehakel al mi sheeno yachol lehassig yoter, ulehachmir al mi sheyyachol harebe, sheshshoalin mimmennu hakkol vaafillu maase merkava.

rashi: Kadcha. baara:
Vattikad. bachem ad hayesod:
Vattochal eretz vivulah. artzechem vivulah (sifre):
Vattelahet. yerushalayim hameyussedet al heharim, shenneemar (Tehillim 125) yerushalayim harim saviv lah:

targum: Yetanun angele meroma tzidketeh veyechmun kol amaya aykareh:
Vesanay tevarta kodamay mechazre kedal baale devavay veshetzetinun:
Min biglal deishtae lechulehon shivchatach bemaalane tare chenishat tzion adutz befurekanach:
Elaha daavad pureanuta li vetabbar ammaya dekayymin leavasha li techotay:
Vaatev Adonai li kizchuti kivriruti kodam memreh:
Shelach neviohi melech takif deyatev bitkof ruma dabbarni shezvani meammin sagiin:
Vahavet shelim bidchalteh vahavet natar nafshi mechovin:
Achle min shemaya Adonai veilaa arim memreh:
Memra dayya tzevaot besaadana tekof lana elaha deyaakov lealmin:
Are at hu mare nehore deyisrael Adonai vayay yafkinani mechashocha linhora veyechezinani bealma daatid lemete letzadikaya:
Veitgele bigvureteh al keruvin kalilin vedabbar bitkef al kanfe rucha:
Bechen al nisa ufurekana di tabed limshichach velishara deamach deishtaarun yodun kol ammaya umaya velishanaya veyemrun let elaha ela Adonai are let bar minach veamach yemrun let detakef ela elahana:
Veappek lirvacha yati shezvani are itrei vi:
Masge lemebad purekan im malkeh veaved tevu limshicheh ledavid ulezareh ad alma:
Are chol dinohi gelan lekibbeli lemebadhon ukeyamohi la adit minhon:
Edkar ovade elaha arum edkar min lekadmin perishvatach:
Al ken ode kodamach Adonai beammaya velishmach emar tushebchan:
Meshave riglay kalilin keayalata veal bet tukefe yekiminani:
Are vememrach asge mashiryan uvememar elahay achabbesh kol kerakkin takifin:
Ufarki misanay veal dekayymin leavasha li tagberinani migog umimashiryat ammin chatufin deimeh teshezvinani:
Veshetzetinun ugemartinun vela yechilu lemekam unefalu ketilin techot parsat riglay:
Yekadmuni beyom tiltuli vahavat memra dayya semach li:
Are netarit orchan detaknan kodam Adonai vela halichit birsha kodam elahay:
Useadtani vechela lemebad kerava tevarta ammaya dekaymin leavasha li techotay:
Ushelach machateh kegirin uvadrinun barkin veshagshinun:
Ant hu elaha aved perishan hodata veamaya ushenach:
Uredafit sanay veshetzetinun vela tavet ad di gemartinun:
Anane yekara vaamitta chazor chazor di leh tzidketa vedina atar di mechavan kureseh:
Veyat ama bet yisrael demitkeran bealma haden am chashich at atid lemifrak uvememrach takifa demitgabberin alehon tamich:

bart: Arbaa achim vechulei. hu haddin afillu nashe tuva nammi, im efshar besippukayhu, harshut beyado lichnos et kullan. vehay denakat arba, etza tova kamashma lan, arba in tefe lo, ki hechi denimtayhu ona bechodesh:

Biatah o chalitzatah shel achat mehen poteret tzaratah. velo meyabbem letarvayhu, dichtiv (Devarim 25) asher lo yivne et bet achiv, bayit echad hu bone veeno bone shene battim. velo chalitz letarvayhu, shekkol sheeno ole leyibbum eno ole lachalitza, vehoil vetarvayhu ki hadade lo salke leyibbum kidamrinan bayit echad hu bone, hachi nammi lo salke lachalitza:
Choletz lappesula. velo yifsol et hakkeshera lichhunna, shehachalutza pesula lichhunna, velo yishpoch adam me boro vaacherim tzerichin lahen:
Vechayyavin bakkarban. shebbaal eshet ach shello bimkom mitzva. vehavvalad kasher mimma nafshach:
Vechayyavin asham taluy. shekkol davar shechayyavin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat, chayyavin al lo hoda shello asham taluy:
Reviit mayim limtzora. dichtiv (Vayikra 14) veshachat et hatztzippor haechat el keli cheres al mayim chayyim, lemayim sheddam hatztzippor nire bahem, veshiaru chachamim reviit hallog:

Reviit shemen lenazir. lelechem nezirut. ureviit lo kaddish lihyot keli sharet mishshum reviit mayim shel metzora, deha chutz hu. velo mishshum lechem shel nazir, deen lechem shel nazir kadosh ella bishchitat hazzevach. ella mippene shebbah haya moded lachavitte kohen gadol reviit shemen lechol challa vechalla, shehen shetem esre challot veniskehen shelosha luggin shemen:
Chatzi log mayim lesota. dichtiv (Bamidbar 5) velakach hakkohen mayim kedoshim bichli chares, chatzi log mayim haya memalle min hakkiyyor:

Chatzi log shemen letoda. halacha lemoshe missinay, vechen reviit shel nazir. vachatzi log nammi lo mishshum chatzi log mayim shel sota vachatzi log shemen shel toda hu dekadosh lihyot keli sharet. ella mippene shebbo mechallek chatzi log shemen lechol ner vener shel menora:
En lah ella luggah. log echad lechol shishshim issaron. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov:

Shishsha luggim lefar. dehaynu chatzi hahin, kedichtiv (sham 15) balul bashshemen chatzi hahin. vearbaa leayil, dehaynu shelishit hahin. ushelosha lecheves, dehaynu reviit hahin, shehahin shenem asar luggin:

Mechatzi log lechol ner. shetztzarich sheyyitten bah middatah shettehe doleket veholechet meerev ad boker. veshiaru chachamim chatzi log shemen lelele tekufat tevet haarukkim. vechen haya noten bechol ner bechol layla. veim kavta, nifsela otah petila vehashshemen millehadlik bahen od, ella mesiran venoten chatzi log shemen acher ufetila chadasha umadlik:
Bichle gelalim. kelim asuyin miggille habbakar. dela chashive chelim leinyan tuma:
Lo vedafnot hakkelim velo veshule hammachatz. mishshum deshivre chelim ninhu:
Velo vimgufat hechavit. delav lehishtammesh betochah avida ella kissuy lechavit:
Bechafnav. shello yemalle chafnav mayim veyishpoch al yede chavero:
Sheen memalleim. milluy mayim chayyim lekaddesh bahen me chattat shel efer para. dichli bainan, dichtiv (Bamidbar 19) mayim chayyim el keli:
Veen mekaddeshim. netinat haefer al gabbe hammayim:
Veen mazzin. shettovel haezov bichli kede lehazzot:
Tzamid patil. shivre kele cheres shehikkifan tzamid patil umunnachin beohel hammet, en matztzilin al ma shebbetochan:
Sheen matztzilin. kemo veen matztzilin. vedugmato beferek kamma devetza, sheefer kira muchan hu. ufershu baggemara, hachi kaamar, veefer kira muchan hu:

Miyyad keli cheres. im nafal sheretz betoch keli cheres, nitma kol ma shebbaaviro, chutz mikkelim veadam sheen mittammein meavir keli cheres, dichtiv (Vayikra 11) kol asher betocho yitma mikkol haochel asher yeachel, ochalin umashkin mittammein meavir keli cheres, veen adam vechelim mittammein meavir keli cheres. veim shivre kelim netunim betannur shel cheres vesheretz battannur, en hashshevarim matztzilin al hoochalim shebbetochan:
Achotah keshehi yevimtah. achotah shel erva keshehi yevimtah eshet achi baalah, keshennofelet immah leyibbum:
O choletzet o mityabbemet. delav achot zekukato hi, deerva lo ramya kammeh:

Vechen hamegaresh et ishto vechulei. baggemara parech, vechen salka datach. ella ema aval hamegaresh et ishto vechulei, sheachot gerusha middivre tora ulechach petura min hachalitza umin hayyibbum, vaachot chalutza middivre sofrim ulechach choletzet velo mityabbemet:

Kefarashat vayhi binsoa haaron. lefi sheotah parasha hi chashuva kesefer bifne atzmo. vechach amru bammidrash (vehu baggemara shabbat daf 116. tosfot yom tov), chatzva ammudeha shiva (Mishlei 9) ellu shiva sifre torot, shessefer vaydabber nechelak lishlosha chalakim, vearbaa sefarim acherim, hare shiva:
Megilla shekkatuv bah. kelomar yeria shel sefer tora, kevan shennichtav bah shemonim vechamesh otiyyot, nitkaddesha umetammea et hayyadayim:
Kohelet eno metamme et hayyadayim. mippene shechachmato shel shelomo hi, velo beruach hakkodesh neemra:
Kedivre ven azzay kach nechleku vechach gamru. vechen halacha:
Hammachnis yadav levayit hamenugga yadav techillot. posel echad bechullin, derishon ose sheni bechullin. umetamme echad ufosel echad batteruma. umetamme shenayim ufosel echad bakkodesh:
Kol hametamme vegadim bishat maggao. kegon zovo shel zav verukko, vechol hane ditnan beferek batra dezavim, shehannogea bahen metamme begadim bishat maggao:

Vechi heach efshar lahem lihyot techilla. sheen rauy lihyot techilla ella hannogea beav hattuma. veim naga beyadav beav hattuma, nitma kol gufo. hilkach en beyadi limtzo [lachem] yadayim techilla, chutz mehammachnis yadav levayit hamenugga, sheim hichnis yadav lo nitma kullo. vehametamme begadim bishat maggao, sheaf al pi shehu chashuv av hattuma letamme begadim velaasot rishon vesheni, eno chashuv av hattuma letamme adam, aval metamme et hayyadayim shennagu vo lihyot techillot. veen halacha kerabbi akiva:
Et shennitma veav hattuma. kelomar, ochalim vechelim shennitmeu beav hattuma:
Metammein et hayyadayim. velo ochalim vechelim shennitmeu bemashkin. deen sheni ose sheni. vahalacha kachachamim:
Bamme hayta hattuma. shel tannur, beav hattuma o vemashke:

Verabbi shimon poter. taama derabbi shimon, dichtiv (Vayikra 18) veishsha el achotah lo tikkach litzror, beshaa shennaasu tzarot zo lazo, kegon hacha sheshshetehen zekukot lo leyibbum, lo yehe lecha likkuchin lo vazo velo vazo. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Hammevi get mimmedinat hayyam. tzarich sheyyomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam. vetama meforash begittin, lemar mishshum sheen bekiin lishmah, ulemar sheen edim metzuyin lekayyemo:
Lo yissa et ishto. mishshum deaddibbureh samchinan:
Met haragtiv vechulei. hoil veal eduto nisset, ikka lezut sefatayim, shemma enav natan bah veheid edut sheker aleha. aval tinnase leacher, deishsha nisset beed echad:

Rabbi yehuda omer haragtiv lo tinnase ishto. beeduto afillu leacher, mippene shehu rasha, vehattora amra al tashet rasha ed. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda, dekayma lan en adam mesim atzmo rasha, deadam karov etzel atzmo. umehemninan leh shenneherag, aval lo mehemninan leh bemay deamar shehu harago. vehilkach afillu ki amar haragtiv tinnase ishto:
Haragnuhu tinnase ishto. meforash baggemara, beomer ani hayiti im horgav aval ani lo haragtiv:
Beneder. shennadra hanaa mibbaalah velo hefer lah, uvat lechacham lehattir lah velo matza petach lacharata:
Lo yissaenna. mishshum chashad:
Shehu vet din. kelomar, meun o chalitza lo asa chacham ze bichidi, mishshum dekayma lan chalitza umeunim bishnayim ushelosha lo chashide. aval hetter nedarim beyachid mumche:
Vechullan. hechacham vehammevi get vehammeid al haishsha lehassiah, ditnan behu lo yichnos, im hayu lahen nashim bishat maase, vametu achar kach, muttarot lehinnase lahem dehashta lekka chashad:
Vechullan. hannashim hallalu:
Shennisseu laacherim. kesheasarah hechacham o kesheheid haed shemmet baalah, umetu habbealim hashsheniyyim:
Muttarot linnase. lechacham velaed velammevi get:

Vechullan muttarot livnehem velaachehen. shel ellu hammattirim otan. veenan asurot ella lahem levaddam, deen adam chote bishvil beno o bishvil achiv. vechol hane deamrinan lo yichnos, im kanas eno motzi, chutz mehannitan al eshet ish, sheim hotziuha bet din mittachat baalah beedim ureaya berura, afillu im kanas yotzi. veim bau ede davar mechoar bilvad, kegon sherau adam yotze vehi chogeret besinnar o adam yotze vehi omedet meal hammitta vechayyotze vaze, im kanas lo yotzi. veim leachar shebbau ede davar mechoar yatza kala velo pasik, sheamad hakkol yom vachetzi, im kanas yotzi, ella im ken hayu lo banim mimmenna, sheaz eno motzi kede shello lehotzi laaz al banav:
O shemmicha vahen et hammiddot. lachluchit shennidbeka bahen, veenah yotza ella vedochak. lehachi tane leshon michuy, kemo michuy keravav ditnan bifsachim perek ellu devarim [daf sach]:
