Posel bachadashim. deaf al pi shehem nekiyyim, en regilut lehishtammesh bahem ad sheyyedichum techilla. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Hare hu cheechad min haachin. velo hifsid chelko bishvil shechalatz. desalka datach amina likneseh hoil vehifsidah miyyibbum, sheppesalah al haachim:
Zacha benichse achiv. vaafillu gershah lemachar, deyakum al shem achiv amar rachamana, vahare kam:
Nechasim shel av. dichtiv vehaya habbechor, ma bechor en lo bechayye haav, af yavam en lo bechayye haav. veen ken halacha, ella hakkones et yevimto zacha benichse achiv vaafillu bimkom av:
Asur bikrovoteha. keillu hi ishto, vechol kerovot hanneesarot mechamat ishsha gemura asurot midderabbanan bachalutza:
Bizman shehi kayyemet. aachotah kae velo ashshear arayot:
Muttar adam bikrovat tzarat chalutzato. velo amrinan tzara kachalutza sheyyehe asur baachot tzarat chalutzato kemo shehu asur baachot chalutzato:

Veasur betzarat kerovat chalutzato. reuven chalatz lelea, verachel nesua lenachri velah tzara, umet hannachri, asura otah tzara liruven. vetama have, shebbizman shellea choletzet, molicha rachel achotah immah levet din, vechulle alma lo yade lehe minnayhu chalitz, veikka desavre dilrachel chalitz, vechi nasiv tzarat rachel dehaynu tzarat kerovat chalutzato amre tzarat chalutzato nasiv, deinhu savre sherachel vetzaratah neshe achiv hayu, shehare chalatz lerachel. aval en hayevama molicha tzaratah immah bizman shecholetzet, hilkach ki nasiv achot hatztzara lo amre achot chalutza nasiv:

Lo tachalotz vechulei. mefaresh baggemara taama, dichtiv (Devarim 25) veim lo yachpotz haish lakachat et yevimto vealta yevimto vegomer, ha im yachpotz yeyabbem, kol haole leyibbum ole lachalitza vechol sheeno ole leyibbum eno ole lachalitza:
Betulot. gazrinan attu beulot, vaarusot attu nesuot, vechen halacha. vehanach shelosha chodashim hem tishim yom chutz miyyom shemmet bo baalah o shennitgarsha bo vechutz miyyom shennitarsa bo:
Hannesuot yitarsu. detaama daasura kede lehavechin ben zera rishon lezera sheni, shello teled ben safek ben tisha larishon safek ben shiva laacharon, uvaarusot lekka lememar hachi:
Vehaarusot yinnasu. deha lo iabbur merishon:

Chutz mearusa shebbihuda. shehayu meyachadin et hakkalla veet hechatan bihuda kodem kenisatan lachuppa kede sheyyihye ragil umesachek immah velo yihyu boshim ze mizze bivilat mitzva, lechach chayshinan shemma baal:

Kol hannashim yitarsu. mishshum derabbi yehuda lo maflig ben almana ligrusha umattir laalmana leares afillu toch sheloshim yom shel yeme evlah, ata rabbi yose leifluge aleh beha, veasar laalmana leares toch sheloshim shel yeme evlah:

Par habba al kol hammitzvot. al achat mikkol hammitzvot. kegon horu bet din shechelev muttar. vezehu par helem davar shel tzibbur shebbammikra, usemicha ketiva beh (Vayikra 4) vesamchu zikne haeda et yedehem al rosh happar, ushelosha mizzikne bet din hayu somchin alav:
Vesair hammishtalleach. laazazel, ketiv beh (sham 16) vesamach aharon et shete yadav al rosh hassair hachay:
Seire avoda zara. dichtiv befarashat shelach lecha vechi tishgu kulei. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Kol karbenot hayyachid teunim semicha. deikkar semicha bekarban yachid hu dichtiva (sham 3) vesamach yado al rosh karbano:
Hayyoresh somech. im hitnaddev aviv bekarban ola ushelamim umet, beno somech alav:
Umevi nesachim. shel karban:
Umemir. im hemirah bivhema acheret, temurato chala aleha ushetehen kedoshot keillu hemirah aviv:

Hayu achin. af mishshum eshet ach vechulei. af al gav dekayma lan en issur chal al issur, it leh lehay tanna divissur kolel veissur mosif veissur bat achat ki hacha, issur chal al issur, vechayyav lehavi karban al kol issur veissur:
Umafrishin otan. shello lachazor levaalehen:
Shemma meubbarot hen. vehavveladot mamzerim, uvainan havechana ben zera kasher lezera pasul, shello yitlu haubbarim bevaalehen:
Veim hayu chohanot. benot kohanim:
Nifselu mitteruma. milleechol bitrumat bet aviha afillu achar mitat baalah, veaf al pi shenneensa:
Shenatot hayu vahin. lo haya sham ella hin, uvo hayu simanim masmerot o pegimot:
Ad kan lefar. chatzi hahin:
Ad kan leayil. shelishit hahin:
Vead kan lecheves. reviit hahin. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:

Vechi me haya hahin meshammesh. shello haya bammikdash davar sheyyihye tzarich lehin shalem, shelleolam lo nitztarchu lahin ella beshemen hammishcha bime moshe veoto shemen adayin hu kayyam veomed, veim ken lo hayu tzerichim lahin:
Ella midda yetera. hayta sham lehashelim hashsheva middot:
Leminchat kohen gadol. hayu lah shelosha luggin shemen, log umechetza shacharit velog umechetza ben haarbayim:
Vehakkaflotot. karti. chatzir bilshon mikra, baaravi 627, uvelaaz 592:
Vehappitma shellahen. kemin pitma shel rimmon shebberoshan, vehave shomer umitztaref:
Vehaammud shehu mechuvvan keneged haochel. hu hallev shebbabbatzal shehazzera nolad bekatzehu:
Sharshe hachazarim. hashshoresh shel chazeret, hi chassa bilshon gemara, vechen baaravi, uvelaaz 49:
Vehannafus. min tzenon hu, ella shealav domim laale hallefet:
Vehassiv shello. peresh harambam, shebbetzidde rosh hatztzenon noladim gidim dakkim kemo chutin, vechotchin otan hammochrim bayyad beshaa shemmochrin otan, venisharim mehen, vehen nikraim siv:
Vehamminta. kach shemah belaaz 106, uvaaravi 240:
Vehappegam. 211 velaaz, uvaaravi 67:
Sheakaran. kede leshatlan bemakom acher:
Vehashshidra shel shibbolet. chut haemtzai, shehachittim devukim bo:
Vehallevush shellah. vehakkerum sheal garin hachitta. vechol ellu shomrim hen lapperi:
Hassig shel retzafit. avak hannidbak al rashe hayerakot veratzuf bahem kekure akkavish. vegam hu chashuv shomer lapperi. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:

Natal et harishonim lemakom echad. shennatal et harishonim befachot merviit, kegon daatu mishsheyare tohora, vetzarich littol et hashsheniyyim. venatal et harishonim bezavit zo, usheniyyim bezavit acheret:
Venafal kikkar shel teruma. lammakom shennaflu rishonim:
Tame. hakkikkar. vehu haddin im naga hakkikkar bemayim rishonim sheal yadav, shehakkikkar tame:

Al hashsheniyyim tahor. dishniyyim tehorim hen. aval natal rishonim usheniyyim lemakom echad venafal kikkar shel teruma al hammayim, tame, kidkatane sefa sheen hashsheniyyim metaharim ella mayim sheal gabbe hayyad, kelomar harishonim sheal gabbe yadav, hashsheniyyim metaharim, aval harishonim shennaflu laaretz, en hashsheniyyim metaharim:
Venimtza al yadav kesam o tzeror. af al pi shehen refuyin velo chaytze, shehammayim baim bahem:

Yadav temeot. af al pi shennatan bahen et hashsheniyyim. mishshum demayim sheal hatztzeror nitmeu mechamat yadav, veen hammayim hashsheniyyim metaharim ella mayim sheal gabbe hayyad, velo mayim sheal gabbe tzeror vekesam. perush acher, venimtza al yadav kesam o tzeror, vechol davar hachotzetz bintilat yadayim, af al pi shennatan al yadav mayim sheniyyim, temeot hayyadayim, velo taharu mechamat hammayim sheniyyim, sheen hammayim hashsheniyyim metaharim ella hammayim sheal gabbe hayyad, lo hayyadayim atzman:

Kol shehu mibberiyyat hammayim tahor. kegon yavchushim veyattushim haggedelim bammayim, im naflu al hayyadayim bishat netila, enam chotztzim, hoil vehen mibberiyyat hammayim. veen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:
Me reviit. mayim sheyyesh bahen shiur reviit hallog, shehu betza umechetza:

Notnim layyadayim leechad af lishnayim. lechad bainan mittechilla reviit. af lishnayim, im haya bo mittechilla reviit venatal harishon veachar kach hashsheni, af al gav delo haya reviit gabbe hashsheni, shappir dame, hoil umishsheyare tohora atu. verambam peresh, dedavka mayim sheniyyim hu delo bainan reviit lechol chad vechad, hoil uchevar nitharu yadav mishshetifa rishona, aval bemayim rishonim, en pachot merviit lechol echad. verabbotay lo pershu ken:

Machatzit log lishlosha o learbaa. lefum shiura dirviit lishnayim, haya day birviit umechetza lishlosha, ella kevan dinfishe gavre chayshinan shemma lo yedakdeku yafe littol ad happerek, shekkol echad metzamtzem bammayim mippene chavero. umihu i ikka reviit umechetza, venatal harishon mehem chatzi reviit, ha vadday deyoil reviit hannishar lashshenayim haacharonim, daafillu bitchilla saggi lishnayim birviit, kol shekken hasheta daatu mishsheyare tohora. vechi lo mahane hacha, hane mille hecha delo nishar lashshenayim haacharonim reviit:
Uvilvad shello yifchot laacharon shebbahen merviit. sheyyihye bakkeli beshaa shehaacharon notel et yadav, reviit. veen halacha kerabbi yose:

Mosifin al hashsheniyyim veen mosifin al harishonim. din netilat yadayim shetztzarich littol yadav ad happerek, uleachar shennatal yadav bishtifa achat af al gav deyadav tehorot, im kinnach otam bemappa, mikkol makom im chozer venogea bammayim sheal hammappa, yadav temeot, veim naga bahen kikkar shel teruma, nitma, ulechach orcheh daavid shetifa acheret bemayim sheniyyim letaher hammayim harishonim sheal gabbe yadav. vehasheta kaamar deim natan hammayim sheniyyim velo higgiu lapperek, yachol lehosif alehem velishpoch mayim bammakom shello shafach sham techilla, veyittaharu hammayim harishonim sheal gabbe yadav. aval al harishonim im lo higgiu lapperek, eno yachol lehosif, ella tzarich lenaggev yadav velachazor velishpoch bevat achat mayim sheyyaggiu lapperek:
Shennifselu mishshetiyyat habbehema. kegon mechamat sirchon. aval shennifselu mechamat tit, afillu bekarka pesulim:
Bechelim pesulim. delo takkun rabbanan netila ella biruyin lishtiyyat behema:
Bekarka kesherim. lehatebil hayyadayim. deha mikve ninhu vechol gufo tovel bahen, yadav lo kol shekken:
Komos. 50 belaaz:
Vekankantom. 267. umazhir keen zechuchit:
Asa vahen melacha o sheshshara vahen pitto pesulin. mishshum devittelan venishtannu mittorat mayim:

Afillu nitkavven lishrot baze. bitmiha, vechi afillu nitkavven lishrot pitto bemakom echad venafal bemakom acher yihyu pesulim, vahalo lo nitkavven velo bittelam, ella vadday kesherim hem. veen halacha kerabbi shimon hattimni:
Uvaggadol. shehaya gedol haachim bimdinat hayyam, vetala gedol haachin shellefanenu bo lomar hametinu lo, shehu gadol mimmenni:
Uvacheresh uvashshote. ad sheyyavriu. en shomin lo:
Alecha mitzva. af al pi sheachicha shebbimdinat hayyam hu gadol mimmecha, kevan sheatta gedol haachin shellefanenu alecha mitzva, deshihuye mitzva lo mashhinan:
Kol hazzevachim shennizbechu shello lishman kesherim. mishna zo bitchillat massechet zevachim hi shenuya, vesham perashnuha:
Tekoa. ir sheshshemah tekoa, kedichtiv (Shmuel 2 14) vayyishlach yoav tekoa:
Alfa lashshamen. hashshemen shellah rishon umuvchar lashshemanim. kealef zo shehi rishona laotiyyot:
Anpiknon. shemen heasuy mizzetim shello heviu shelish bishshulan, vehu mar meod:
Shennishru vammayim. shehammayim mekalkelim et hashshemen:

Kol shehu yad. haetz hamechubbar el happeri, veadam ochez bo beshaa sheochel happeri, kegon okatze tappuchim anavim vaagasim, keruyin yadot. vechen etzem sheyyesh berosho vasar, veadam ochez baetzem kede leechol habbasar shebberosho, have haetzem yad labbasar:
Velo shomer. laafoke chelek haoketz hannogea bapperi vedavuk laggarin, sheoto hachelek shomer hu lapperi:
Mittamme. hayyad, veaf al pi sheeno rauy laachila, im naga tuma baochel. dachashiv hayyad chibbur laochel ucheillu hu guf echad:

Umetamme. im naga tuma vayyad, nitma haochel, af al pi shello naga hattuma baochel. ulemaduhu rabbotenu min hammikra, dichtiv (Vayikra 11) vechi yippol minnivlatam al kol zera zerua asher yizzarea vegomer‏ tame hu lachem, lechol shebbetzarchechem, kelomar kol davar hatztzarich laochel mekabbel tuma kemoto vetame umittamme immo:
Velo mitztaref. im haya haochel pachot mikkabbetza, sheen tumat ochalin befachot mikkabbetza, en yad haochel mitztarefet immo lehashelimo lechashshiur:
Shomer af al pi sheeno yad. kegon kelippat happeri sheshshomer oto shello yippased:

Mittamme umetamme umitztaref. dichtiv al kol zera zerua asher yizzarea, umay asher yizzarea, bederech shebbene adam motziin otan lizria, chittin biklippatan, useorim biklippatan, dehaynu im hashshomer shellahen. lemay itzterich kera, i lemittamme umetamme, hasheta yad happeri mittamme umetamme kidyalfinan millachem lechol shebbetzarchechem, shomer mibbaya, ha lo ata kera ella lemitztaref immo, deyad eno mitztaref immo, shomer mitztaref immo:
Vechol sheeno lo yad velo shomer. kemo sear shebbapperot:
Lo mittamme velo metamme. veen tzarich lomar sheeno mitztaref:

Natal yado achat mishshetifa achat. ka kare shetifa achat kol zeman shello natal ki im paam achat ad happerek. uveyado achat hu desaggi befaam achat, af al gav deen bakkeli reviit ella daatu mishsheyare tohora. aval lishte yadav, af al gav daatu mishsheyare tohora, lo mahane ad sheyyittol shete peamim. rishonim ad happerek, usheniyyim ad happerek. verambam mefaresh, mishshetifa achat, mishsheficha achat. ucheshennotel shete yadav bishficha achat, hammayim mittammeim beyado achat, venimtza rochetz hashsheniyya bammayim shennitma, velo taharu yadav ad sheyyittol mayim sheniyyim merviit. aval keshennotel yado achat bilvad, bishficha achat, nithara yado. ucheshennotel mayim sheniyyim letaher hammayim sheal yado, saggi befachot merviit. veen halacha kerabbi meir:

Nafal kikkar shel teruma. hecha denatal et harishonim merviit, venafal alehem kikkar shel teruma, o naga bechikkar shel teruma im hammayim shebbeyado kodem sheyyenaggevem, o kodem sheyyishpoch alehen mayim sheniyyim:
Tahor. dechi hechi demahanu letaher yadav, mahanu nammi letaher atzman:
Rabbi yose metamme. desavar letaher yadav mahanu, aval inhu gufayhu temeim:

Shete middot. issaron issaron vachatzi issaron. shete middot shel issaron hayu, achat moddim otah gedusha, shehayta ketanna velo hayta machzeket keshehi gedusha ella issaron, keshiur chavertah keshehi mechuka. derabbi meir gamar mikkera dichtiv (Bamidbar 28) issaron issaron lakkeves haechad, dishte esronot hayu sham, vei shetehen shavot haveya lehu midda achat. ella achat mechuka veachat gedusha. gedusha shebbah haya moded lechol hammenachot, mechuka shebbah haya moded lachavitte kohen gadol, vachachamim omrim, lo haya sham ella issaron echad, dichtiv (sham 29) veissaron echad lakkeves haechad, veoto issaron machuk haya, uvo hayu moddim lechol hammenachot. vahalacha kachachamim:

Lo veshel shelosha lefar. leminchat nesachim shel par dichtiv beh (sham 28) ushelosha esronim lappar haechad, lo hayu moddin bemidda achat shettehe machzeket shelosha esronim, shello hayta sham midda gedola meissaron:
Ella moddan esronot. kol issaron issaron bifne atzmo:

Hachi garsinan chatzi issaron me haya meshammesh, shebbo haya moded lachavitte chohen gadol. vehachi perusha, lachavitte kohen gadol, mevi mibbeto issaron shalem, vechotzehu bachatzi issaron shebbammikdash, velash kol chatzi issaron bifne atzmo, veose mikkol chatzi issaron shesh challot, shehen lishne chatzae issaron shetem esre challot, veofe kullan beyachad, veachar kach mechallek kol challa lishnayim umakriv shenem asar chatzain babboker, ushenem asar chatzain baerev. vekodem sheyyakriv potet otan lefittin kazzayit, vechofel kol petita lishnayim, veeno mavdil. aval petitat kol shear menachot af al pi sheppittin shellahen kazzayit, kofel otan lishnayim ushenayim learbaa umavdil, keditnan leel beferek 6:
Kerichot. korchim vekoshrim rashe shibbolim melo egrof:
Mitkannesot lesham. lemotzae yom tov keshekkotzrim oto:
Kede sheyyehe niktzar beesek gadol. bekol hamulla gedola. sheyyakkiru hatztzedokim shebbemotzae yom tov kotzrim oto, mishshum deinhu lo modu behay, kedilkamman:
Amar lahen. hakkotzer, livne haayarot haomdim alav, ba hashshemesh, veamru lo hen:
Maggal ze. kelomar, ektzor hattevua bemaggal ze:
Kuppa zo. achnis hattevua letoch kuppa zo:
Shabbat zo. ektzor beshabbat zo, veamru lo hen:
Shalosh peamim. shoel lahen kol davar vedavar:
Vechol kach. shehaya shoel, lamma:

Mippene hatztzedokim uvaytosim shehayu omrim en ketzirat haomer bemotzae yom tov. ella bemotzae shabbat, dichtiv (Vayikra 23) usefartem lachem mimmochorat hashshabbat, mimmochorat shabbat bereshit mashma, umasoret beyadenu meavotenu dehay mimmochorat hashshabbat, hayenu mimmochorat yom tov rishon shel pesach, ben shechal bechol ben beshabbat. vechen matzinu besefer yehoshua (perek 5) vayyochlu meavur haaretz mimmochorat happesach matztzot vekali, vahare neemar battora (sham) velechem vekali vecharmel lo tochlu ad etzem hayyom hazze, umeachar shettala hetter hechadash bemochorat happesach, haddavar barur shemmochorat happesach hu hammattir et hechadash, uvo kotzrim haomer, ben shechal yom tov rishon shel pesach bechol ben shechal lihyot beshabbat. ulefichach hakkotzrim magbihin kolam, kede sheyyishmeu habbaytosim ulehotzi millibban. vekotzrim haomer ballayla velo bayyom, dichtiv usefartem lachem mimmochorat hashshabbat miyyom haviachem vegomer‏ sheva shabbatot temimot tihyena, vei efshar lihyot temimot ella im ken matchil limnot mittechillat hallayla, shehare hallayla techillat hayyom hu, vahare hu omer (Devarim 16) mehachel chermesh bakkama tachel lispor, alma hakketzira ballayla hu beshaa shemmatchil limnot:

Chazru layyad tehora. dechevan derishonim lo yatzu chutz lapperek, lo nitmeu hashsheniyyim bitziatan chutz lapperek. aval kesheyyatzu rishonim usheniyyim chutz lapperek vechazru layyad, temea, lefi shennitmeu hashsheniyyim barishonim shechutz lapperek, sheen hashsheniyyim metaharim harishonim [mehayyotzim] chutz lapperek, ella ad happerek bilvad hen metaharin:

Natal et harishonim. leyado achat, shennatal bemayim rishonim kol yad veyad bifne atzmah, veachar kach tzeref shete yadav lishpoch alehem mayim sheniyyim, yadav temeot. dichshetztzeref yadav, nitmeu yadav bingiatan zo bazo, demayim sheal gav zo metammeim mayim sheal gabbe chavertah, kemo shehayu metammeim kikkar shel teruma, venitmeu hayyadayim mechamat mashkin temeim. ucheshennatal et hashsheniyyim, lo tiharu et harishonim, kevan shennitmeu mechamat mayim shel chavertah, ella adderabba gam hashsheniyyim nitmeu vahen. vedavka keshennatal et harishonim zo leatzmah vezo leatzmah. aval im natal et harishonim lishte yadav keachat, necheshavot shete yadayim keyad achat veen metammeot zo bazo. kach matzati perush mishna zo beferushe rabbotay. verambam peresh, natal et harishonim leyado achat, shennatan mayim rishonim al gabbe yad achat bilvad, veachar kach tzeref shetehen lishpoch alehen mayim sheniyyim, yadav temeot. shehammayim sheniyyim mittammein beotah hayyad shello nithara, vechozrim umetammeim hayyad hattehora:
Veshifshefah bachavertah. shello netalah. nitmeu hammayim shealeha mechamat chavertah delo netalah, vechozrim umetammein et hayyad shennatal:
Berosho o vakkotel. im shifshefah berosho o bakkotel kede lenaggevah:

Tehora. veim leachar sheshshifshef chazar venaga beotan hammayim shebbau miyyado lerosho o lakkotel, temea. sheotan mayim temein hen vechozrim umetammeim hayyad shennaga bahen. af al gav dechol kamma delo shifshef lo (metammeim) [metaharin] beshifshuf, ki shifshef vechazar venaga, gara tefe:

Notlim arbaa vachamishsha ze vetzad ze. veen choshshim mishshum arbaa devarim, mishshum shemma nitmeu keshennaflu miyyad ze leyad ze, veshemma yesh lahem din mayim shennaasa vahem melacha, umishshum shemma lo natlu min hakkeli, umishshum shemma lo natlu min harviit:
Uvilvad sheyyerappu. yedehem shello tihye sham chatzitza:

Mearvin niske farim. minchat niske par beminchat niske ayil. lefi shebbelilat shetehen shava, shene luggim leissaron. deha tenan leel shishsha luggim lappar, vesolet have lehu shelosha esronim kedichtiv (sham) vehikriv al ben habbakar mincha solet shelosha esronim balul bashshemen chatzi hahin, dehaynu shishsha luggin. velaayil arbaa luggin, vesolet shene esronim laayil:
Niske chevasim. shelosha luggin leissaron, dichtiv issaron echad lakkeves haechad, uchetiv balul beshemen katit reviit hahin, dehaynu shelosha luggin:

Veshel hayyom beshel amesh. im hevi emesh zivcho belo nesachim. dekayma lan adam mevi zivcho hayyom unesachav mikkan vead asara yamim. veim hayyom hevi karban echad ushene nesachim immo, echad bishvilo veechad bishvil shel emesh, mearvin yachad im hakkarbanot shavin, shehayu shenehem kevasim o elim [o parim] o par veayil:
Aval en mearvim niske chevasim beniske farim veelim. lefi shemminchat par veayil chareva hi legabbe kevasim, uvolaat hemenna, venimtzet shel keves chasera vezo yetera:
Veim belalan. shekkevar halcha mitzvat shamnan:
Kesherot. kerabbanan diflige aleh derabbi yehuda behakkometz rabba veamre charev shennitarev bevalul yikrav:
Veim ad shello velalan. nitarvu:
Pesulot. devainan rauy levila, velekka, dechasra la shel keves, veshel ayil yetera:
Af al pi shemminchato chefula. kedichtiv beemor el hakkohanim, uminchato shene esronim:
Safek naasa vahen melacha. dimlacha poselet mayim lintila, keditnan beferek kamma:
Temeim. pesulim lintila:
Sefekan tahor. afillu yesh bammayim shennatal kol hanach sefekot. vehayenu safek littaher diflige besefa rabbanan verabbi yose. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Sefek yadayim littame uletamme. lekamman beidach bava mefaresh lah:
Shene chikkarim temeim. doochalim temeim metammeim et hayyadayim, keditnan lekamman beferek 3‏ [mishna 2], kol happosel et hatteruma metamme et hayyadayim lihyot sheniyyot:
Shene chikkarim tehorim. beshel teruma ayre. shehayyadayim poslot et hatteruma:
Hayyadayim kemo shehayu vehakkikkarim kemot shehayu. hattame betumato vehattahor betohorato:

Chutz min habbechor vehammaaser vehappesach vehachattat vehaasham. mishshum dichtiv befarashat nesachim (Bamidbar 15) lefalle neder o vindava. ba beneder uvindava, taun nesachim, yatzu bechor umaaser ufesach vechattat veasham shehen baim chova lo lindava, sheen teunim nesachim. yachol af chovot habbaot mechamat haregel baregel kegon olot reiyya veshalme chagiga lo yihyu teunot nesachim, talmud lomar o bemoadechem, kol habba bemoadechem taun nesachim. useire chattat shebbaim chova laregel en teunim nesachim, dichtiv befarashat nesachim vechi taase ben bakar, ben bakar bakkelal haya, bichlal vaasitem ishshe, demashma kol ishshe taun nesachim chutz [meishshe] shemmiet, velamma yatza, lehakish elav, ma ben bakar meyuchad shebba beneder unedava. af kol ba beneder unedava, yatzu seire hargalim shehen baot chattaot, sheen chattat ba beneder unedava, sheen teunot nesachim:

Chattato vaashamo shel metzora teunim nesachim. lefi sheenan baim al chet kishar chattaot vaashamot. vechattat nazir enah teuna nesachim, mishshum denazir chote hu kedichtiv (Bamidbar 6) measher chata al hannafesh, shetztzier atzmo min hayyayin:

Shavin. lav lechol mille shavin, deha bechullehu tenan harishon lammenora vehashshear lammenachot, ella shavin lammenachot kaamar. umishshum dekayma lan bechol makom mivchar nedarecha, sheyyavi min hammuvchar, ka mashma lan hasheta sheharishon shebbashsheni vehashsheni shebbarishon shavin. sheim yesh lo mincha lehavi veyesh lo mishshenehem, meeze sheyyirtze yavi. aval im yesh lo mishshelishi shebbarishon umerishon shebbashsheni, yavi minchato merishon shebbashsheni shehu muvchar:
Shomeret yavam. mamtenet layyavam:
Shekkiddesh. echad min haachim et achotah achar shennafla zo lifnehen vehuzkeka lechullan:
Hameten. millichnos, deka pagata baachot zekuka:
Ad sheyyaase achicha maase. sheyyichnos achicha et hayevama o yachlotz lah veyaakor et zikkatah mealecha:
Meta hayyevama yichnos et ishto. daafillu kenasah umeta muttar baachotah:
Met hayyavam. velo notar ach ella ze shekkiddesh et achotah:
Motzi et ishto veget veet eshet achiv bachalitza. aval yibbume lo, mishshum daachot gerushato hi. uvaggemara pasik halacha kerabbi yehuda ben betera:
Shemmillemalan veshemmillemattan. shetztzarich sheyyanniach panuy belo chetiva lemala min haddaf shalosh etzbaot ulematta tefach:

Shebbattechilla veshebbassof. bitchillat hassefer tzarich sheyyanniach panuy kede liglol kol hassefer, kelomar keshiur hekkef shel kol hassefer, shehassefer missofo litchillato hu niglal, dumeya dimzuza dechorchim otah meechad kelappe shema. uvesofo, kede lagol ammud. vedavka kesheen sham ella tora levaddah, tzarich laasot ken. aval hammadbik tora neviim uchetuvim beyachad, tzarich kede lagol kol hassefer besofo, uchede lagol ammud bitchillato. sheim hu gollo litchillato, nimtzet tora mibbachutz, ugenay hu shettease tora shomer linviim uchetuvim. uvehachi mayre ha deamrinan beferek kamma devava vatra, veose lo kede lagol ammud bitchillato uchede hekkef kol hassefer besofo:
Veechad mufne. belo ishsha:
Ishto immo. dekasavre bet shammay baalat maamar hi chashuva kichnusa, ucheshennafla achotah leachar ken lo mittesra mishshum achot zekuka:
Vehalla tetze. af min hachalitza, mishshum achot ishsha:

Motzi ishto veget. delo allim maamar leshavyah kichnusa, vezo osartah mishshum achot zekuka. utzericha get mippene hammaamar dahave kiddushin bemiktzat velo pake kiddushin belo get, utzericha chalitza dehoil velo have maamar kiddushin gemurin adayin zekukato hi utzericha chalitza lezikkatah. uveresha yahev lah gitta, vahadar chalitz lah. vechen halacha:

Omrim tzedokin. hammachchishin tora shebbeal pe nikraim tzedokim, al shem tzadok uvaytos talmidav shel antignos ish socho shehitchilu bekalkala zo techilla. lefi sheshshamu meantignos rabban al tihyu kaavadim hameshammeshin et harav al menat lekabbel peras. amru, efshar poel toreach veose melacha kol hayyom kullo velaerev eno mekabbel sachar, ufarshu middivre chachamim, venitchabberu immahem kittot miyyisrael, vead hayyom hazze nisharu mehem pelitim bemitzrayim bedammesek uvekostantina, vehem lesikkim beenenu velitzninim betziddenu, veanu korim lahem karaim, lefi sheen lahem ella hammikra bilvad:
Kovlin anu alechem. mitraamim anu al middotechem:
Perushim. lechachme yisrael hayu korin perushim, lefi sheochlin chullehen betohora uferushim mimmagga am haaretz, ditnan bigde am haaretz midras lapperushim:
Vesifre hamiram. sifre hamminim. venikraim hamiram, shehemiru dat haemet bedivre sheker: tarvadot. kappot sheochlim bahen. leshon melo tarvad rakav:

Af sifre hakkodesh lefi chibbatan hi tumatan. shello yaasem adam shetichin al gabbe behema. ulefi divrehem haya meshiv lahem, velo lefi haemet. detaama desifre hakkodesh metammein et hayyadayim, kede shello yavou hassefarim lide peseda, shehaachbarim hammetzuyyin etzel hoochalim hayu mafsidim et hassefarim, kidfarshinan besof zavim:

Hacholetz livimto. hu muttar bikrovoteha. delav chalitza hi, deha lo baya chalitza. ukerovot ukerovim dematnitin hayenu hanach deneesarot al haish mechamat ishto ukerovim hanneesarim al ishsha mechamat baalah:
Im en havvalad shel keyama. shehu nefel:

Rabbi yishmael omer haomer haya va veshabbat. keshechal shishsha asar benisan lihyot beshabbat, haomer doche et hashshabbat, shekkol karban shezzemanno kavua doche et hashshabbat veet hattuma. vehaya haomer ba mishshalosh sein, shehayu kotzrin shalosh sein seorin umenifin otan benafa ad shemmaamidin otan al issaron echad muvchar:

Uvechol. im chal shishsha asar benisan lihyot bechol, hayu kotzrin oto chamesh sein, desavar rabbi yishmael issaron muvchar belo tircha sheeno menappe oto kol kach ate mechamesh, betircha keshemmenappe oto harebe ate mishshalosh. bechol maytinan mechamesh, shekkach meshubbach haddavar yoter shemmenifin mikkol sea meat oto solet dak hayyotze rishon shehu muvchar, umotziin mechamesh sein issaron. beshabbat mevi shalosh, mutav sheyyarbe bimlacha achat sheroked shalosh seim peamim harebe, veal yarbe bimlachot harebe sheyyiktzor veyivror veyitchon virakked shene sein yoter. veen halacha kerabbi yishmael:

Bishlosha bene adam uveshalosh kuppot uveshalosh maggalot. lefarsem haddavar shekketzirat haomer bemotzae chamishsha asar benisan, mippene hatztzedokim shehayu omrim sheen haomer ba ella beechad beshabbat:
Mehavehvin oto vaur. beodo bashshibbolin, kede lekayyem bo mitzvat kali, kedichtiv (Vayikra 2) aviv kaluy baesh, uveminchat haomer mayre kera:
Vachachamim omrim. techilla chovtim. velo kederech tevua yevesha shechovtim oto bemakkel, ella bekanim lachim:
Uviklichot. bekelach shel keruv, kede shello yitmaech. veachar kach mekayyemin bo mitzvat kali:

Netanuhu laabbuv. disvira lehu lerabbanan sheim mehavehvim oto baur mammash en nikra kali, sheen nikra kali ella al yede davar acher dehaynu al yede keli, shennotnim oto baabbuv, vehu keli shel nechoshet menukkav shemmochre kelayot kolin bo. vahalacha kachachamim:
Berechayim shel garosot. sheen tochanot dak ella ave. sheim yitchanu yafe yaavru hassubbin shel kelippa bannafa im hassolet. vegarosot leshon gerisin shel pol, veal shem ken nikret geres karmel:
Vechayyav bachalla. dechiyyuv challa hayenu gilgul haissa, vegilgul issa zo beyad hedyot hi leachar shennifda:
Ufatur min hammaasrot. demerucho beyad hekdesh hu, umeruach hekdesh poter min hammaasrot:
Rabbi akiva mechayyev. hay kemach hannotar meissaron shel omer:
Bachalla uvammaasrot. lefi shello nittenu meot hekdesh ella batztzarich lahem leissaron levad, aval haacher lo kadash, hilkach lav meruach hekdesh hu, deha lo kaddush. veen halacha kerabbi akiva:
Ba lo laissaron. noten techilla shamno ulevonato kodem netinat hassolet:
Yatzak uvalal. leachar netinat hassolet, kederech kol hammenachot shennoten shemen bichli techilla veachar kach noten solet vechozer veyotzek aleha shemen uvolel:
Henif vehiggish. deminchat haomer teuna hanafa vehaggasha, kidamrinan beferek kol hammenachot:
Kotzrim. kodem laomer:

Mippene hannetiot. shello yafsidu. lefi sheotah tevua enah reuya laomer, kidamrinan beferek kol hakkarbanot, en meviin lo missede bet hashshelachim velo missede ilan, uleel amrinan mimmekom shei atta mevi atta kotzer. perush acher, mippene hannetiot, mishshum kilayim. lefi sheppeamim adam zorea tevua veen sham netiot, uleachar zeman olot sham netiot benehen mealehen, vetzarich liktzor hazzeraim mishshum kilayim:
Umippene vet haevel. sheen lahem makom panuy leshev levarech birkat rechava sheomrim bevet haevel:

Umippene bet hammidrash. sheen makom lattalmidim leshev. vetaama dechol hane, mishshum diktzir mitzva ninhu, vehakkatuv omer reshit ketzirchem, sheyyihye haomer reshit liktzirchem shel reshut velo reshit lekatzir shel mitzva:
Kerichot. alummot keshurot:
Tzevatim. aguddot belo kishshur. perush acher, kerichot alummot gedolot, tzevatim aguddot ketannot:
Min hakkama. sheyyehe kotzer lishmo:
Lo matza. shekkevar niktzar hakkol:
Min hallach. dichtiv karmel, rach umal:

Liktzor ballayla. kidyalfinan beresh pirkin, middichtiv (Devarim 16) mehachel chermesh bakkama tachel lispor, mishshaa sheatta mone atta kotzer, vehassefira tzericha lihyot ballayla dichtiv (Vayikra 23) sheva shabbatot temimot:
Kerutim vehattulim. shem mekomot hem:
Ilyusetan. yayin matok mechamat hashshemesh, shettalu haanavim bashshemesh lemattekan. shemesh bilshon yavan yusetan:
Yayin yashan. sheavru alav shenem asar chodesh, over admimuto, vehakkatuv omer (Mishlei 23) al tere yayin ki yitaddam, alma bishat admimuto muvchar hu:
Lo matok. keshehu matok mechamat atzmo. deillu mechamat shemesh, ha tana resha ilyusetan im hevi kasher. perush acher, tirosh shello avru alav arbaim yom. verishon ikkar:
Min haddaliyyot. min haggefanim hammuddelot al gabbe kelonsot vekanim gevohim min haaretz:
Ella min harogliyyot. miggefanim sheshshochvot al gabbe karka ben ragle bene haadam, sheenan muddelot:
Haavudim. shenneevdu shete peamim bashshana. shechofrim sevivot haggefanim lehappech bakkarka shebbesharshehen veosin bahen gummot lehashekotan, vezo hi avodatan:
Shelosha zetim. shalosh peamim bashshana melakketim et hazzetim. uvahen shalosh shemanim, bechol paam yesh shelosha minim shemen:
Hazzayit harishon. paam rishona shemmelakket:
Megargero verosh hazzayit. melakket gargerim shehen berosh hazzayit, shehen mitbashshelim techilla lefi shehachamma zorachat alehen umevashshaltan:
Letoch hassal. umistannen veyotze, vehakkeli tachat hassal lekabbel hashshemen:

Rabbi yehuda omer sevivot dafne hassal. noten et hazzetim vehashshemen zav derech haddefanot venofel leshule hassal umishsham mistannen veyotze, venimtza mezukkak, shehappesolet nishar medubbak bedafne hassal. aval lo yittenem beshule hassal, mippene shemitarev bo shemen ushemarim veyotzim venimtza shemen achur. vehashshemen hazzav meelav belo shum teina nikra shemen rishon shel hazzayit harishon:
Taan bekora. zetim shebbassal:
Rabbi yehuda omer baavanim. velo bekora. shehakkora keveda umotzia et hashshemarim:
Chazar vetachan. barechayim, et hazzetim shettachat hakkora, vetoen achar kach hakkora:
Harishon lammenora. devainan shemen zayit zach:
Vehashshear kasher lammenachot. delo ketiv behu zach:
Hazzayit hashsheni. paam sheniyya keshemmelakket et shennimtzaim mevushshalim atta:
Megargero verosh haggag. melakket haggargerin hassemuchim laggag. shezzetehen hayu semuchim legaggotehen, veotan mitbashshelim bashsheniyya:
Harishon. sheyyatza kodem teina, kasher lammenora:
Hazzayit hashshelishi. shemmitlakket paam shelishit, en mitbashshelim leolam kol tzarkan, shehen anafim shettachat haggag sheen chamma maggaat bahem:
Otno. leshon maatan shel zetim, shehi haggumma shemmannichim bah hazzetim kede sheyyitappeshu sham. uleshon mikra hu, atinav malu chalav (Iyov 21):
Sheyyilke. sheyyitappesh:
Umenaggevo verosh haggag. demittoch shehu tzavur umechunnas bemakom echad arbaa vachamishsha yamim zav meelav mohal sheeno yafe, lefichach tzarich lenaggevo:
Shenayim shekkiddeshu shete achayot. vehem nachrim:
Ze choletz lishtehen kulei. mishshum dechol chad minnayhu asur leyibbume, dedilma kol chad vechad paga baachot zekukato:

Hayyachid choletz lishtehen. shei efshar lo leyabbem, lo kodem chalitza shel sheniyya mishshum achot zekuka, velo leachar chalitza mishshum achot chalutza. lefichach hoil veasur leyabbem yachlotz techilla lishtehen, kede lehotzi otah shehi yevimto meissur yevama lashshuk:

Vehashshenayim echad choletz. leafkue zikka meachiv im zo yevimto, vetishtere achotah lashsheni mimma nafshach, i yevimto hi, shappir, vei achotah hi, ha paka zikkat hayyevama minneh bachalitzat achiv:

Achiv shel ze meyabbem chalutzato shel ze. mimma nafshach, im zo yevimto shappir nasiv, shehare achiv lo chalatz lezo ella laachotah shello hayta yevimto veenah kelum. vei lav yevimto hi shappir nasiv, nachriyya hi, dei mishshum achot zekuka lekka, shehare chalatz achiv et achotah shehi yevimto ufaka zikka. vei mishshum yevama lashshuk, hare chaltza zo meachi baalah:
Kadmu shene achin. shel echad vechaltzu lishtehen mishshum delo yade ezo hi yevimto:
Lo yeyabbemu. shene achim haacherim ze et zo veze et zo, mishshum dekamma denasiv it leh lememar zo hi achot zekukato: ella echad choletz. techilla, laachat:
Veechad meyabbem. lashsheniyya, mimma nafshach, i yevimto hi shappir, vei lav, baachot zekuka lo paga, shehare chalatz achiv livimto. vivama lashshuk lo have, shehare chaltza meachi baalah:

Veim kadmu. ellu shenayim acharonim vechansu achar chalitzat shenayim haacherim velo bau limmalech bevet din, en motziin miyyadan, kedifrishit, shehare en kan ella sefek issur achot zekuka benissue rishona, veikka lememar kamma denasiv yevimto hi veshappir nasiv, uvatra nammi shappir nasiv nachriyya, vei nammi have insiva ippecha vekamma paga baachot zekuka, kevan shebba sheni veyibbem paka zikkatah meachiv vehuttera lo ishto, veissura deavad avad:
Issur erva. kegon chamoto veem chamoto:
Umuttar baachotah. delav achot zekukato hi, deerva lo ramya kammeh leyibbume:
Issur mitzva. ramya kammeh middeorayta, hilkach asur baachotah, daachot zekukato hi:
Retzuot shel tefillin metammeot et hayyadayim. dichsheggazru al hayyadayim habbaot mechamat sefer shepposlot et hatteruma, gazru nammi al hayyadayim shennagu birtzuot shel tefillin:
Rabbi shimon omer kulei. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Shenneemar veasir gevulot ammim. shehaya magle bene ir zo umoshivan beir acheret, umagle bene ir acheret umoshivan beir zo:
Veshavti et shevut ammi yisrael vaadayin lo shavu. ucheshem sheellu lo shavu, kach ellu lo shavu:

Vehittiruhu lavo vakkahal. dechevan demishshivim haummot en asur lavo bakkahal ella ammoni umoavi ad olam, umitzri vaadomi dor rishon vesheni, hasheta sheen ellu haummot yeduim, shekkevar nitbalbelu venitarvu ben shear haummot, amrinan kol defaresh merubba paresh, vechol hammitgayyer muttar lavo bakkahal miyyad:
Mitzvat haomer lavo min hakkarov. mimmakom shekkarov lirushalayim, lefi sheen maavirin al hammitzvot, hilkach kesheyyotze mirushalayim levakkesh omer, otah tevua shemmotze rishona notlah:
Lo vikker. lo bashal kol tzarko:
Maase shebba miggaggot tzerifin veen socher. rechokim mirushalayim harebe. mippene shehecherivu haggeyasot kol tevuot shessevivot yerushalayim:
Chatzavim gedolim. shehakkelim haggedolim pogmim taam hayyayin:
Kede sheyyehe recho nodef. keshehechavit melea, yotze hareach lachutz veeno nodef:
Kemachin. kemin gargerim dakkim levanim sheolim al pene hayyayin domin lekemach:
Umeemtzaah. mesim barza beemtza hechavit:
Kane. ammat hammidda shehayta regila lihyot beyad haggizbar:

Zarak et haggid vehikkish bakkane. kelomar keshezzarak hayyayin haggid shel shemarim, shemmatchilim hashshemarim latzet, hikkish haggizbar bakkane shebbeyado vedachahu shello yikkanes bakkeli sheyyesh bo hayyayin. verabbotay pershu hikkish bakkane shebbeyado lirmoz el moshech hayyayin min hechavit sheyyistom hechavit babbarza, velo haya omer lo setom, lefi shehaddibbur kashe leyayin. vehachi mefaresh leh baggemara:

Rabbi yose verabbi yehuda omer yayin shealu vo kemachin pasul. veen halacha kerabbi yose berabbi yehuda. vechol hane deamrinan bematnitin shehem pesulim, ben bassolet ben bashshemen ben bayyayin, im avar vehikdishan makkin oto makkot mardut middivrehem, kedin hammakdish baal mum lammizbeach shehu loke min hattora, middichtiv bevaal mum lo takrivu, veamru besifra, en lo takrivu ella lo takdishu. ucheshem shehayu meviim hassolet vehayyayin vehashshemen mimmekomot muvcharim yeduim keditnan bematnitin, kach hayu meviim hakkarbanot mimmekomot yeduim, elim mimmoav, kevasim mechevron, agalim mishsharon, gozalot dehaynu torim uvene yona mehar hammelech:
Chutz mecheresh shote vekatan. lefi sheen lahem daat:

Suma. dichtiv befar helem davar shel tzibbur vesamchu zikne haeda, vehem sanhedri gedola, uvassanhedrin lo haya bahen suma, kidmuchach bemassechet sanhedrin, vehu haddin lechol shear semichot sheen suma yachol lismoch:
Venachri. dichtiv dabber el bene yisrael vegomer, bene yisrael somchin veen hannachrim somchin:
Vehaeved vehashshaliach. dichtiv (Vayikra 1) vesamach yado, velo yad avdo velo yad shelucho:
Vehaishsha. bene yisrael somchin, velo benot yisrael somchot:
Usemicha sheyare mitzva. deenah meakkevet kappara. umihu maale alav hakkatuv keillu lo kipper:
Bishte yadayim. dichtiv bassair hammishtalleach (sham 16) vesamach aharon et shete yadav, ze bana av lechol hassemichot sheyyihyu bishte yadayim:
Uvimkom shessomchim shochatim. sheim samach chutz laazara chozer vesomech baazara bimkom shechita:
Vetechef lassemicha shechita. dichtiv vesamach veshachat:

Ma pesach shehu va vechova eno va ella min hachullin. defesach mitzrayim lo ba ella min hachullin, sheadayin lo hayta lahem shum tevuat maaser sheni, sheen maaser ella mishshennichnesu laaretz, uma pesach mitzrayim lo ba ella min hachullin, af pesach dorot eno ba ella min hachullin, shehare hu omer (Shemot 13) veavadta et haavoda hazzot bachodesh hazze, sheyyehu kol avodat hachodesh hazze keze shel mitzrayim:
Af kol davar shebbechova. nammi kulei. lefichach, haomer hare alay toda o shelamim, hoil vehen baim chova, dekaamar hare alay, lo yavi ella min hachullin:

Vehannesachim. afillu amar hare alay lehavi mimmaaser, lo yavi ella min hachullin. dechi shara rachamana laatoye shelamim mimmaaser hane mille shelamim gufayhu divne achila ninhu, aval nesachim dechalil hem lo yaviu min hammaaser:
Kol happosel et hatteruma. dehaynu sheni lattuma, shehu posel shelishi batteruma:
Hayyad metammea et chavertah. mi shehayta yado achat temea venaga beyado haacheret tehora, nitmet, vechazru shetehen temeot:
Vahalo chitve hakkodesh. sheggazru alehen lihyot sheni lattuma ufoslim et hatteruma, vehen metammein et hayyadayim hannogot bahen laasotan sheniyyot, alma sheni ose sheni:

Velo divre sofrim middivre sofrim. vetumat yadayim bechol hattumot, middivre sofrim hi, dishlomo tikken eruvin u[netilat] yadayim. vechitve hakkodesh shemmetammein et hayyadayim nammi middivre sofrim, mishshemona asar davar sheggazru bo bayyom. veen danim zo mizzo lomar keshem shemmatzinu bechitve hakkodesh sheshsheni ose sheni hachi nammi bishar tumot yihye sheni ose sheni, demay detakkun takkun, may delo takkun lo takkun. veen halacha kerabbi yehoshua:
Zikkat shene yevamin. dechol zeman shello kenasah ze adayin zikkat rishon alav, venittosfa alav zikkat sheni bishvil hammaamar, ucheshemmet notru aleha zikkat shene yevamin:

Rabbi shimon omer vechulei. dekasavar mesappeka lan i maamar kone legamre o lo kane kelal, lechach meyabbem leezo sheyyirtze, dei maamar kane lo have alah ella zikkat sheni, vei maamar lo kani lo have alah ella zikkat harishon:

Vecholetz lashsheniyya. dachada lo mefatterah beviat idach, dedilma maamar lo kane vahavo shete yevamot habbaot mishshene battim. veyibbume tarvayhu lo, dedilma maamar kane vahavo shete yevamot habbaot mibbayit echad. veen halacha kerabbi shimon. veaf al gav deamrinan bematnitin dezikat shene yevamin deorayta mikkera divamah yavo aleha, baggemara muchach dezikat shene yevamin derabbanan hi, gezera shemma yomru shete yevamot habbaot mibbayit echad mityabbemot:
Metaharim et hannitztzok. ditnan bemassechet machshirin, kol hannitztzok, tahor. im meare mikkeli tahor lichli tame, ma shennishar bakkeli haelyon, tahor, denitztzok eno chibbur:
Ammat hammayim habbaa min hakkevarot. modu bah tzedokim dithora, dichtiv (Vayikra 11) mikve mayim yihye tahor:
Shehare en bahen daat. sheyyechavvenu lehafesid mamon levaalehen:
Yelech veyadlik gedisho shel acher. venimtza mafsid et rabbo mea mane bechol yom:
Bo vayyom. appirkin dilel kae, ammilleteh derabbi shimon ben azzay, demayre bayyom shehoshivu et rabbi elazar ben azarya bayshiva. vechol makom shenneemar bammishna bo bayyom, al oto yom neemar:
Nimnu. amdu leminyan, ladaat minyan hametammeim uminyan hametaharim, vegamru haddin al pi harov:
Arevat haraglayim. areva asuya lirchitzat haraglayim:
Shennisdeka. samuch leshuleha, veenah machazeket mayim kede rechitzat raglo achat:
Temea midras. daareva kodem shennisdeka nammi hayu regilim leshev bah, vehayta meshammeshet yeshiva im melachtah:
Sherabbi akiva. haya cholek veomer arevat haraglayim kishmah, kelomar kishmah ken hi, sheen shem midras aleha. veen halacha kerabbi akiva:
En meviin. omer ushete hallechem:
Lo mibbet hazzevalim. missade shetztzericha lezevel, deshemma lo nizdabbela kol tzarkah venimtzeu peroteha kechushim. i nammi, lefi shehazzevel mavish umafsid taam happeri:
Velo mibbet hashshelachim. eretz tzemea lemayim shepperoteha kechushin:
Lo mibbet hailan. mittevua shebben hailanot. shehailanot haggedelim sham yonkim hakkarka umachchishim hazzeraim:
Narah. choresh. leshon niru lachem nir (yirmeya 4):

Uvashsheniyya zorah. baggemara massik, deshana rishona hu nar kullah vezorea chetzyah umanniach chetzyah nir. vechen bashsheniyya chorshah kullah vezorea hachetzi shello zara eshtakad, vehachetzi shezzara eshtakad mannicho nir. vechen bechol shana zorea nir shel eshtakad:
Ketzad bodek. hassolet im menuppa kol tzarkah im lav:
Ala veyado avak. kemach dak, vegarua hu:
Ad sheyyenifenna. benafa laavor haavak dak shennishar bah:
Veim hitlia. hassolet o hachitta:

Pesula. vehu shehitlia berubbah. veyalfinan la lekamman sof pirkin middichtiv (Bamidbar 28) temimim yihyu lachem uminchatam. temimim yihyu lachem veniskehem. sheyyihyu gam ken hammenachot vehannesachim temimim:
Hattorem et habbor. shel yayin o shel shemen:
Al menat shettaale shalom. keshehitna shalom setam velo hitna leinyan ma, missetama leinyan shever usheficha kaamar, sheal ze adam yare beshaa shemmaale min habbor:
Aval lo min hattuma. lefichach im nitma, terumato teruma:
Af min hattuma. dichsheamar shettaale shalom, shettaale betohora kaamar. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Nishbera enah medammaat. shello chal aleha shem teruma:
Ad kede shettitgalgel. kol zeman shello nitrachaka min habbor kol kach deim titgalgel tashuv labbor, lo alta shalom karinan bah:
Shehaya vo daat lehatenot. kelomar shehaya bedato vechashav belibbo lehatenot, veshachach velo hitna. veen halacha kerabbi yose:

Ammon umoav ma hen bashsheviit. en ze ammon umoav shettiharu besichon shehi nachalat reuven vegad, dehahi eretz yisrael hi, afillu im timtza lomar shello chevashuha ole bavel, al karchach sheviit noheget bah, deha tenan bemassechet sheviit perek happegam, shalosh aratzot leviur, yehuda veever hayyarden vehaggalil. veever hayyarden hi eretz sichon. ella bishar eretz ammon umoav shello tiharu besichon velo chavshu meolam ayre. teda, middemayte ala mibbavel umimmitzrayim:
Lo shinniti misseder hashshanim. shel olam. achar hashshana shel maasar ani meviin maaser sheni, vahare bashshishshit maasar ani, lefichach rauy bashsheviit maaser sheni:
Hammaaser vehatteruma. veal karchach hammaaser haamur kan, maaser sheni hu, dumeya ditruma shehi kodesh, velo maasar ani shehu chol gamur, veen lidchot maaser sheni mippene aniyyim:
Kemeshiv al divre tarfon. lesayyea lo:
Aval lo leinyan devarav. kelomar velo mittaameh:
Mitzrayim maase chadash. shehazzekenim shehayu achar ezra tikkenu lehaferish maaser bemitzrayim:
Uvavel maase yashan. takkanat neviim shehayu kodem churban habbayit, venishkach haddavar, deshemma lo haya tzorech aniyyim beotah shaa:
Maase neviim. veal pi nevua asu horaat shaa, veen lemedim mimmenna:
Halacha lemoshe missinay. lav davka. deen ze min hattora, ella keillu hi halacha lemoshe missinay. mihu betosefta mashma dahalacha lemoshe missinay mammash kaamar:
Kol karbanot. min hechadash umin hayyashan. bimnachot kaamar:
Sheenan baim ella min hechadash. baomer ketiv (Vayikra 23) mincha chadasha, uvishte hallechem ketiv (Shemot 34) bikkure ketzir chittim:
Umin haaretz. baomer ketiv (Vayikra 23) ki tavou el haaretz vegomer‏ uketzartem et ketzirah, uvishte hallechem ketiv (sham) mimmoshvotechem taviu lechem:
Michmas vezonicha. shemot shel mekomot hen:
Alfa lassolet. solet shellahen rishon umuvchar lechol hasselatot. kealef zo shehi rishona lechol haotiyyot:
Alfa. zo alef belashon yevani:
Sheniyya lahen. kerova saltah lihyot meshubbachat kesolet michmas vezonicha:
Chafarayim babbika. shete chafarayim hen, achat bahar veachat babbika, veotah shebbabbika hi shessolet shellah meshubbachat:
Kol haaratzot. shel eretz yisrael hayu kesherot, ella shemmikkan hayu meviim:
Vechullan. chamesh esre arayot, shehayu bahen leachiv kiddushe safek o gerushe safek, dehavya sefek tzarat erva:
Choletzet. velo miftera belo kelum, dedilma lav tzarat erva hi:
Safek karov lo. shehayu shemone ammot metzumtzamot benehen birshut harabbim, vearba ammot shel adam konot lo sham, uzerako safek bearba ammotav safek bearba ammoteha:
Geluskin. kikkerot lechem naki vetahor:
Veim hediach bahen yadav. vetach et haggeluskin beyado:
Kesherim. hammayim shebbakkeli lintila. shello naaset melacha bammayim shebbakkeli, ella bammayim shellakach bechafnav:
Manniach chavit ben birkav. uvirkav mesayyein lishpoch, vehayenu koach gavra, umishshum hachi lo paleg rabbi yose beha:
Umatte chavit al tziddah. vaafillu halach veyashav lo achar kach vehechavit shofechet mayim kol hayyom kullo, mechamat hattayato hu, vachashiv koach gavra:
Vehakkof. chayya sheshshemah 97 belaaz. veyesh lah yadayim kide adam:
Notel layyadayim. dechoach noten bainan, koach adam lo bainan:
Rabbi yose fosel bishne ellu. bekof, uvematte chavit al tziddah. bekof, mishshum devainan koach adam velekka. umatte chavit al tziddah, lav koach gavra chashiv leh. veen halacha kerabbi yose:

Sheechad menif lechol hachaverim. shennitchabberu lehitnaddev karban echad. shekkol karbenot nedava yecholim lehavi beshuttafut, veechad menif al yede kullan, aval kullan yachad en yecholin lehanif, dehavya chatzitza ben yado shel ze velakkarban. vechohen shemmanniach yado tachat yad habbealim umenif vehaveya yad bealim chatzitza, lo ichpat lan, deha ikkar tenufa babbealim:
Bekarbenot hayyachid. kegon chaze veshok shel shelamim:
Uvekarbenot tzibbur. kivse atzeret shetteunim tenufa chayyim ushechutim:
Bedavar sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim. karban behema:
Uvedavar sheen bo ruach chayyim. kegon lachme toda venazir:
Veeno yodea ezo kiddesh. veasur bishtehen, mishshum dechol chada vachada ikka lememar zo achot ishsha:

Choletz lishtehen. delo yada ezo hi yevimto. umichlatz lachada uleyibbume leidach, lo efshar, daachot chalutzato hi, vaasura lo midderabbanan bechayyeha. veyibbume beresha nammi lo, dedilma lo zo hi yevimto vekafaga baachot zekukato dehavya keishto:

Hayu lo shenayim, echad choletz. techilla laachat, vehashsheni im ratza leyabbem lashsheniyya meyabbem, sheim zo yevimto shappir, veim achotah hi, lo paga baachot zekukato, mishshum dachalitza dehach afkata lazzikka:
Kadmu vechansu. kodem shennimlechu bevet din:

En motziin otan miyyadam. mishshum dechol chad vechad amar, ana shappir nasve. vei nammi have ippecha, sheharishon shekkanas leyibbum kanas achot zekukato, hahi shata hu deavad issura, umishshebba achiv veyibbem et hashsheniyya shehi yevimto, paka zikkatah lemafrea meidach:

Shaa echat. binfila rishona keshennafla meachiv harishon, sheaz hayta ishto kayyemet vehayta zot asura alav keeshet ach sheyyesh lo banim. vetzaratah hannachrit lo itparesh dinah, umistabbera decholetzet velo mityabbemet:

Mitzva vaggadol leyabbem. dedarshinan ulekachah lo leishsha veyibbemah vehaya habbechor, hameyabbem yehe bechor. asher teled, veotah yevama tehe reuya leled, perat leaylonit. yakum habbechor hayyavam al shem achiv linchol oto, velo yachleku echav immo:
Hannitan al eshet ish. hechashud al eshet ish:
Vehotziuha. bet din mittachat baalah, bishvil ze sheasarah alav, vehalach ze unesaah:

Yotzi. demiddeorayta asura nammi lo kemo sheasura labbaal, kiddarshinan minnitmaa nitmaa shete peamim, echad labbaal veechad labboel. vedavka hannitan al eshet ish, aval nitan al happenuya, nire demitzva lichnos, kidashkechan gabbe ones (Devarim 22) velo tihye leishsha:
Nachrit. sheenah kerova lo lezo velo lezo:

Nachrit choletzet velo mityabbemet. hu haddin af al gav delo asa bah maamar, vamet, nachrit michlatz chaltza yibbume lo meyabbemah, dehavya lah tzarat achot ishsha bezikka. vehay dekatane maamar, laafoke middevet shammay deamre maamar kone kinyan gamur vaafillu chalitza nammi lo tibbae, ka mashma lan ditzricha chalitza:

Kotzrim bet hashshelachim shebbaamakim. shettevuatan raa veen meviin omer mishsham. vetanya, katuv echad omer (Vayikra 23) uketzartem et ketzirah vahavetem et omer, demashma deyachol liktzor kodem havaat haomer, vechatuv acher omer reshit ketzirchem, demashma shettehe reshit lechol hakketzirot, ha ketzad, mimmakom sheatta yachol lehavi haomer i atta kotzer kodem laomer, mimmakom shei atta mevi, kegon bet hashshelachim uvet haamakim sheen meviin omer mehen lefi shehen raot, atta kotzer mehen kodem laomer:
Aval lo godshin. laasotan gadish. dechamma deefshar leshannoye meshanninan:
Anshe yericho. bet hashshelachin havu lehu:
Kotzer lashshachat. muttar liktzor lashshachat kodem laomer umaachil livhemto:
Ematay bizman shehitchil. lekatzrah letzorech behemto ad shello hevia shelish acharon shel gemar bishshulah, kotzer af leachar shehevia shelish:
Rabbi shimon omer af yiktzor veyaachil. yatchil liktzor umaachil livhemto mishshehevia shelish. dechol lashshachat lav katzir hu. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda, shebba lefaresh devarav shel tanna kamma:
Keishto lechol davar. shemmegarshah beget velo baya chalitza, umachzirah kesheyyirtze velo mittesra aleh:
Al nichse valah harishon. sheyyihyu karkaot shel baalah harishon acharain vearvain al ketubbatah. vei let lah ketubba mibbaalah harishon kotev lah hayyavam ketubba al nechasav, vehi mane bilvad:

Shehaya godshah betochah. keshehaya machuk haya machazik kishar issaron gadush. umatnitin rabbi meir hi deamar beresh pirkin issaron issaron haya bammikdash, echad machuk veechad gadush. velet hilchata kevateh:
Berutzehen. gadshan. delach nammi ikka godesh pureta:

Middot hallach berutzehen kodesh umiddot hayyavesh berutzehen chol. baggemara mefaresh dehay tanna savar middot hallach nimshechu ben mibbifnim ben mibbachutz, hilkach sefat hakkeli mekaddeshan labberutzin. middot hayyavesh nimshechu mibbifnim velo nimshechu mibbachutz, hilkach berutzin sheenan nogim mibbifnim bimkom meshichatan lo kaddeshe:
Rabbi akiva omer middat hallach kodesh. desavar middot hallach nimshechu ben mibbifnim ben mibbachutz:
Middot hayyavesh chol. delo nimshechu kol ikkar. umihu ma shemmoddim bahen kadosh kedushshat happe. vegavra lemay detzarich mekaddesh bappe, berutzin lo mekaddesh lehu delo tzeriche leh:

Rabbi yose omer lo mishshum ze. rabbi yose savar idi veidi nimshechu mibbifnim velo nimshechu mibbachutz. vehacha hayenu taama mishshum delach nekar, ma shebbeshule hakkeli keshemmosifin alav nekar umitarev venivlal veole millemala, venimtza shekkevar kadshu habberutzin betoch hakkeli:
Vehayyavesh eno nekar. ella bimkomo omed, hilkach ma shebbifnim kadosh uma shebbachutz eno kadosh:
Arbaa achin. choltzot velo mityabbemot. dechevan detarvayhu zekukin lehay ulehay, kamma dimyabbem paga baachot zekukato dehavya keishto:

Bet shammay omrim yekayyemu uvet hillel omrim yotziu. baggemara mappechinan lah, bet shammay omrim yotziu uvet hillel omrim yekayyemu. divchol makom bet shammay lechumra uvet hillel lekulla chutz mehammekomot hayeduim mikkulle bet shammay umechumre bet hillel. vehachi amrinan bealma, bet shammay bimkom bet hillel enah mishna, kelomar, kol hecha deashkechan bammishna bet shammay mekilin, uvet hillel hu sheddarkan lehakel venimtzeu atta bet shammay omdim bimkom bet hillel, enah mishna umeshabbashta hi vetzarich lehafchah, ella im ken hi mehammishnayot hayyeduot shehem mikkulle bet shammay umechumre bet hillel. uvemassechet eduyyot mane lah beshem rabbi eliezer mikkulle bet shammay umechumre bet hillel:
Shello virtzon chachamim. degazre shemma yochal min hechadash keshekkotzer kodem sheyyakrivu haomer, veze shekkevar hu kemach vadday niktzar kodem haomer:
Rabbi yehuda omer birtzon chachamim. delo gazru shemma yochal keshekkotzer. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Veharchokim. sheenan yodim im adayin karav haomer:
Muttarim mechatzot hayyom ulehallan. kidkatane taama lekamman:
Sheyyehe yom hanef. yom shishsha asar benisan shebbo menifin et haomer:
Kullo asur. leechol bo chadash:
Amar rabbi yehuda. letanna dematnitin, vechi rabban yochanan hitkin:

Vahalo min hattora asur. bizman sheen bet hammikdash kayyam. ditre kerae ketive, katuv echad omer ad etzem hayyom hazze, demashma deatzmo shel yom kullo asur, dead vead bichlal, vechatuv echad omer (Vayikra 23) ad haviachem et karban elohechem, demashma dilachar karban haomer muttar. ha ketzad, kan bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam, kan bizman sheen bet hammikdash kayyam. alma bizman sheen bet hammikdash kayyam sheen haomer karev have yom hanef kullo asur min hattora. umeshane baggemara deha ditnan hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay sheyyehe yom hanef kullo asur, lo tema hitkin ella darash vehitkin, kelomar sheddarash mikraot hallalu barabbim vehodiam shekkach haddin sheyyom hanef kullo asur min hattora mishshecharav bet hammikdash. veit dimfarshe baggemara, sheen hechadash asur min hattora beyom shishsha asar benisan bizman sheen mikdash ella ad sheyyair pene hammizrach shacharit beyom shishsha asar, dichtiv ad etzem hayyom hazze, ad velo ad bichlal, vehitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay sheyyehe yom hanef kullo asur, mishshum mehera yibbane bet hammikdash veyomru eshtakad mi lo hava achlinan mishsheheir hammizrach, hasheta nammi nechul, vehen enan yodim devizman hammikdash asur leechol chadash ad sheyyakriv haomer, dichtiv ad haviachem et karban elohechem. vehachi mefarshinan la beferek lulav haggazul:

Hakkaddumin. etz gadol aruch veyotzin mimmennu unkelayot elach vaelach, vetolin beotan unkelayot tzelochiyyot shel mayim baavir kede letzannenan. verambam peresh, kemin zer shel barzel veunkelayot sevivotav, uvo maalin hakkelim shennaflu labbor:
Haashkelonim. shennaasim beashkelon:

Hammaber vehammazre vehammaggov. kelim asuyin lenakkot hattevua min hatteven ulehaavir hatteven mimmakom lemakom. hammaber, yesh lo shinnayim dome layyad shel bene adam, uvo maavirin hatteven mimmakom lemakom. vehammazre, bo zorim hachittin baggoren, lefichach nikra mazre. veshinnav merubbot mishshinne hammaber. vehammaggov, shinnav merubbot mishshinne hammazre, uvo borrim hattevua achar shezzaru otah bammazre:

Veal kullam amar rabbi yehoshua vechulei. betosefta muchach deakkol hane mille dematnitin kae rabbi yehoshua, mehaishsha shehi tevulat yom ad kan. umishshum derabbi yehoshua kae akkullehu, tana hacha mille tuva sheen inyanam lechan:
Davar chadash chiddeshu sofrim. sheen haddaat notenet sheyyihye haddavar ken:
Veen li ma lehashiv. mippene ma amru chen:
Shomeret yavam. shehi mamtenet umetzappa leyavam:
Shennaflu lah nechasim. mibbet aviha:
Ma yaasu vichtubbatah. mane umatayim vetosefet uneduneya shehichnisa lo vekibbel alav acharayut:
Uvannechasim hannichnasim veyotzim. nichse melog, shekkeshehi nichneset nichnasin immah uchesheyyotzet mibbaalah yotzin immah:
Bet shammay omrim yachaloku yorshe habbaal im yorshe haav. desafek nesua hi, vezoche hayyavam bachatzi yerushshatah missafek, shehabbaal yoresh et ishto, veze shessafek nesua hi etzlo zoche vefalga:

Nechasim bechezkatan. nichse tzon barzel, bechezkatan. velo pershu bet hillel i bechezkat yorshe haishsha shehayu hannechasim shellah, i bechezkat yorshe habbaal sheacharayutam alav. uleinyan dina yachaloku afillu ledivre bet hillel:
Mitzva vaggadol leyabbem. kidyalfinan mivvehaya habbechor:
Haomer haya mattir bammedina. leechol hechadash bechol hammekomot:
Ushete hallechem bammikdash. shekkodem shete hallechem en meviin mincha mittevua chadasha, dichtiv bishte hallechem (Bamidbar 28) mincha chadasha, shettehe chadasha lechol hammenachot:
Uminchat behema. minchat nesachim shel behema:
Veim hevi. kodem laomer:
Pasul. shello huttar hechadash mikkelalo afillu etzel hahedyot:
Aval kodem shete hallechem lo yavi, veim hevi kasher. shekkevar huttar mikkelalo etzel hahedyot:

Targum shekketavo ivrit. targum shebbedaniyyel veezra, uchegon kidna temrun lehom shebbeyirmeya (perek 10), im ketavo bilshon hakkodesh, vechen divre hannavi hanneemarim bilshon hakkodesh shekketavan targum, en metammeim et hayyadayim:

Ketav ivri. hakketav shebba meever hannahar. vehakkutiyyim kotvim bo ad hayyom, veyisrael hayu mishtammeshin beoto ketav bedivre chol. uvematbeot shel ketav hannimtzaim beyadenu hayyom shehayu mizzeman malche yisrael, mefuttachot beoto ketav. aval hakketav sheanu kotvim bo sefarim hayyom, ketav ashshuri hu nikra, vehu hakketav shehaya balluchot. venikra ashshuri, shehu hameushshar shebbakketivot, leshon beashri ki ishsheruni banot (Bereshit 30):
Tzedoki gelili. tzedoki shehaya meeretz haggalil:
Hammoshel im moshe bagget. shehayu monim lishnot hammelachim vechotvim bechach vechach lemelech peloni, uvesof hagget kotvin kedat moshe veyisrael, ugenay haddavar lemoshe:
Et hammoshel milmalan veet hashshem millemattan. shemmakdimin shem paro leshem hashshem, dichtiv vayyomer paro mi Adonai:
Ucheshellaka. paro:
Ma hu omer Adonai‏ hatztzaddik. kede shello lehashelim hammassechta bemi Adonai‏ asher eshma bekolo, mishshum al taamod bedavar ra, hishlim baAdonai‏ hatztzaddik:

Umitztarfin ze im ze. lehashelim shiur haissa hachayyevet bachalla. velo sheyyitztarfu kullan yachad, demin besheeno mino en mitztaref, ella hachittin mitztarfin im hakkussemin bilvad mippene shehen minan, vehasseorim mitztarfin im hakkol chutz min hachittim. veaf al gav dechussemin min chittin hen, lav min chittin davka, ella min seorim veaf min chittim, umitztarfin im hachittim vehasseorim. umihu bayrushalmi mashma deim nilloshu yachad mitztarfin afillu min besheeno mino. aval im lo nilloshu yachad ella sheachar kach hayu noshchot haissot zo bazo, min bemino mitztarfin, shello bemino en mitztarfin:
Vaasurim bechadash. kedichtiv (Vayikra 23) velechem vekali vecharmel lo tochlu ad etzem hayyom hazze, vegamrinan lechem lechem mippesach, ma lehallan mechameshet hamminim af kan mechameshet hamminim:

Umilliktzor millifne happesach. sheasur liktzor meechad mechameshet hamminim kodem ketzirat haomer. dichtiv baomer (sham) reshit ketzirchem, shettehe techilla lechol hanniktzarim, veatya reshit reshit mechalla, ketiv hatam (Bamidbar 15) reshit arisotechem, uchetiv hacha reshit ketzirchem, ma lehallan mechameshet hamminim, af kan mechameshet hamminim:
Veim hishrishu. echad mechameshet hamminim hallalu kodem ketzirat haomer:
Haomer mattiran. umuttar lekatzran achar ketzirat haomer. dichtiv (Shemot 23) asher tizra bassade, mishshaa shennizra venishrash bassade:
Veim lav. shello hishrishu ella leachar ketzirat haomer:
Asurim ad sheyyavo haomer habba. shel shana habbaa:
